SECT_STEWARDSHIP_BASE_STANDING.name: Standing
riders: Standing measures how an institution currently recognizes you.
Standing is not cultivation Realm, social class, noble rank, or universal reputation. It is local and contextual.
There are five ordinary Standing grades.
No Standing. You are a stranger, guest, prisoner, petitioner, or unknown worker.
Servant Standing. You may perform basic labor, receive food or shelter, and be ordered around.
Outer Standing. You are trusted for ordinary duties, simple missions, shared facilities, and basic records.
Inner Standing. You are trusted with restricted duties, better instruction, inner facilities, low-grade resources, and sensitive errands.
Core Standing. You are trusted with disciples, stores, restricted archives, important missions, hall authority, or a named courtyard.

Some institutions may also recognize Elder Standing, Guest Elder Standing, Lineage Heir Standing, Clan Standing, Official Standing, or other campaign-specific statuses. These are story positions and are not automatically gained from this sphere.

When you learn Sect Stewardship, choose one institution where you have Servant or Outer Standing, subject to GM approval. If the campaign begins before you have joined any group, you instead gain the Petitioner status and can use the sphere to earn your first recognized place.

### The World Rests on My Palm
“The immortal lowered one hand. The army did not fall. It simply discovered what it had always been standing on.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Bearing Ground, hidden earth-root scripture
Action Type: Action
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on a point on the ground you can perceive or have ritually marked
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per month or once per major story arc, as determined by the GM
You claim the burden of a battlefield, valley, mountain pass, city gate, sect courtyard, mine, tomb complex, or other grounded region.
Choose one principle when you activate this inheritance.
#### Nothing Unmoored May Rule
Creatures hostile to you cannot teleport into, teleport out of, burrow through, phase through, or use planar movement through the area unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Earth Save DC.
On a success, the movement works, but the creature gains one Burden Mark and takes 6d10 Force damage as the world makes it pay the weight of departure.
This does not block deity-scale movement, artifact-scale movement, or GM-declared story-scale passage.
#### The Ground Bears the Innocent
Choose any number of creatures you can name, see, or ritually identify as protected.
While a protected creature touches ground in the area:
it has Advantage on death saving throws;
it cannot be moved against its will by ordinary forced movement;
the first time each minute it would take damage, reduce that damage by 10d10;

effects.on: Difficult Terrain
effects.evidence: the creature treats one 10-foot square of your choice inside the figment as Difficult Terrain

riders: Your figments can alter the apparent terrain inside their area. You can make grassland appear as forest, a wall of fire appear as harmless mist, a pit appear as floor, a bridge appear broken, a door appear absent, or a safe road appear flooded.

The terrain is not physically changed. The effect does not create real Difficult Terrain, Cover, bridges, pits, fire, water, or hazards. However, a creature that fails to Study the illusion and chooses its route based on the false terrain may gain a False Premise from you. You may trigger a Misdirection Response when that creature moves willingly through or around the false terrain.

TAL_ILLUSION_PROGRAMMED_ILLUSION.name: Programmed Illusion
riders: When creating a figment, you may cause it to remain dormant and invisible until a trigger occurs. The trigger can be as general or detailed as you like, but it must be based on visual, audible, tactile, scent, aura, or simple environmental conditions that occur within 30 feet of the figment’s location.

Until triggered, the figment is imperceptible. Once triggered, it performs a simple sequence you set when you create it, with a maximum duration of 5 minutes. After that sequence ends, the figment disappears.
If you also use an effect that makes the figment permanent, it resets after its sequence ends and waits for the trigger again.

riders: Reaction, range 60 feet, once per round. You Witness a Cause when you directly see or hear it, it acts against you, or it acts against your side; the game asks you first, then places the Imprint and spends your Reaction.

Debt. Place one Debt Imprint when the creature does one of the following: deals meaningful damage to another creature; inflicts a harmful condition; breaks a clear oath; betrays a willing ally; steals something of real value; commands a minion to perform a harmful act; performs another harmful act approved by the GM. Grace. Place one Grace Imprint when the creature does one of the following: restores Hit Points to another creature; prevents meaningful damage; removes a harmful condition; protects another creature at personal risk; keeps a difficult oath; repays a meaningful debt; performs another selfless act approved by the GM. Automated: a teammate restores another creature's Hit Points, or takes damage for another (Take the Blow, Oath of Mutual Defense and the like). GM-applied: preventing damage, removing a condition, keeping an oath, repaying a debt, and any other selfless act.

A creature holds a combined number of your Imprints up to your Proficiency Bonus. A single action normally creates only one Imprint (one per creature and action). If more than one creature is responsible, the GM determines who receives the Imprint.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_ONGOING_TECHNIQUE.use_limit: text:once per creature per long rest

effects.evidence: Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature's Cultivation Save DC. Success: Transfer one eligible beneficial effect from the target to yourself for up to 1 minute. the target ceases benefiting while the effect is stolen; time spent stolen counts against the effect's duration; if the effect ends while stolen, it does not return; if it remains active when this theft ends, it returns to the original creature for its remaining duration

TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_ANCESTRAL_WRIT.name: Ancestral Writ

activation.trigger: When you have access to a legitimate ancestral record, founding oath, old charter, saint’s instruction, sect law, clan genealogy, or lineage tablet

riders: Prerequisite: CL 15+.
You can invoke the old words correctly.
When you have access to a legitimate ancestral record, founding oath, old charter, saint’s instruction, sect law, clan genealogy, or lineage tablet, spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.

On a success, the Writ grants one non-combat effect: delay an unlawful punishment until review; open a sealed but non-secret archive category; protect a junior from being erased from records; require a hall to answer a formal question; preserve a property, title, or duty from casual seizure; grant safe guest status to a named petitioner for 24 hours; prove that a tradition, promise, or boundary once existed.
On a failure, the Writ is ambiguous, politically inconvenient, incomplete, or challenged.
This talent cannot compel an ancestor to appear, create a divine miracle, or override a current sect master without consequence.

TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_COURTYARD_ALLOTMENT.name: Courtyard Allotment

activation.trigger: When you spend downtime in an institution where you have at least Outer Standing

riders: Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can secure a place where people can breathe.

When you spend downtime in an institution where you have at least Outer Standing, you may spend one Merit Die to secure modest private or semi-private space for yourself and a small group for 24 hours.
The space may be a guest room, side courtyard, shed, classroom, empty shrine room, unused lecture alcove, medicine cot, or supervised cultivation room.
While using the space for rest, study, crafting, ordinary healing, or cultivation meditation, one creature may add your Merit Die to one relevant non-combat check.
This talent cannot create luxury, privacy against high-ranking inspection, or a room inside a forbidden area.

While using this place for non-combat work, you and your invited allies gain the following benefits: regain all Merit Dice after a Long Rest if you perform 10 minutes of duties there; gain Advantage on one Sect Check per day made inside the place; safely store ordinary records, tools, clothing, and non-rare supplies; maintain a small staff or student group if you have Disciple Register.
If the place is attacked, seized, politically undermined, or neglected, the benefits pause until restored.

riders: An unwilling spirit must be defeated, restrained, trapped in a vessel, inside a prepared circle, shrine, formation, body or object, reduced to 0 Hit Points, willingly accepting punishment, or unable to flee because of another legal effect.
The spirit may seek loopholes, sabotage, malicious compliance, or escape.
description: A Binding Seal restrains or compels a spirit.

Binding Seal is Restricted or Forbidden in many orthodox sects unless used to contain hostile spirits, seal plague spirits, imprison murderous ghosts, restrain demons, secure a battlefield threat, or protect civilians.
To place a Binding Seal on an unwilling spirit, the spirit must be one of the following:
- defeated;
- trapped in a vessel;
- inside a prepared circle, shrine, formation, body, or object;
- willingly accepting punishment;
- unable to flee because of another legal effect.
On a failure, the Binding Seal takes hold.
While Binding Seal holds:
- you may command limited service through Manifest the Spirit Nature;
- the spirit may seek loopholes, sabotage, malicious compliance, or escape.
A Binding Seal is not friendship. It is a chain.

you and the spirit can communicate simple ideas while within 1 mile of each other

description: A Covenant Bond is a willing relationship with a spirit.
The spirit must be willing, persuaded, repaid, rescued, honored, defeated honorably, inherited, or otherwise narratively available.
A Covenant Bond creates a Major Spirit Bond.
While the Covenant Bond remains stable:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one gift below that matches the recorded lineage.

### Dragon Gift

Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Radiant, or Thunder as the lineage damage type. Gain Resistance to that type. Spend 2 Qi as a Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet until the end of your turn.

### Phoenix Gift

When reduced to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, spend 4 Qi to remain at 1 Hit Point. Hostile creatures within 5 feet take `2d8` Fire or Radiant damage, chosen when the gift is gained; each makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Qi Cultivation Save DC, taking half damage on a success. Once per scene.

### Demon-Blood Gift

Choose Necrotic, Psychic, Poison, or one damage type printed by the lineage source. Once per turn, one damaging Qi-powered feature deals an additional `1d6` damage of that type.

### Jade Tortoise Gift

Gain +1 AC and reduce forced movement applied to you by 5 feet, to a minimum of 0 feet.

### Fox Gift

Gain proficiency in Deception, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion; if already proficient in the chosen skill, gain a +2 bonus to checks with it. As a Reaction when a creature you can perceive within 30 feet makes an attack roll, spend 1 Qi to impose Disadvantage on that roll.

insight.armament-commander.name: Armament Commander
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Domain Armament, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Your Domain Armament improves:

- Control range increases by 30 feet.
- Movement increases by 15 feet.
- Calling or releasing a bound item may occur at any point during your turn without using an action, once per turn.

Once per turn when your Domain Armament hits, choose one:

- Push or pull the target 5 feet.
- The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Move the Armament 10 feet.
- Reveal the target with visible Qi until the start of your next turn; Invisible does not conceal it from you.
- Gain Advantage on your next Cultivation Attack against that target before the end of your next turn.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Domain Armament and the Formations Sphere, Talismans Sphere, Sigil Scribe, Calligraphy Cultivator, or another Formation-authorized Source Rule, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Your Domain Armament may serve as one movable Formation Anchor.

When used as an Anchor:

- It uses the better of its item durability or `AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC` and `Hit Points equal to 3 × your CL`.
- It may move normally unless the Formation expressly requires a fixed Anchor.
- Moving it repositions only effects that the Formation permits to move.
- If it is suppressed, restrained, or forced out of legal range, the anchored portion is suppressed.
- A real bound item is not duplicated or made indestructible.

Once per turn after moving the Anchor, gain one of the following until the start of your next turn:

- +1 AC for one ally inside the Formation.
- Move one willing creature in the Formation 5 feet.
- Extend one Formation line by 5 feet.
- Reveal one creature touching a Formation boundary.

---

notes: Every printed combat effect is automated by APP/combat/ext/body_as_center.py: compile_actions publishes one centered-on-you variant of each printed way to pay Gravitic Pull, Gravity Well, Crushing Field and Flight Suppression -- the three area talents place their zone on the fighter's own body and Gravitic Pull pulls toward the caster (direction "toward", the printed "toward a point you can see" with the point being the fighter's body), and a variant that pays Stamina costs one less Stamina, never less than one (a CP-paying variant keeps its printed CP cost, because the reduction is to the Stamina actually paid). The centered area follows its owner only until the start of the owner's next turn through the general zone_follows seam (combat/zones.py follows_now): zone_created records the turn the area was centered and zone_follows answers False once the owner's turn count has moved past it, so the area then remains at its current location for the rest of its duration. Centering changes only placement and cost, so the talent's own saves and recipients are unchanged and the owner is not immune to the effect unless the talent says so. Prerequisite and the ability-score selection are character construction, not combat effects.

insight.breath-thread-listener.name: Breath-Thread Listener
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Air sphere, Spirit Awakening, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Use your Spirit Awakening CL for Breath Reading and the normal Air Source CL for Air talents.

You hear the spiritual thread carried by breath, speech, and suppressed panic.

You have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks against a creature within 30 feet that you can hear breathing or speaking.

### Breath Reading

**Action Type:** No Action  
**Trigger:** A creature within 30 feet that you can hear knowingly speaks a false statement, begins an audible command or compulsion technique, or attempts to conceal immediate fear or panic  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Learn which one of the following states best describes the triggering breath:

- **Steady:** The creature's breath does not reveal deliberate falsehood, immediate panic, or coercive command pressure.
- **Strained:** The creature is afraid, under duress, injured, or suppressing panic.
- **False:** The spoken statement deliberately conflicts with what the creature presently believes. This does not detect omission, metaphor, mistake, or technically true misdirection.
- **Absent:** The creature has no living breath, is using an artificial voice, or is speaking through a body that does not breathe normally.
- **Spiritually Masked:** A cultivation effect is concealing or falsifying the breath-thread.

If a masking effect has lower Source CL than you, you identify both the underlying state and that it was masked. Otherwise, make a Spirit Awakening Cultivation Check against the masking effect's Cultivation Save DC. On a success, identify the underlying state. On a failure, learn only **Spiritually Masked**.

Breath Reading does not read thoughts, reveal the complete truth, identify an unknown technique by name, or force the creature to speak.

effects.evidence: Once per turn after you push a hostile creature at least 10 feet, knock a hostile creature Prone, reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, break a qualifying recorded object or scene objective, destroy a barrier or Formation Anchor, or escape a hostile Grapple or Restrained effect, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. **Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

- Pill diagnosis.
- Ingredient substitution.
- Cauldron stabilization.
- Poison identification.
- Medicine refinement.

Once during each distinct crafting procedure, after failing a crafting or stabilization check, reroll it.

- Preserve half of the ordinary ingredients.

This Insight cannot preserve a Secret ingredient, permanent sacrifice, or irreplaceable relic consumed by the procedure.

insight.ceremonial-yue-bearer.name: Ceremonial Yue Bearer
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Axes sphere, Mandate Axe Presence, CL12+, and Spirit Awakening, Warleader sphere, Sovereign Will, or another printed mandate doctrine

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** The Source CL of Mandate Axe Presence.

When you make a public declaration through **Mandate Axe Presence**, name one lawful group, sect, clan, office, army, sworn band, protected settlement, or another recorded authority with defined membership and jurisdiction that you actually represent.

You have Advantage on the Axes Check if at least one listener satisfies either condition:

- **Recognized Authority:** The listener knows your office or affiliation, has been shown a genuine credential, standard, seal, witness, or insignia, or has previously seen that authority lawfully exercised.
- **Feared Consequences:** The listener reasonably believes the named authority can investigate, punish, protect, mobilize, or retaliate within the current situation.

### Dishonored Mandate

If you knowingly use this Insight to pronounce a materially false judgment and the falsehood is publicly exposed, you gain **Dishonored Mandate** and cannot benefit from this Insight.

Remove Dishonored Mandate by completing one public restitution scene that includes:

1. acknowledging or correcting the false judgment before the harmed party, represented group, or a recognized witness; and
2. completing one of the following: material compensation, an accepted office punishment, a formal apology and retraction, or a Karma or purification procedure that expressly settles the abuse.

A declaration made from incomplete information is not a false judgment unless you knowingly represented uncertain information as established fact.

insight.compressed-golden-core.name: Compressed Golden Core
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when you activate a Qi-powered feature, compress it in one of these ways:

### Single-Target Compression

If the feature affects exactly one target, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll and increase its save DC by 1.

### Area Compression

Reduce one printed area dimension by at least 5 feet. Add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll against one target in the reduced area and subtract 1 from the first saving throw made against it.

### Line Compression

Reduce a line's width to 5 feet or reduce its length by at least 20 feet. The line ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

A feature cannot benefit from Compressed and Expansive Golden Core during the same activation.

---
description:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when you activate a Qi-powered feature, compress it in one of these ways:

### Single-Target Compression

If the feature affects exactly one target, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll and increase its save DC by 1.

### Area Compression

Reduce one printed area dimension by at least 5 feet. Add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll against one target in the reduced area and subtract 1 from the first saving throw made against it.

### Line Compression

Reduce a line's width to 5 feet or reduce its length by at least 20 feet. The line ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

A feature cannot benefit from Compressed and Expansive Golden Core during the same activation.

---

insight.conceptual-edge.name: Conceptual Edge
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Heaven-Splitting Conceptual Severance or equivalent Secret authority, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use a feature that severs, cuts, suppresses, or separates a relationship, spend 3 additional Qi to name one eligible conceptual connection:

- Weapon from owner.
- Technique from source.
- Soul from body.
- Name from authority.
- Formation from Anchor.
- Qi from meridian.
- Memory from identity.
- Oath from beneficiary.
- Regeneration from injury.

Against a target whose Source CL is lower than yours, the connection is suppressed until the scene ends unless the feature already grants a longer result.

Against an equal or higher Source CL, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On success, suppress it until the end of your next turn.

This Insight cannot create a permanent severance unless the underlying Secret feature already authorizes permanence and its price is paid.

---

riders:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

- reduce damage by one damage die;
- reduce forced movement by 5 feet;
- reduce Strain, Crack, Corruption, or a similar counted state by 1; or
- prevent the weapon from being dropped.

If the complication has none of those components, this Insight cannot reduce it.

insight.core-sheltering-scripture.name: Core-Sheltering Scripture
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain Advantage on saving throws and Cultivation Checks against:

- Golden Core damage.
- Core extraction.
- Forced Core mutation.
- Core imprisonment.
- Suppression of your Golden Core Form.
- Effects attempting to replace your Golden Core.

Once per round, when a hostile effect suppresses or damages a Golden Core function, choose one:

- Spend 2 Qi to delay the suppression until the end of your current turn.
- Reduce its duration by one round, minimum one round.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks before the suppression fully takes hold.
- Transfer the effect's Anchor mark to your Domain Armament when the effect can legally target it; the Armament becomes the affected Anchor instead.

A Secret or higher-authority effect may require a Cultivation Check against its save DC to use the final option.

insight.courteous-medium.name: Courteous Medium
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once per spirit per scene, when you first address it respectfully after successfully reading its Spirit Nature, reduce the DC of your next social check made toward that spirit during the scene by 2.

If, before making the check, you provide one Offering that matches the spirit's recorded appetite, Minor Offering, custom, office, or acknowledged need, reduce the DC by 5 instead.

An Offering qualifies only if it is actually delivered or made available on the terms stated. The same object, promise, service, or sacrifice cannot qualify simultaneously for multiple spirits unless each spirit's record permits shared use.

This Insight improves the opening position; it does not force cooperation, waive a Taboo, erase Bond Strain, or make an insulting or impossible request acceptable.

insight.cremation-furnace-core.name: Cremation-Furnace Core
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Cinder Heart Cultivator or Fire/Ash cultivation access, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When a qualifying creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points within 30 feet after taking Fire, Radiant, or Ash-tagged damage from you during the current turn, gain 1 Ash Charge.

- Maximum Ash Charges: Your Proficiency Bonus.
- A creature yields one Ash Charge until its body, spirit, or cultivation is genuinely restored.
- Ash Charges disappear after a Full Cultivation Session unless incorporated into another printed procedure.

Spend 1 Ash Charge when activating a Qi-powered feature to choose one:

- Add `1d8` Fire or Necrotic damage to one roll.
- Reduce its Qi cost by 1, minimum 1.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Prevent one damaged target from regaining Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

Using this Insight leaves visible cremation residue on your Golden Core and victims.

---

- Advantage on your next unarmed attack roll;
- that hit deals additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; and
- immediately move up to 10 feet toward a hostile creature by the safest legal route.

Once per scene, after failing a check directly connected to your ancestry, inherited culture, bloodline enemy, ancestral territory, or lineage technique, reroll it.

You must use the new result.

During a Full Cultivation Session, you may ask one question of ancestral memory. The answer is limited to knowledge a genuine ancestor could have possessed and may be symbolic, incomplete, or biased, but it cannot be deliberately false unless the ancestral source itself is deceptive.

insight.divine-statue-meditation.name: Divine Statue Meditation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Gōruden, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

**Divine Statue Procedure.** Spend 10 uninterrupted minutes in a statue-like posture. At the end, choose one:

- regain 2 Stamina, not above your maximum;
- gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`; or
- gain Advantage on the next saving throw you make before the end of the next scene against Frightened, Disease, Poison, or Necrotic damage.

You can benefit from this procedure once per scene. Taking damage, moving, or performing another cultivation activation interrupts it.

- regain 2 Stamina, not above your maximum;
- gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet until the end of the current turn; or

insight.dual-body-synthesis.name: Dual-Body Synthesis
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Two Internalized Sphere Insights, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

Choose two different internalized Spheres and record one physical synthesis joining them.

Once per turn, after you successfully resolve a talent from one Sphere in the pair, the next talent you activate from the other Sphere before the end of your next turn costs 1 less Stamina, minimum 1.

You can hold only one pending reduction. Triggering the synthesis again replaces the pending reduction and its expiration. It cannot trigger from a refunded or invalid activation, cannot reduce a cost below 1, and cannot create a closed resource loop. You may maintain only one Dual-Body Synthesis unless another rule explicitly permits more.

insight.dual-element-golden-core.name: Dual-Element Golden Core
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Two elemental Spheres, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose two elemental Spheres you know.

When you activate a Qi-powered feature from one chosen Sphere, your next feature from the other chosen Sphere before the end of your next turn gains one Fusion benefit:

- Reduce its Qi cost by 1, minimum 1.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll.
- Increase one forced movement by 10 feet.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks after it resolves.
- Grant one affected ally Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.

Use one Fusion benefit per turn.

Repeatedly using the same element does not generate Fusion.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Sand sphere, Sand-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 15+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use a Sand Burial talent, you may choose any number of creatures affected by it to be preserved rather than crushed.

A preserved creature does not take Scouring or compression damage from that talent, has Advantage on death saving throws while Buried by you, and can breathe through a narrow thread of sand for up to 1 minute.

In addition, once between Full Cultivation Sessions when you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while touching Sand Terrain you control, you may fall apart into sand and re-form in an unoccupied Sand Terrain square within 30 feet. You instead drop to 1 Hit Point. You cannot use this benefit if you are Incapacitated before the damage resolves, sealed in a Barrier that blocks Sand movement, or prevented from transforming.

insight.elemental-armament.name: Elemental Armament
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Domain Armament, one elemental Sphere or an elemental Qi Subpath, CL12+  
**Repeatable:** Choose a different element each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one damage type associated with an elemental Sphere you know.

Your projected Domain Armament may deal that damage type. A bound real item may apply the elemental damage to its Domain Armament Attack without changing its ordinary wielded damage.

Once per turn when the Armament hits with the chosen damage type, choose one:

- Deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Push or pull the target 5 feet.
- Reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Move the Armament 10 feet.

The rider must be thematically and mechanically compatible with the selected element as recorded when the Insight is gained.

insight.elemental-core-mutation.name: Elemental Core Mutation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, one elemental Sphere, CL8+  
**Repeatable:** Choose a different elemental Sphere each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one elemental Sphere you know.

At the end of a Full Cultivation Session, choose one mutation. It remains until you complete another Full Cultivation Session and choose again.

### Resistant Mutation

Gain Resistance to one damage type directly associated with the Sphere.

### Violent Mutation

Once per turn, one damaging feature from the Sphere deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

### Driving Mutation

Increase one forced movement caused by the Sphere by 10 feet once per turn.

### Flowing Mutation

Once per turn after activating a feature from the Sphere, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

### Sheltering Mutation

Once per turn after activating a feature from the Sphere, you or one affected ally gains Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.

### Expansive Mutation

Once per turn, increase one radius or cone by 5 feet or one line by 10 feet.

A single activation benefits from one mutation granted by this Insight.

---

insight.elemental-dominion.name: Elemental Dominion
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Elemental Mastery, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 6 Qi

Create a Dominion of the damage type chosen for Elemental Mastery.

For the duration:

- Your Qi-powered features of the selected type may originate from any point inside the Dominion.
- Allies you choose gain Resistance to the selected type while inside.
- The first time during each turn that a hostile creature takes the selected damage inside, it takes additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- An ordinary environmental expression of the element obeys your printed direction inside the area.

When a hostile persistent elemental effect of an opposing or incompatible type overlaps the Dominion:

- If its Source CL is lower than yours, suppress it in the overlap.
- If its Source CL is equal to or higher than yours, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On success, suppress it in the overlap until the start of your next turn.

Elemental Dominion is a Qi field, not a Spirit Awakening Domain.

---

insight.exorcist-s-calling.name: Exorcist's Calling
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Awakening, CL4+, Spiritual Sense  
**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.  
**Source CL:** Your Spirit Awakening CL.

You have learned to diagnose and interrupt invasive spiritual influences before gaining the Path's complete exorcism feature.

## Lesser Exorcism

**Action Type:** Action  
**Range:** 30 feet  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance  
**Target:** One creature, object, location, manifested spirit, or Spiritual Anchor that you can perceive with Spiritual Sense or Soul Gaze, or one target bearing your Resonance Mark

Choose one **Intrusion** attached to the target that you can perceive:

- unwilling Possession;
- unwilling or coercive Hosting;
- dream intrusion;
- spiritual contamination;
- imposed emotional corruption;
- memory interference;
- hostile spirit presence; or
- a curse whose Source Rule has a spiritual component.

You cannot target:

- a willing stable Covenant Bond unless both bonded parties consent to separation;
- integrated spirit ancestry or a legal Species, Path, Subpath, Foundation, Method, Origin Insight, or ordinary memory;
- completed death, reincarnation, permanent soul destruction, or divine custody; or
- an artifact, Secret, Immortal, or world-law effect unless its Source Rule permits ordinary exorcism.

### Resolution

Make a Spirit Awakening Cultivation Check against the Intrusion's Cultivation Save DC. If it has no printed DC, use the possessing spirit's or creator's Cultivation Save DC. If neither exists, use the Rules Reference fallback Authority DC for the source's Realm.

On a failed check, the Intrusion remains. Learn its broad category, its Source CL band relative to you, and whether it is sustained by a creature, Bond, vessel, location, Domain, or Spiritual Anchor.

On a successful check, compare Source CL:

- **6 or More Lower:** End one ordinary temporary Intrusion. For Possession, achieve Grade 2 Separation and place the Intruder in its legal adjacent manifestation, legal vessel, or visible noncontrolling outline. A permanent, Secret, artifact, divine, or explicitly anchored Intrusion is suppressed until the scene ends and reveals one printed release requirement instead.
- **3–5 Lower:** Suppress the Intrusion for up to 1 minute while you maintain Concentration. The Host immediately repeats one saving throw the Intrusion allows with Advantage. The Intruder becomes perceptible and cannot conceal its link during suppression.
- **Within 2:** Suppress the Intrusion until the end of the target's next turn. The Host immediately repeats one allowed saving throw with Advantage. If no repeat save exists, suppression is the complete result.
- **3 or More Higher:** Do not suppress it. The Host immediately repeats one allowed saving throw with Advantage. Expose the Intrusion's manifestation and the direction of its sustaining Anchor to your Spiritual Sense until the end of your next turn.

A willing Host may waive resistance made on its behalf. A willing Intruder does not resist separation. If both Host and Intruder oppose separation, use the higher relevant Cultivation Save DC; if only one opposes, use that opponent's DC.

### Limits

- A specific Intrusion can be targeted by your Lesser Exorcism only once per round.
- Lesser Exorcism cannot destroy a Complete Soul, transfer spirit ownership, create a Companion Bond, strip integrated ancestry, or remove legal character options.
- It cannot bypass a named rite, material, location, authority, or higher Source CL requirement unless the result expressly satisfies it.

## CL13 Improvement

When you gain **Spiritual Exorcism** from Spirit Awakening:

- Lesser Exorcism costs 1 Resonance;
- its range becomes 60 feet;
- successful suppression against a lower-Source-CL Intrusion does not require Concentration; and
- when you expose an equal- or higher-authority Intrusion, the target has Advantage on its next saving throw against it before the scene ends.

This Insight does not grant the Spirit Companions Sphere and does not replace the Exorcist tradition.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Strength, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL for this external-projection permission.

You may use non-Domain Earth features with a printed range of 30 feet or less when the effect originates from your body, a stomp, a strike, a held object, or a continuous surface connected to your footing. At CL10, Foundation-Realm Earth talents used this way may reach 60 feet.

You cannot create Earth in open air, originate from an unseen or disconnected surface, or ignore line of effect unless the Earth feature expressly permits it. The permission ends if no legal bodily or surface route remains.

The projection originates from your held implement or striking motion. This Insight does not grant broad Qi projection, affect an unseen workpiece, or waive materials, tools, time, or other Blacksmith requirements.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

After completing a 10-minute cultivation preparation procedure, you may perform one 10-minute Field Refinement on an existing non-Secret Cultivation Asset, Domain Armament, Formation Anchor, talisman, medical implement, or prepared vessel.

Choose one benefit lasting until the end of the next scene:

- Increase its Hit Points by `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
- Increase its movement by 10 feet.
- Increase one operating range by 10 feet.

- Allow it to ignore the first ordinary suppression effect whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- Reduce the Qi cost of its first activation by 1, minimum 1.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you activate Qi-powered features carrying three different elemental alignments during the same scene, gain 1 Cycle Charge after the third resolves.

- Maximum Cycle Charges: Your Proficiency Bonus.
- Each distinct activation can count toward one sequence.
- Repeating an element before completing the sequence does not erase progress but does not advance it.
- A new sequence begins after a charge is gained.

Spend 1 Cycle Charge when activating a Qi-powered feature to choose one:

- Reduce its Qi cost by 1, minimum 1.
- Add `2d8` to one damage or healing roll.
- Increase one forced movement by 10 feet.
- Increase one radius or cone by 5 feet or one line by 10 feet.
- Grant one affected ally Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
- Gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn.

Unused Cycle Charges disappear when the scene ends.

When activating a Qi-powered feature that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, spend 1 additional Qi to change any amount of that damage to another type from the same list.

Declare the conversion before attack rolls or saving throws are resolved.

The conversion:

- Changes damage type.
- Does not automatically change the feature's Sphere, elemental, weather, or metaphysical tags.
- Does not add a rider belonging to the new damage type.
- Applies once across a Barrage, area, or multiattack activation.
- May convert technique damage delivered through a weapon, but does not convert ordinary weapon damage unless the delivery rule explicitly permits it.

At CL16, you may instead spend 2 additional Qi to convert the chosen damage to Force.

insight.formation-apprentice.name: Formation Apprentice
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Formations Sphere, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain +2 on Cultivation Checks involving:

- Formation design.
- Formation identification.
- Formation repair.
- Formation disruption.
- Anchor placement.
- Formation maintenance.

During a 10-minute preparation procedure, create one temporary Minor Anchor from available materials.

The Anchor:

- Uses your Source CL.
- Has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC.
- Has Hit Points equal to `2 × your CL`.
- Lasts until destroyed, dismissed, or you complete a Full Cultivation Session.
- Can support only a Formation effect that explicitly accepts a Minor or temporary Anchor.

You may maintain one temporary Minor Anchor from this Insight.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Survive a Formation collapse, spatial collapse, teleportation disaster, or prison Formation Tribulation

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain Advantage on checks and saving throws to:

- Escape Formations.
- Resist unwilling teleportation.
- Locate spatial faults.
- Survive collapsing pocket spaces.

When trapped, sealed, or spatially isolated, you immediately learn the direction of the nearest vulnerable Anchor, boundary fault, exit route, or unstable spatial seam within 300 feet, if one exists.

Once per scene, spend 3 Qi to move up to 15 feet through one Formation boundary or spatial seam whose Source CL is lower than yours.

Against an equal or higher Source CL, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

insight.heart-devil-negotiator.name: Heart-Devil Negotiator
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Daemonic Cultivation and either Spirit Awakening or Wisdom 14+, CL5+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

### Bargain with the Inner Demon

**Action Type:** No Action  
**Trigger:** You would gain one or more Corruption from a single event  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Make a Wisdom (Insight) check against `DC 12 + your current Corruption` before applying the triggering Corruption.

**Success:** Delay the triggering Corruption until the current scene ends. Record its amount and source. When the scene ends, gain all Corruption delayed by this Insight simultaneously. Ending, suppressing, or bargaining with the source does not erase the delayed amount unless that Source Rule expressly removes Corruption already incurred.

**Failure:** Gain the Corruption immediately and record one **Temptation**. Choose or roll `1d6`:

| d6 | Temptation |
|---:|---|
| 1 | Conceal the Corruption or its source from an ally or authority. |
| 2 | Seize, consume, protect, or study the object or essence that caused it. |
| 3 | Accept a further offer of power, knowledge, or access from the source. |
| 4 | Isolate yourself from anyone likely to interfere. |
| 5 | Spare, obey, imitate, or bargain with the entity behind the Corruption. |
| 6 | Prove your superiority through an unnecessary risk, contest, or display. |

A Temptation is a recorded impulse, not control. It cannot compel an action, impose a condition, or create additional Corruption unless another Source Rule says so. It ends with the scene.

An effect that expressly says its Corruption cannot be delayed overrides this Insight.

insight.heart-stealing-resonance.name: Heart-Stealing Resonance
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Emotion Cultivator or access to Mind, Emotion, or Spirit manipulation; CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When a creature fails a saving throw against one of your emotional cultivation effects, spend 2 additional Qi to choose one:

- Learn its current dominant emotion.
- Learn one emotional vulnerability presently influencing its decisions.
- Give it Disadvantage on its next saving throw against Charmed or Frightened before the end of your next turn.
- Prevent it from receiving emotional support, morale bonuses, or another creature's reassurance until the start of your next turn.
- Extract one surface emotion into a visible Heart Fragment lasting until the scene ends.

A Heart Fragment may be used as a focus, evidence, ritual component, or emotional key under an authorized Source Rule.

Permanent emotional theft, transplantation, removal, or rewriting requires an effect that explicitly authorizes it, such as the Heart-Stealing forbidden Subpath, a helpless or properly bound target, a ritual, sufficient authority, and printed recovery consequences.

This Insight is not automatically Daemonic.

insight.heaven-s-scar.name: Heaven's Scar
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Survive an extraordinary, unique, Secret, Immortal, or Heaven-recognized Tribulation and record the Tribulation's Source CL and authority

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one Scar expression that directly matches the recorded Tribulation:

1. **Resistant Scar.** Gain Resistance to one damage type dealt by the Tribulation. Once per round after a qualifying hostile source deals that type to you, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
2. **Unbowed Scar.** Gain Advantage on saving throws against one named category of suppression used by the Tribulation.
3. **Scar-Step.** Once during each of your turns after you spend Qi, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
4. **Heaven-Refusing Scar.** Once per scene, when a lower-Source-CL effect would forcibly transform, banish, possess, or kill you, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On a success, the effect fails against you.
5. **Witness Scar.** You can perceive one specific heavenly, spatial, karmic, or elemental phenomenon demonstrated by the Tribulation within 1 mile when it is not concealed by a higher-Source-CL effect.
6. **Matching Feature Scar.** Choose one printed feature from a Tribulation Subpath you possess. Increase one printed once-per-scene use by one, or improve one numerical result by your Proficiency Bonus. Record the exact feature and improvement when this Insight is gained.

Record the Scar's visible sign, mechanical tag, Source CL, expression, and any ongoing price printed by the Tribulation source. No unlisted custom expression is available without a separate published record.

riders:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

- Automatically remove one Tier I ordinary lasting physical Injury whose Source CL is no higher than your Body Refining Source CL.
- For a Tier II Hidden Injury, you may make its treatment check as part of the session and have Advantage if it was already diagnosed.
- A Tier III crippled structure or Tier IV missing limb or organ still requires its printed Reconstruction Progress, project time, a treatment environment meeting the requirements of Body Refining Shared Procedures R1, medicine, ritual aid, and required components. Your personal work counts as a valid Body Refining treatment source.

This Insight cannot automatically reverse Tier V erasure, divine or Immortal authority, Secret effects, Artifacts, soul destruction, heavenly punishment, Foundation destruction, or an effect that expressly requires a breakthrough or story-scale cure.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You gain Advantage on one Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Wisdom (Perception), or Intelligence (Investigation) check per scene to conceal, notice, identify, or ready a small legal weapon.

If the weapon will be used as an attack in combat, it must still be listed on the character sheet before the fight begins.

insight.hidden-sleeve-adept.name: Hidden Sleeve Adept
description:
**Prerequisite:** Hidden Sleeve Preparation, CL 6+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Increase your Prepared Talisman Limit by 1.

Once per scene, when you roll Initiative, you may immediately ready one unprepared talisman you are carrying.
notes: The existing prepared pool gains +1 capacity (canonical insight ID normalized). Prefight setup records starting preparation and an optional one-talisman readying at Initiative; match_start resolves it once without an Action, capped at the limit. Ability-score selection is character building.

insight.hidden-spool-discipline.name: Hidden Spool Discipline
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Thread sphere.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You can hide thread tools on your body even under inspection. You have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks to conceal thread, needles, thin wire, hooks, or small spools. Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, if deprived of equipment, you may reveal that you retained enough thread stock to use one mundane Thread talent.

insight.hollow-meridian-circulation.name: Hollow-Meridian Circulation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Void Sphere or Void-Touched Cultivator, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, after activating a Void-tagged feature, choose one:

- Reduce its Qi cost by 1, minimum 1.
- Move 10 feet through a visible gap without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Gain Advantage on your next Cultivation Check before the end of your next turn.
- Suppress ordinary sound in your space until the start of your next turn.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Ignore one ordinary physical barrier no more than 1 foot thick when measuring the feature's line of effect.

The final option cannot bypass lead, artifacts, sealed Formations, spatial locks, or higher-authority barriers.

---

riders: During downtime, gain Advantage on one relevant Cultivation Check when teaching, copying, sealing or defending a Void scripture.
description:
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Void sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you teach, copy, seal, or defend a Void scripture during downtime, gain Advantage on one relevant Cultivation Check.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Void talents, you may extend Hollowed on that creature until the end of your next turn.

insight.hook-master.name: Hook Master
description:
**Prerequisite:** Chains sphere, CL 8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Your hooks are fast, cruel, and accurate.

Restraining Hook gains:

range increases by 30 feet;

on a failed save, you may also pull the target 5 feet;

once per scene, you may use Restraining Hook without spending CP.

effects.label: Hook Master: pull the target 5 feet

effects.evidence: on a failed save, you may also pull the target 5 feet;

insight.hybrid-sphere-refinement.name: Hybrid-Sphere Refinement
riders:
**Prerequisite:** One Hybrid Sphere, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose the Power expression of one Hybrid Sphere you know.

You may use that expression through Qi and your Qi Cultivation key ability where the Sphere permits.

Retraining between its Might and Power expressions requires:

- 7 days of training;
- a qualified master, manual, lineage, or equivalent recorded source;
- the normal training check; and
- every Restricted, Secret, inherited, ethical, or license requirement printed by the Sphere.

The retraining does not erase talents that remain legal in both expressions.

insight.ice-sure-footwork.name: Ice-Sure Footwork
description:
**Prerequisite:** Ice sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You ignore difficult terrain caused by mundane ice and snow. If you already have Sure-Footed Disciple, you may also stand from Prone while on one of your Lattice Spaces by spending only 5 feet of movement.

insight.impact-tempering.name: Impact Tempering
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Destruction Sphere, Body Refining

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Destruction Source CL, using Body Refining CL when the talent is internalized through Body Refining.

When you deliver Destructive Blast through an unarmed strike, natural weapon, or melee weapon, you may use Constitution for the Cultivation Attack roll.

Once per turn, after such an attack damages an unattended object, structure, vehicle, temporary barrier, Formation Anchor, or defined terrain section, deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to that same target. The additional damage is part of the attack and does not create another hit.

insight.imperial-academy-graduate.name: Imperial Academy Graduate
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Recognized academy access, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain proficiency in Arcana and History. If already proficient in either, gain +2 on checks using that skill instead.

Also gain one:

- Language.
- Script.
- Tool proficiency.
- Bureaucratic credential.

Once per scene, reroll one failed institutional, legal, historical, scholarly, or technical Cultivation Check.

You must use the new result.

Academy status creates obligations, records, superiors, rivals, and possible service requirements according to the institution.

insight.imperial-armory-certification.name: Imperial Armory Certification
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Imperial, military, sect-armory, or equivalent authorization, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one weapon group, armor category, shield category, vehicle weapon, siege implement, or military cultivation implement for which you possess access.

Gain one of the following:

- Proficiency with the chosen weapon group.
- Proficiency with the chosen armor or shield category.
- Tool proficiency needed to operate the chosen siege or vehicle implement.
- A +2 bonus if already proficient.

This Insight represents formal training and certification rather than Path chassis proficiency.

When using an authorized item, gain Advantage on checks to inspect, maintain, requisition, safely store, or identify sabotage affecting it.

insight.imperial-examination-laureate.name: Imperial Examination Laureate
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Imperial Academy Graduate, successful examination or equivalent recorded recognition, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one Sphere listed in the academy curriculum tied to your examination record and for which you possess recorded legal access.

Learn that Sphere and gain its normal free first talent under the universal new-Sphere rule.

In addition:

- training time for talents listed in that curriculum is reduced by 25 percent;
- gain Advantage on checks to obtain legal manuals, teachers, archives, and licenses from officials recognizing your rank; and
- once per CL, one training attempt for a listed talent may be retried after half the normal failed-training delay.

Rank does not waive Secret access, inheritance requirements, sect exclusivity, or political obligations.

insight.imperial-officer-s-circulation.name: Imperial Officer's Circulation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Military, guard, administrative, or command training, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When Initiative is rolled, choose one ally within 30 feet.

That ally gains +2 to its Initiative result for the scene. This may change order immediately.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** An ally within 30 feet fails a saving throw.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi

Add your Proficiency Bonus to the saving throw, potentially turning failure into success.

This is not saving throw proficiency and cannot modify death, breakthrough, or training rolls.

If the save succeeds after this bonus, move the ally 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks or allow it to stand from Prone.

---

Once per scene, you may use Swaying Guard even when your Speed is 0.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Dexterity score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL for Ink talents used through this Insight.

You may learn the Ink Sphere through the Inked Body variant. Use Constitution as its key ability and Stamina for its Cultivation Point costs. If this is a new Sphere, gain the normal free talent.

Your body is a legal writing surface, but every Ink talent still requires its printed mark, medium, action, duration, visibility, and removal procedure. Injury to inscribed anatomy follows Body Refining Shared Procedures R1.

insight.inner-vessel-discipline.name: Inner Vessel Discipline
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions Sphere, Body Refining

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** The Source CL of the Hosted spirit expression, using Body Refining CL only where the expression is expressly used through your body.

Choose one spirit currently joined to you through a legal Hosting Bond and record it as your **Inner Vessel spirit**.

When you use one of that spirit's body-bound Nature Expressions, you may use Constitution as the expression's key ability. The expression must be self-only, touch-only, weapon-bound, blood-bound, body-bound, or modify your natural weapons, anatomy, movement, senses, skin, blood, breath, organs, or embodied cultivation.

This Insight does not authorize external projection, create an additional action, or let Constitution replace the spirit's own ability when it acts independently.

You may designate a different legally Hosted spirit after a Full Cultivation Session and recording the new Hosting terms, or immediately when the previous Hosting Bond ends and a new legal Hosting Bond is formed.

insight.internal-weapon-scripture.name: Internal Weapon Scripture
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

Choose one printed weapon group or one recorded bodily-weapon tradition. You may use Constitution instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with a weapon in that group or tradition.

At CL5, those attacks count as magical and cultivation-powered for overcoming ordinary Resistance. At CL17, Heavenly Fist also causes them to count as adamantine and grants its other printed benefits.

This Insight grants no weapon Proficiency, Sphere, extra attack, reach, or damage die. If the selected group is too broad to identify mechanically, record the exact weapons included when the Insight is gained.

insight.internalized-sphere-insight.name: Internalized Sphere Insight
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining, access to one Power Sphere, CL4+

**Repeatable:** Multiple; choose a different Power Sphere each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL for the chosen internalized Sphere.

Choose one Power Sphere to which you have legal access. You may learn and use that Sphere through Body Refining, using Constitution as its key ability and Stamina as its Cultivation Point resource.

Record the bodily medium through which the Sphere functions: anatomy, breath, blood, marrow, organ furnace, scars, natural weapon, integrated weapon, or another explicit bodily structure. The Sphere uses Body Refining Source CL when used through this Insight.

If this is a new Sphere for you, gain the normal free talent granted whenever a character learns a new Sphere. This Insight does not grant every talent, waive Secret or inherited access, remove printed costs or actions, or authorize external projection beyond the Sphere and Body Refining rules.

insight.iron-blood-circulation.name: Iron-Blood Circulation

effects.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against Bleeding, Poison, Disease, and Exhaustion caused by physical injury.

riders: GM: After at least 10 uninterrupted minutes of breathing, pressure-point work, bandaging or medicinal circulation, regain Hit Points equal to 2 times your Proficiency Bonus, once between Full Cultivation Sessions. It does not remove an Injury, restore missing anatomy or replace required treatment.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

You have Advantage on saving throws against Bleeding, Poison, Disease, and Exhaustion caused by physical injury.

You can benefit from this procedure once between Full Cultivation Sessions. It does not remove an Injury, restore missing anatomy, or replace required treatment.

insight.iron-captain.name: Iron Captain
description:
**Prerequisite:** Warleader sphere, Shieldbrothers or Ironclad Line, CL 8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Charisma, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When a Commanded ally adjacent to another Commanded ally is hit by a critical hit, spend 1 Momentum Mark.

The attack is treated as a normal hit instead of a critical hit.

Use Iron Captain once per scene.

insight.iron-mercy.name: Iron Mercy
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Life Sphere and Body Refining

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Life Source CL for Empathic Transfer; Body Refining Source CL for the temporary bodily buffer.

When you use Empathic Transfer and legally accept an affliction, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus` after the transfer resolves.

Record the transferred affliction. These Temporary Hit Points can absorb only damage or Hit Point loss caused directly by that recorded affliction. They cannot absorb unrelated attacks, costs, maximum-Hit-Point loss, or a different affliction, and expire when the recorded affliction ends.

It gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, has Advantage on checks or saving throws against being destroyed or Disarmed, and counts as Wood or Metal, chosen when this Insight is gained, for relevant Sphere and material interactions.

Choose one durable inscription you create. It may store two charges instead of one.

When its normal recovery procedure would restore charges:

- It restores one charge.
- A Full Cultivation Session performed while touching it restores all missing charges.

A second charge does not duplicate a consumed material, permanent sacrifice, or irreplaceable item component.

insight.karmic-ledger-within-the-core.name: Karmic Ledger Within the Core
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Karma-Thread Cultivator, Oath-Ledger Cultivator with Karma access, or genuine Karma Secret authority; CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You may hold Karmic Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Gain one Mark when a creature you can perceive during a qualifying scene:

- Directly harms you or an ally.
- Saves your life.
- Breaks an oath to you.
- Pays a genuine debt.
- Accepts a major sacrifice from you.

The event must carry actual consequence; staged exchanges and closed loops do not qualify.

Spend one Mark when interacting with that creature to choose one:

- Add `2d8` damage or healing to one result.
- Move it or an ally 10 feet through causal redirection.
- Add or subtract `1d4` from one saving throw.
- Reveal the direction of the creature on the same plane.
- Force an immediate Cultivation Check against one concealed oath, debt, or Karmic bond.

Marks persist until settled, purified, transferred, or consumed.

---

insight.keeper-of-the-funeral-wick.name: Keeper of the Funeral Wick
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Wax sphere or Spirit Awakening

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have Advantage on checks concerning funeral etiquette, respectful corpse handling, disturbed remains, funerary wax, and preservation of final messages or identifying signs.

### Funeral Wick

**Action Type:** Reaction  
**Trigger:** A creature you can perceive dies within 30 feet  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Create one harmless funeral candle in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the corpse or remains. The candle lasts for 1 hour and records one **Final Impression** that was perceptible at death. Choose one:

- visible name, seal, crest, or written mark;
- handprint, footprint, blood pattern, or weapon grip;
- last visible breath, gesture, expression, or direction of attention;
- one symbolic spiritual image produced by the dying creature's own soul-pattern; or
- one brief final sound of no more than six words that the creature actually uttered.

The candle is a Tiny Spirit Asset with AC 10 and 1 Hit Point. It emits dim light for 5 feet. Destroying it ends the record.

A Final Impression is evidence, not a Soul Fragment or Complete Soul. It cannot answer questions, reveal unperceived thoughts, repeat an activation, serve as a resurrection substitute, or be compelled as the dead creature.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, Foundation Realm

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You refine your internal circulation until little qi escapes into the surrounding world.

As a Bonus Action, conceal the obvious signs of your Qi Cultivation. Until the concealment ends, ordinary spiritual perception cannot automatically identify you as a Qi Cultivator or determine your Realm from qi leakage. A creature that actively examines you must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Insight) check against your Cultivation Save DC.

The concealment becomes suppressed until the start of your next turn when you spend Qi, activate a Qi Cultivation feature, create a Field or Formation, deliberately flare your meridians, or sustain a visible elemental manifestation. You may end the concealment at any time.

This does not conceal a manifested technique, suppress environmental consequences, or defeat higher-authority detection.

Choose one willing cultivator as your Dao Companion. Both characters must record the bond.

While you remain within 30 feet of one another, both of you gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws. A character can benefit from only one Dao Companion bond at a time.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, as an Action, one Dao Companion may transfer Cultivation Points from one active Path pool to an active compatible pool belonging to the other. Betrayal, death, or spiritual severance does not erase the bond automatically. Record the event and use the normal Bond, recovery, resurrection, or restitution rules to determine whether the bond is repaired, transformed, or ended.

insight.legacy-dual-cultivation.name: Dual Cultivation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL4+ and one willing cultivator who also knows Dual Cultivation or has a compatible paired-cultivation method

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have learned a paired practice that harmonizes your cultivation with another willing cultivator.

When you and one eligible partner complete the same 2-hour Full Cultivation Session together:

- both participants restore their Path resources normally;
- both participants may exchange emotional impressions, visions, or spiritual insights by mutual consent;
- each participant may transfer Cultivation Points from one of their active Path pools to the other, up to the transferring character's Proficiency Bonus; and
- each participant gains Advantage on one Cultivation Check made as part of that session or during the next 24 hours to comprehend a lesson that arose from it.

Transferred Cultivation Points cannot raise a pool above its normal maximum. A participant can benefit from only one use of Dual Cultivation between Full Cultivation Sessions.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL8+, legal access to at least one Sphere outside your Path affinities

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one Sphere outside your Path's listed affinities for which you have recorded legal access.

For you, that Sphere counts as Path-affiliated when a rule asks whether a Sphere fits your Path. This classification does not waive Secret, Forbidden, lineage, initiation, ethical, teacher, manual, or other access requirements.

After you legally learn the Sphere's base ability, you may train its non-Secret talents through personal practice without requiring a separate teacher or scripture, provided you still meet every prerequisite and pay all normal time and material costs.

If selected twice, choose a different Sphere each time.

This does not grant an extra command, action, turn, or attack to a sword whose Source Rule does not already permit an attack. Resolve both attacks as one activation and pay the printed command cost once.

The sword's legal command range increases by 30 feet, to a maximum of 60 feet unless its Source Rule already provides a greater range.

insight.legacy-formation-breaker.name: Formation Breaker (Legacy Restored)
riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You understand how Formations circulate power and where they fail.

You have Advantage on saving throws against Formation effects, supernatural traps, spiritual barriers, and wards whose Source CL is no higher than yours.

After studying a visible Formation for 1 minute, make an Intelligence or Wisdom Cultivation Check against the Formation's save DC. On a success, choose one:

- identify its printed purpose;
- locate the nearest visible or detectable Anchor;
- identify its primary damage type or controlling Sphere;
- gain a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus on the next check you make within 10 minutes to disable, escape, or breach it.

A higher-authority or Secret Formation may reveal only the category of its authority and the next legal investigation step.

insight.legacy-immortal-dreamer.name: Immortal Dreamer
riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each 7-day downtime period, you may enter a deep dream-trance for at least 2 uninterrupted hours. Choose one benefit:

- gain Advantage on your next three Cultivation Checks made within 7 days;
- receive one symbolic vision about a current danger or unresolved mystery, framed through information your character could plausibly reach through dream, omen, memory, or spirit contact;
- treat one technique you have personally witnessed as a valid training source for 7 days; or
- frame one question about your developing Dao and receive a symbolic answer that identifies a concrete theme, conflict, cost, or training direction without revealing hidden statistics or overriding a Secret authority.

You may hold only one unused Immortal Dreamer benefit at a time.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Receive life-saving aid from a powerful cultivator, spirit, or immortal

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when you fail a saving throw or Cultivation Check, you may turn that failure into a success.

Each use creates one recorded Karmic Debt owed to the being that granted this Insight. Record the creditor, the event, and one service category: protection, recovery, information, transport, restitution, or aid against a named enemy.

A creditor may call in one recorded debt during a meaningful scene. Fulfilling the agreed service clears that debt. Refusing a lawful demand does not retroactively undo the success, but the unresolved debt remains and may become a Bond, oath, or Karma complication through normal story rules.

insight.legacy-meridian-sight.name: Meridian Sight
riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

As an Action, choose one creature you can perceive within 60 feet and make a Wisdom (Insight) check against its Cultivation Save DC. A willing creature may allow the reading without a check.

On a success, learn:

- whether each visible Path-resource pool is full, above half, below half, or empty;
- whether the target is suffering from an ordinary curse, poison, disease, possession, meridian disruption, spiritual intrusion, or comparable printed affliction; and
- whether the target completed a breakthrough or survived a Tribulation within the last 7 days.

This never reveals exact resource totals, complete features, hidden contracts, Secret authority, or information blocked by a higher-authority concealment.

You may use Meridian Sight a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you complete a Full Cultivation Session.

insight.legacy-quiet-foundation.name: Quiet Foundation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Your cultivation remains stable in adverse conditions.

You have Advantage on Cultivation Checks made to complete meditation, circulation, or spiritual integration in a cursed, spiritually thin, storm-wracked, recently contested, polluted, or otherwise hostile environment.

When a location would normally prevent a Full Cultivation Session but is not completely devoid of usable cultivation authority, you may attempt a DC 15 Cultivation Check after 2 uninterrupted hours. On a success, recover half the missing Cultivation Points in each active Path pool, rounded down.

After you use this recovery, you cannot use it again until you complete a normal Full Cultivation Session in a suitable environment. It never functions during Initiative.

insight.legacy-quiet-furnace-method.name: Quiet Furnace Method
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining, Foundation Realm

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You can draw your breath, pulse, body heat, blood flow, and embodied vitality inward.

As a Bonus Action, conceal the obvious signs of your Body Refining cultivation. Until the concealment ends, ordinary spiritual perception cannot automatically identify you as a Body Refiner or determine your Realm from your bodily presence. A creature that actively examines you must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Insight) check against your Cultivation Save DC.

The concealment becomes suppressed until the start of your next turn when you spend Stamina, activate a Body Refining feature, deliberately unveil your strength, or enter a printed bodily transformation. You may end the concealment at any time.

This does not make you Invisible, suppress physical evidence, defeat higher-authority detection, or conceal an effect after it visibly manifests.
