insight.legacy-stable-meridians.name: Stable Meridians
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Technique Forging access

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you fail a Technique-Forging Check by 5 or more, reduce the resulting severe failure consequence by one step:

- a catastrophic or permanent consequence becomes a serious but recoverable Injury, deviation, Asset loss, or project setback;
- a serious consequence becomes temporary CP strain, ordinary damage, one level of Exhaustion, or loss of half the remaining materials; or
- a minor consequence becomes loss of the action or current work period only.

Stable Meridians does not change the failed check into a success, restore spent materials, remove an explicitly unavoidable price, or reduce a consequence imposed by a Secret or higher-authority source.

insight.legacy-sword-riding-flight.name: Sword-Riding Flight
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, a sword-form Domain Armament or another cultivated sword capable of remote movement, CL9+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Outside Initiative, you may ride your qualifying cultivated sword.

Entering or ending the riding state requires a Bonus Action. While riding:

- you gain a flying Speed of 40 feet and may hover;
- the sword cannot make its own attacks or act as an independent origin;
- carrying one additional willing creature reduces the Speed to 20 feet; and
- if the sword is suppressed, dismissed, disarmed, or unable to support you, you fall normally.

At CL15, the flying Speed becomes 60 feet.

insight.legacy-treasure-sense.name: Treasure Sense
riders:
**Prerequisite:** CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

As an Action, open your senses for 1 minute. During that time, you know the approximate direction of exposed spiritually significant objects within 60 feet, including spirit stones, pills, jade tablets, talismans, cultivated weapons, Formation Anchors, beast cores, and cursed relics.

You learn direction and broad category, not exact location, identity, value, owner, complete properties, or whether an object is safe. Total cover, sealed containers, concealment Formations, and higher-authority wards can block the sense.

You may use Treasure Sense a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you complete a Full Cultivation Session.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Awakening, Foundation Realm

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You draw your spiritual presence inward until your soul burns like a lantern behind shutters.

As a Bonus Action, conceal the obvious signs of your Spirit Awakening. Until the concealment ends, ordinary spiritual perception cannot automatically identify you as a Spirit Awakener or determine your Realm from your soul pressure. A creature that actively examines you must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Insight) check against your Cultivation Save DC.

The concealment becomes suppressed until the start of your next turn when you spend Resonance, activate a Spirit Awakening feature, manifest a spirit effect, deliberately unveil your soul, or allow a bound spirit to express power through you. You may end the concealment at any time.

This does not hide a Resonance Mark already perceived, conceal a manifested spirit, or defeat higher-authority detection.

insight.legacy-walking-the-ten-thousand-.name: Walking the Ten-Thousand-Li Circuit
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Foundation Realm

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You may complete a Full Cultivation Session while traveling on foot at a steady overland pace, including walking, jogging, or sustained running.

While cultivating this way:

- you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and your Passive Perception is reduced by 5;
- you cannot stand watch, navigate, track, forage, conceal tracks, or perform another travel task;
- combat movement and the Dash action do not count toward the required time; and
- the session immediately fails if Initiative begins, you take damage, make a saving throw against a hazard, activate a cultivation feature, perform another strenuous task, or leave the rhythm for more than a brief interruption.

If Initiative begins, you also cannot take Reactions until the start of your first turn. The Insight does not reduce the normal time or environmental requirements of a Full Cultivation Session.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when you succeed on Counter-Mandate by 5 or more, you may immediately place a matching opposite Mandate without spending additional CP.
notes: The ability increase is applied at level selection. A fight-local receipt prevents repeating a confirmed free opposite in that fight; it does not enforce or reset the between-Full-Cultivation-Sessions limit, retained explicitly as a rider.

When a creature carrying one of your Debt Imprints creates another Debt Cause, you may move one Debt Imprint from another creature within 60 feet onto it. The receiving creature cannot exceed your normal Imprint maximum.

Once you use this Insight, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
notes: The ability score increase is chosen during character advancement.

insight.meridian-breath-discipline.name: Meridian-Breath Discipline
riders: You can hold your breath for 1 hour. The one-hour reserve is not yet applied to a general breath-holding clock.
description:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws caused by suffocation, smoke, altitude, inhaled hazards, or environmental pressure, and you can hold your breath for 1 hour.

**Breath Recovery — Once per scene.** Immediately after you use Stomping Step and its movement or Disengage benefit resolves, regain 1 Stamina, not above your maximum. An invalid or prevented Stomping Step does not trigger this recovery.

insight.meridian-economy.name: Meridian Economy
description:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, after a Qi-powered feature resolves successfully and you actually paid at least 2 Qi for that activation, regain 1 Qi.

Meridian Economy:

- Resolves after the complete feature.
- Does not reduce the feature's cost.
- Does not trigger from refunded Qi.
- Does not trigger when the final amount actually paid was 0 or 1 Qi.
- Cannot trigger itself or create a closed refund loop.
- Functions alongside Golden Core Efficiency because it is recovery rather than a cost reduction.

---

insight.meridian-fortress.name: Meridian Fortress
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain Advantage on saving throws and Cultivation Checks against:

- Qi drain.
- Maximum-Qi reduction.
- Meridian sealing.
- Forced cost increases.
- Cultivation Point theft.
- Effects preventing Qi recovery.

Once per round, when a hostile effect would reduce your current Qi or maximum Qi, reduce that loss by your Proficiency Bonus.

If you possess Stable Golden Core, add this reduction to Stable Golden Core's reduction. This is an explicit stacking exception.

Meridian Fortress does not reduce Qi you willingly spend or sacrifice.

---

insight.meridian-lightning-physician.name: Meridian Lightning Physician
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Lightning sphere, Medicine proficiency, Life sphere or Pressure Points sphere, CL 8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You can use carefully measured Lightning Qi to restart, test, or interrupt bodily channels.

During a 10-minute recovery procedure, you may treat one willing creature. The creature may immediately repeat one saving throw against paralysis, Speed reduction, or a meridian-blocking effect that allows repeated saves.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when a willing creature within 5 feet fails a death saving throw, you may use your Reaction to apply a harmless shock. The creature rerolls the death saving throw and must use the new result.

This Insight does not restore HP unless another feature says so.

insight.meridian-overchannel.name: Meridian Overchannel
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when a Qi-powered feature deals damage or restores Hit Points, spend additional Qi up to your Proficiency Bonus.

Add `1d8` to one damage or healing roll for each additional Qi spent.

For every Qi spent beyond the first 2, take `1d8` Force strain after the feature resolves.

Force strain from this Insight:

- Cannot be reduced.
- Cannot be prevented.
- Cannot be redirected.
- Cannot be converted into another damage type.
- Cannot generate Qi, charges, Temporary Hit Points, or retaliatory effects.

Meridian Overchannel adds dice to one roll, not once per target, projectile, attack, or healing recipient.

This is temporary functional impairment, not anatomical severance or a lasting Injury. A creature immune to the underlying Joint Lock remains immune.

it still cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn;

reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn;

learn whether Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution is its weakest saving throw.

Once per scene, when a creature fails against Meridian-Sealing Palm, extend one chosen seal until the end of your next turn.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Weapons sphere, CL 8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once per round, when you switch from one legal weapon to another legal weapon before making an attack, you may carry one non-damaging Weapon Method benefit from the first weapon's posture into the next attack.

The carried benefit must be defensive, positional, disarming, hooking, measuring, concealing, or setup-based. It cannot add extra damage dice unless a talent explicitly says so.

insight.might-sphere-discipline.name: Might-Sphere Discipline
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Recorded legal access to one Might Sphere, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one Might Sphere identified by your access record. Learn that Sphere and gain its normal free first talent.

For each talent from that Sphere, record whether it operates through cultivated Qi or requires transformed anatomy.

A talent recorded as Qi-compatible uses:

- Qi as its Cultivation Point resource;
- your Qi Cultivation key ability; and
- your Qi Cultivation Save DC and Attack Modifier.

This Insight does not grant Body Refining Hit Dice, Body Refining attack progression, Stamina, Body-only external projection, a Body Refining Foundation, or another Body chassis feature.

A talent whose printed premise requires transformed anatomy remains unusable until a Method, Foundation, item, bloodline, or explicit Qi adaptation supplies that anatomy.

insight.mirror-of-frozen-breath.name: Mirror of Frozen Breath
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Ice sphere and either Spirit Awakening or Wisdom 13+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

### Frozen-Breath Mirror

**Action Type:** Bonus Action  
**Target:** One of your Lattice Spaces within 30 feet  
**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn  
**Cost:** 0 CP  
**Limit:** Once per scene

The chosen Lattice Space becomes a temporary **Rime Mirror Surface**. For the duration, you can see and hear from that space as though standing there. While using those senses, you are Blinded and Deafened to your body's senses unless you end the perception at any time.

A creature can identify the mirror as a sensory focus through the normal **Rime Mirror Surface** Study procedure.

If you already know **Rime Mirror Surface**, increase its normal range by 30 feet for you. This range increase applies to every normal activation and is separate from the free once-per-scene use above.

insight.missing-step-technique.name: Missing-Step Technique
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Void Sphere, Void-Touched Cultivator, or Missing-Step inheritance; CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You are targeted by an attack roll or a line, cone, or area whose boundary you can perceive.  
**Cost:** 3 Qi

Teleport up to 15 feet to a visible legal space.

- An attack roll fails if you are no longer a legal target.
- A line, cone, or area affects you only if the destination remains inside it.
- The attacker cannot choose another target for the same attack.

Missing-Step Technique is blocked by spatial locks, sealed Formations, planar boundaries, and effects explicitly preventing Void movement.

When you complete a mission or Duty with witnesses and file a clean report, choose one institution involved. For the next 30 days, you have Advantage on one Sect Check there when requesting a similar mission, asking for related information, or defending the truth of your report.

You may maintain a number of active Mission-Born Reputations equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Once per turn, after your elevation changes by at least 5 feet through voluntary movement, your next unarmed strike before the end of the turn deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Falling involuntarily does not qualify unless you regain control before the attack.

A two-handed melee weapon you wield does not prevent you from climbing, balancing, or moving across fragile surfaces.

A non-heavy melee weapon you wield may be used with your Gravity key ability for attack and damage rolls until the start of your next turn.

One thrown weapon you throw returns to your hand at the end of the turn by curving through a small orbit.

You have Advantage against forced movement.

You have Advantage against being knocked Prone.

You count as one size larger for Grapple and Shove.

You reduce forced movement affecting you by 5 feet.

If you already have Anchor Stance, increase the total reduction by 5 feet.

insight.name-sealing-demon-chain.name: Name-Sealing Demon Chain

insight.named-blade-listener.name: Named Blade Listener
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Sabers sphere, Spirit Awakening, one named saber focus

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

### Blade-Listening Rite

**Action Type:** Cultivation Procedure  
**Time:** 10 uninterrupted minutes while holding or touching your named saber focus  
**Limit:** Once per scene for each named saber

Ask one question concerning a battle, execution, oath, fear, pursuit, wielder, or target connected to the saber within the last 7 days.

The saber answers through one symbolic omen chosen from the following forms:

- **Direction:** toward, away, above, below, encircling, or nowhere.
- **Pressure:** safe, threatened, dominant, wounded, restrained, or absent.
- **Relationship:** hunter, quarry, ally, betrayer, witness, or stranger.
- **Outcome:** victory, escape, capture, death, interruption, or unresolved.
- **Emotion:** duty, fear, hatred, grief, loyalty, or hunger.

The omen must reflect information the saber genuinely witnessed, carried, spiritually recorded, or received through its recognized bond. If it has no qualifying information, the answer is **silent**. A sealed, altered, or higher-authority memory may instead answer **obscured**.

The rite does not provide names, exact locations, complete conversations, hidden statistics, or facts the saber never perceived.

insight.named-treasure-recall.name: Named Treasure Recall
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, one named weapon, shield, instrument, or cultivation implement that recognizes your bond, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You always know the direction of the named treasure while it is on the same plane.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 1 Qi

Call the treasure to a legal free hand or floating Domain Armament position from up to 1 mile away.

The call is supernatural movement and may cross ordinary intervening distance, but it is blocked by:

- A sealed Formation.
- A spatial lock.
- An artifact restraint.
- A higher-authority ownership or control effect.
- A planar boundary.

Once per scene, while holding or controlling the treasure, add your Proficiency Bonus to one failed saving throw, potentially turning it into success.

The item is never duplicated.

---

insight.nascent-soul-externalization.name: Nascent Soul Externalization
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Nascent Soul, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 4 Qi  
**Duration:** 1 minute

Project your Nascent Soul into an unoccupied point within 30 feet.

The projection:

- Is not a separate creature.
- Occupies no space.
- Has Fly Speed 30 feet and Hover.
- Moves up to 30 feet once during each of your turns without using an action.
- May serve as the origin of a non-Self Qi-powered technique once per turn.
- May maintain line of sight for your Domain Armament.
- Reveals your spiritual position to Qi Sensing.

If the projection is struck by an effect that explicitly targets souls, Nascent Souls, or projected cultivation structures, use your statistics and Source CL. On a failed save, take the effect normally and the projection ends.

The projection ends if it moves more than 60 feet from you, you become Unconscious, or it is successfully sealed.

insight.nascent-soul-reserve.name: Nascent Soul Reserve
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Nascent Soul, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Nascent Continuity restores:

`2 × your Proficiency Bonus Qi`

instead of your Proficiency Bonus.

When Nascent Continuity activates, choose one:

- End Charmed or Frightened when its Source CL is no higher than yours.
- End Grappled or Restrained when its Source CL is no higher than yours.
- Move 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
- Gain Advantage on your next Cultivation Attack before the end of your next turn.
- Restore a suppressed Domain Armament to a legal point within 30 feet when the suppressing Source CL is lower than yours.

Against a higher-CL condition, you may immediately repeat its saving throw with Advantage instead of ending it.

insight.nightmare-feaster.name: Nightmare Feaster
riders:
**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** Touch or shared dream connection  
**Target:** One sleeping, unconscious, restrained, willing, or otherwise accessible genuine dreamer

Drain the target's active dream substance.

The target makes a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, its choice, unless willing.

- **Failed Save:** Regain Qi equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The target suffers one Dream Trauma.
- **Successful Save:** Regain 1 Qi. The target wakes and knows an intrusion occurred.

A Dream Trauma imposes one of the following, chosen when harvested:

- `2d8` Psychic damage that cannot be healed until the target completes a Full Cultivation Session devoted to recovery.
- Maximum Hit Points reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until cultivated treatment.
- One level of Exhaustion.
- Loss of one specific recent memory until dream therapy or restoration.
- Disadvantage on the next saving throw against Dreams or Fear.

A creature may suffer a number of Dream Traumas equal to its Proficiency Bonus.

When its Dream Traumas reach that maximum:

- It becomes comatose and cannot wake naturally until at least one Trauma is removed.
- A further failed harvest deals `4d8` Psychic damage and reduces its Hit Point maximum by the same amount.
- If this maximum-Hit-Point reduction reaches its normal Hit Point maximum, the creature dies and its dreaming consciousness is consumed or scattered.

A Dream Trauma is removed by one of the following: a 1-hour dream-therapy procedure that succeeds on a Wisdom (Medicine), Wisdom (Insight), or Cultivation Check against your Qi Cultivation Save DC; Spiritual Exorcism or memory restoration whose Source CL is at least yours; a Full Cultivation Session under a Dreams or Samsara Source Rule whose Source CL is at least yours; or another Source Rule that expressly repairs Dream Trauma.

A self-created dream construct, illusory sleeper, or closed refund loop provides no Qi unless it possesses independent genuine consciousness.

The practice may be called demonic by the Empire or other institutions, but it gains the Daemonic tag only from a separate rule.

---

**Prerequisite:** Space sphere, CL 10+.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Dexterity score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Until the start of your next turn, creatures have Disadvantage on checks made to track your immediate spatial path unless they possess Spatial Awareness, Divination, Stars, or an equivalent sense.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, you may also use Cut the Road Behind You without spending CP.

description:
**Prerequisite:** Karate, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

If you voluntarily move no more than 5 feet during your turn, the first unarmed strike you hit with before the end of that turn deals additional damage equal to your Constitution modifier and grants +1 AC until the start of your next turn.

Forced movement does not count against the 5-foot limit. Teleportation, granted movement, standing from Prone, and other voluntary relocation do count. The damage applies once per turn.

You remove **Body as the Only Bowl** from Stomach Furnace Scripture. You may use Hunger talents at their listed ranges and may learn or use Banquet, external Taste, external Meal, external Secret Hunger, and external Forbidden Hunger options if you otherwise meet every prerequisite.

Every external Hunger effect must visibly originate from breath, blood-steam, stomach thunder, cooking smoke, furnace heat, appetite pressure, thrown food, a prepared dish, a held utensil or weapon, a bite mark, or another recorded body-furnace sign.

This Insight does not grant Qi Cultivation, waive ingredients, remove Appetite Stain, or make external Hunger subtle.

insight.pill-sovereign-s-ledger.name: Pill Sovereign’s Ledger
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Alchemy, CL 12+.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you invest at least 1,000 gp in ingredients during downtime, record one Ledger Credit.

You may hold Ledger Credits equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

When you fail an Alchemy Check, spend one Ledger Credit to reduce the failure margin by 2. If this changes a failure by more than 5 into a failure by 5 or less, create a Broken product instead of losing the ingredients.

Ledger Credits represent extra stabilizers, backup reagents, assistant labor, and redundant furnace preparation. They cannot turn a failed check into a success.

insight.poisoned-meridian-scripture.name: Poisoned-Meridian Scripture
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Poison Cultivator or Poison Sphere, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once per turn when a creature fails a saving throw against your Poison Touch, cultivated poison, or Poison-tagged Qi technique, spend 2 additional Qi to infect one meridian function until the start of your next turn.

Choose one:

- Reduce Speed by an additional 10 feet.
- Prevent Hit Point recovery and Temporary Hit Points.
- Give Disadvantage on the target's next Constitution saving throw.
- Increase the Qi cost of its next feature by 1.
- Prevent Qi recovery.
- Reveal its direction to you while within 1 mile and on the same plane.

Against a target whose Source CL is 6 or more lower than yours, you may spend 4 additional Qi to extend the chosen infection until the scene ends. The target repeats the original poison saving throw at the end of each turn, ending it on a success unless the underlying poison states otherwise.

A higher-authority Venomous Poison feature may convert the temporary infection into an indefinite cultivation poison.

insight.portable-workshop.name: Portable Workshop
riders:
**Prerequisite:** One preparation-based Sphere or Subpath, CL8+  
**Repeatable:** Choose a different workshop type each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one workshop type, such as:

- Alchemical cauldron.
- Talisman desk.
- Formation bench.
- Smithing forge.
- Medical clinic.
- Calligraphy table.
- Inscription frame.
- Culinary station.
- Kiln.

You possess or construct a portable version.

Benefits:

- Setup and breakdown time are halved.
- Routine downtime work may continue during ordinary travel when the environment permits.
- The workshop counts as proper tools for trained procedures.
- It protects ordinary materials from weather and travel damage.

It does not permit major projects while moving, waive rare facilities, or replace a required ley line, furnace, laboratory, spirit spring, or strategic Formation.

**Repeatable:** Choose a different recorded ley-line region each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one province, watershed, mountain chain, city network, or other ley-line region whose boundaries are recorded on a campaign map or regional ledger.

Within that region:

- you know the direction of the nearest major usable ambient-Qi source within 10 miles when one exists;
- a Full Cultivation Session requires 1 hour instead of 2 hours at a healthy local source;
- when Initiative is rolled while directly connected to an active local ley line, regain Qi equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per scene; and
- gain Advantage on checks to identify local Formations, spirit roads, Qi pollution, and regional cultivation traditions.

A damaged, poisoned, sealed, or hostile ley line applies only the benefits permitted by its recorded state.

insight.psychopomp-s-courtesy.name: Psychopomp’s Courtesy
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Death sphere, Spirit Awakening, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use **Soul Funeral** or **Quiet Burial** against a ghost, undead creature, possessing Intruder, or another target those talents legally affect, you may declare **Courtesy** before resolving damage.

If you do:

- the activation deals no damage;
- a target currently possessing an unwilling Host, desecrating remains, or preventing a soul from following its lawful afterlife or reincarnation route has Disadvantage on its saving throw against the activation; and
- if the target fails but remains a Complete Soul, it may communicate one final sentence and ask one brief question before it departs, is expelled, or enters the legal state produced by the talent.

The question does not compel an answer, suspend hostile action beyond the talent's normal resolution, reveal hidden information automatically, or change the target's legal destination.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when one of your puppet vessels is reduced to 0 Hit Points, leave it at 1 Hit Point instead.

insight.qi-devourer.name: Qi Devourer
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When an essence-bearing creature within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points after you damaged it during the current scene, you may consume a portion of its escaping cultivated essence without using an action.

Regain Qi equal to the lower of:

- Your Proficiency Bonus.
- The creature's CL, minimum 1.

You may use Qi Devourer once per round.

A creature yields essence to you once until its life-force, spirit, or cultivation has been fully restored. Repeatedly reviving the same depleted creature does not refresh it unless the restoration effect explicitly rebuilds the consumed essence.

A construct, illusion, projected clone, summoned disposable body, or creature you created solely as a refund engine does not yield essence unless it possesses an independent genuine soul, life-force, or cultivation source.

Qi Devourer can be used on captives, condemned enemies, sacrificial victims, or willing donors when they genuinely possess consumable essence. Such use may be criminal, forbidden, praised, tolerated, or condemned according to the culture involved; it does not automatically gain the Daemonic tag.

---

effects.evidence: Add your Proficiency Bonus to the failed Constitution Concentration save (2 Qi, the Reaction), potentially turning failure into success.

description:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Reaction**

When the attack hits, you may expend Martial Focus to impose Disadvantage on the first Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check made before the end of the next round to locate you by the shot.

When a creature bearing Execution Mark from you drops to 0 HP, teleports, or becomes Invisible before the mark ends, you may regain Martial Focus if it is absent.

In addition, once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when you hit a creature bearing Execution Mark with Headsman's Mandate or Rending Hew, you may reroll one damage die and use either result.

insight.red-sash-pursuer.name: Red Sash Pursuer
description:
**Prerequisite:** Sabers sphere, Red Trail Pursuit

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When Red Trail Pursuit lets you move, increase that movement by 5 feet.

insight.red-seal-authority.name: Red Seal Authority
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Ink sphere, CL 10+.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Effect: When you create a Seal talent, you may mark it with vermilion authority. The first creature that fails a check or saving throw against that Seal takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.

Additional Benefit: You have Advantage on social checks made to present official, sect, bureaucratic, or ritual written authority when your claim is at least partly true.

riders: **Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

Once per turn, immediately after you willingly become Prone, move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks and gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. This movement does not stand you up, requires a legal destination, and does not trigger when another creature or effect knocks you Prone.

This movement does not stand you up, requires a legal destination, and does not trigger when another creature or effect knocks you Prone.

insight.refined-golden-bell.name: Refined Golden Bell
description:
**Prerequisite:** Golden Bell Circulation, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

Whenever you activate Golden Bell Circulation, choose one refinement for that activation. It lasts until that activation ends:

- gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`;
- gain Advantage on all checks and saving throws against forced movement and being knocked Prone;
- gain Resistance to Force damage; or
- reduce the first damage packet applied to you during each round by your Proficiency Bonus.

The last reduction resolves in the normal damage-ordering procedure after percentage modifiers and before other flat reductions unless a rule states otherwise. Reactivating Golden Bell Circulation replaces the selected refinement.

insight.refined-meridian-regulation.name: Refined Meridian Regulation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Meridian Regulation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Meridian Regulation gains a range of 10 feet when used through direct Qi projection, a needle, a medical implement, or your Domain Armament.

You may also target:

- Charmed caused by a poison, drug, disease, bodily parasite, or meridian disturbance.
- Blinded or Deafened caused by smoke, ash, poison, pressure, or a directly impaired organ.
- One ordinary Bleeding effect.
- One temporary meridian blockage.

Against an effect whose Source CL is lower than yours, a successful repeated save also suppresses its ongoing damage until the end of the target's next turn.

This Insight does not allow Meridian Regulation to remove a Curse, Tribulation, Foundation Injury, Hidden Injury, permanent transformation, completed possession, Soul Damage, or conceptual severance unless another Source Rule expressly expands it.

---

insight.refined-natural-weapon.name: Refined Natural Weapon
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining, CL4+

**Repeatable:** Multiple; choose a different bodily weapon each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

Choose one recorded bodily weapon and choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage. That bodily weapon is a natural weapon and may be used for Iron Fist attacks. Record its anatomical structure and whether an Injury to that structure disables it.

Once per turn when you hit with the chosen bodily weapon, choose one:

- deal additional damage of the weapon's selected type equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
- push the target 5 feet;
- prevent the target from taking Reactions until the start of its next turn; or
- gain Advantage on your next Grapple or Shove roll against that target before the end of the current turn.

Choose only one option for one hit. The additional damage is part of the hit and cannot be delivered again by copying the same attack.

insight.refuse-the-forbidden-bowl.name: Refuse the Forbidden Bowl
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Hunger sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Strength, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You gain Advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to resist Forbidden Hunger, daemonic appetite, cursed food, cannibal scriptures, ghost famine, or another effect tagged Hunger, Daemonic, Curse, Possession, or spiritual predation.

If you willingly use a Forbidden Hunger talent on an unwilling creature, this Insight becomes dormant after that activation. Restore it by completing a Full Cultivation Session devoted to restraint and providing food, medicine, restitution, or protection whose ordinary value is at least `10 × your CL` silver pieces to creatures harmed by predatory hunger.

riders:
**Prerequisite:** Domain Armament Link, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When a floating bound weapon delivers a cultivation technique, waive the 1-Qi Remote Technique Origin surcharge once per turn.

At CL15, this free use is separate from Nascent Armament Conduction. You may therefore waive the surcharge for:

- One weapon-delivered remote technique through this Insight.
- One other remote-origin technique through Nascent Armament Conduction.

A single technique still uses one origin unless it expressly permits multiple origins.

description:
**Prerequisite:** Golden Core Reservoir, CL10+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Golden Core Reservoir gains a second use during each scene.

When you use it a second time during the same scene:

- Regain the normal amount.
- Gain 1 level of Exhaustion after the Qi is restored.

This Exhaustion:

- Cannot be prevented.
- Cannot be transferred.
- Cannot be removed before the scene ends.

After Golden Core Reservoir becomes Perfected, the second use restores the Perfected amount.

---

insight.restorative-circulation.name: Restorative Circulation
description:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when a Qi-powered feature restores Hit Points to one or more creatures, choose one recipient.

Increase the healing it receives by your Proficiency Bonus.

If the target is already at maximum Hit Points after the healing, it instead gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

At CL12, when the chosen target is at 0 Hit Points, increase the healing by `2 × your Proficiency Bonus` instead.

Restorative Circulation applies once per activation, not once per healing die, target, pulse, or repeated tick.

---

insight.restricted-sphere-license.name: Restricted Sphere License
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Imperial, sectarian, hereditary, professional, or equivalent authorization; CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one Restricted Sphere to which the license grants access.

Learn the Sphere and its normal free first talent if the authorization includes instruction. If it grants legal use only, this Insight instead grants access to training.

Once per scene, gain Advantage on one check involving the licensed Sphere's:

- Learning.
- Research.
- Identification.
- Stabilization.
- Repair.
- Countering.
- Legal deployment.

The license provides its recorded social and legal benefits but may impose reporting, service, inspection, or geographic restrictions.

---

description:
**Prerequisite:** Jujutsu, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

**Returning Tide — Once per scene:** Immediately after you successfully redirect or throw a hostile creature through a Jujutsu feature, regain 1 Stamina, move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and gain Advantage on the next Grapple roll you make before the end of your next turn.

Resolve the throw or redirection first. Movement requires a legal destination.

insight.ricochet-savant.name: Ricochet Savant
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Bouncing Shot, CL 6+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When using Bouncing Shot, you may choose the bounced surface after making the attack roll but before knowing whether the attack hits.

Once per scene, if a Bouncing Shot misses, you may make a Scoot Shot against one unattended Tiny object within 10 feet of the missed target.

insight.river-without-edges.name: River Without Edges
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Flowing River sphere, CL10+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When Flowing Response grants movement, you may cross liquid surfaces, loose rubble, narrow branches, collapsing terrain, or a hostile creature's occupied space as Difficult Terrain if there is a continuous physical path no wider than your normal reach from one supporting surface to the next.

You do not need the surface to support your full weight during this movement, but you must end in a legal space that can support you. This is not flight, teleportation, or general water walking outside movement granted by Flowing Response.

description:
**Prerequisite:** Earth sphere, one Settlement talent, CL 6+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Strength, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you create a wall, road, ramp, shelter, ridge, or seal with an Earth talent, choose one:

increase its Hit Points by your Cultivation Level;

increase its duration by one step, from 1 minute to 10 minutes, 10 minutes to 1 hour, or 1 hour to 24 hours;

create one additional 5-foot section or space.

Use this Insight once per scene.

insight.ruin-pearl-handler.name: Ruin Pearl Handler
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Destruction sphere, Calamity Pearl

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have Advantage on checks made to conceal, place, throw, sling, recover, or safely disarm your own Sealed Pearls.

When a creature attempts to identify one of your Sealed Pearls before it triggers, the DC increases by 2.

insight.ruin-safe-grip.name: Ruin-Safe Grip
description:
**Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, CL 4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When an External Channel would gain its first Crack from your Unmaking talent, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, it does not gain that Crack.

At CL 10, this succeeds on a 4, 5, or 6.

insight.ruin-without-hatred.name: Ruin Without Hatred
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, Spirit Awakening, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When an Unmaking talent damages a possessed creature, bound spirit, cursed victim, puppet vessel, controlled summon, or another target joined to a hostile controlling link, you may direct that activation's **extra Ruin damage** at the controlling link instead of the Host, body, or vessel.

Resolve the link as follows:

- If it has Hit Points, Seal layers, Strain, Integrity, or another printed durability track, apply the extra Ruin damage to that track.
- If it has a printed breaking or suppression procedure but no damage track, treat the Ruin delivery as one successful qualifying hit for that procedure.
- If it has neither, after the Unmaking talent resolves, make an Unmaking Cultivation Check against the controlling source's Cultivation Save DC.

On a successful fallback check:

- a temporary ordinary link at least 6 Source CL lower ends;
- a link 3–5 Source CL lower is suppressed for up to 1 minute while you maintain Concentration;
- a link within 2 Source CL is suppressed until the end of the target's next turn; or
- a link 3 or more Source CL higher is not suppressed, but its direction and sustaining Anchor are exposed to your Spiritual Sense until the end of your next turn.

On a failed fallback check, the link remains and the redirected extra Ruin damage does not return to the Host or vessel.

This Insight cannot destroy a Complete Soul, sever a willing stable Covenant Bond without the parties' consent, or bypass a named material, rite, Secret, artifact, divine, or world-law release requirement.

insight.sand-born-footwork.name: Sand-Born Footwork
description:
**Prerequisite:** Sand sphere, CL 4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You gain the following benefits:

Sand Terrain you create is never Difficult Terrain for you.

Once per scene, when a creature misses you with an Opportunity Attack, you may create one Shallow Sand Terrain square in a space adjacent to you.

You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in dusty, sandy, desert, ruin, or dry-earth environments.

insight.scripture-breaker.name: Scripture Breaker
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Ink sphere, CL 8+.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Effect: Gain Advantage on checks made to read magical writing, disable runes, identify seals, remove Ink Marks, break written curses, understand Formation inscriptions, or contest talismanic scripts.

Reaction: Once per scene, when a written magical effect activates within 30 feet, you may use your Reaction to attempt to suppress it. Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC. On a success, the effect is suppressed until the start of your next turn.

insight.seal-breaker.name: Seal Breaker
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Talismans Sphere, Cultivator of Seals, Puzzle Cultivator, Calligraphy Cultivator, or another seal-authorized Source Rule, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain Advantage on Cultivation Checks to detect, identify, weaken, solve, or remove seals.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A visible seal, lock, binding script, or cultivation prison within 60 feet activates.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi

Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

- **Success:** Suppress the activation until the end of the current turn. If the effect requires a target decision, movement, payment, or attack, that portion fails for the turn.
- **Failure:** The effect activates normally, but you learn its Source CL, Anchor direction, and one printed escape or release condition.

Against a seal whose Source CL is 6 or more lower than yours, you may instead break one nonpermanent layer automatically.

maximum Corruption increases to 12;

visible signs of Corruption appear two points later;

once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when you would gain Corruption, reduce the amount by 1.

insight.secret-authority-contention.name: Secret Authority Contention
riders:
**Prerequisite:** One Secret Law, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When one of your Secret effects directly contests another Secret, artifact, Immortal, or conceptual authority, add your Proficiency Bonus to the first Cultivation Check you make in that contest.

If the check still fails, choose one concession instead of total failure when logically possible:

- Reduce the opposing effect's duration by one round.
- Preserve one Anchor from destruction at 1 Hit Point.
- Prevent one permanent consequence from becoming irreversible until the scene ends.
- Learn the opposing authority's exact Source CL and one recovery condition.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks before the consequence resolves.

A concession cannot negate a price already willingly paid or recreate something conceptually erased.

This Insight does not mass-produce permanent magic items, waive materials or maintenance, or grant a Mandate to a creature that does not possess the project or item.

riders:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

activation.trigger: A spirit bonded to you within 30 feet would take damage

riders: If your spirit is Hosted inside your body, first reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus before splitting it. The table does not track a Hosted spirit as a separate creature, so the GM applies this.
If you or the spirit cannot legally be hit by the original damage (another plane, a stronger ward), the transfer fails and the spirit takes it all. The GM rules on this.
description:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Action Type:** Reaction  
**Trigger:** A spirit joined to you by a Covenant Bond, Hosting Bond, Major Spirit Bond, or full Spirit Companion relationship and within 30 feet would take damage

Transfer half of the triggering damage to yourself.

Resolve the transfer in this order:

1. Determine the damage after modifiers that apply to the original damage source but before applying the spirit's Resistance, Immunity, or Vulnerability.
2. If the spirit is Hosted in you, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 0.
3. Divide the remaining damage in half. You receive the smaller half, rounded down; the spirit receives the remainder.
4. Apply your own Resistance, Immunity, and Vulnerability to your share and the spirit's to its share.

The transferred share retains its original damage type and source. It is not a new attack or activation, cannot trigger this Insight again, and cannot be redirected a second time unless a Source Rule expressly permits recursive transfer.

If either recipient is not a legal target for the original damage because of planar separation or a higher-authority ward, the transfer fails and the spirit takes the original damage normally.

**Prerequisite:** Domain Armament capable of Guard Mode, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

A shield or defensive Domain Armament may change its protected creature once per turn without using an action.

**Reaction**

Move the Armament up to 15 feet to a legal point adjacent to that creature and increase its AC against the triggering attack by 2.

The Armament must have a legal path and cannot cross a sealed Formation, spatial lock, or solid barrier.

insight.soul-devouring-scripture.name: Soul-Devouring Scripture
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Devourer, access to a forbidden or predatory manual, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When Qi Devourer consumes essence from a sentient creature, you may take a deeper soul fragment.

If you do:

- regain 4 additional Qi;
- learn one dominant emotion, unresolved oath, major fear, or active spiritual allegiance carried by the victim; and
- the victim suffers **Soul Depletion**.

### Soul Depletion

Until repaired, the victim has Disadvantage on its first saving throw in each scene against possession, dream intrusion, emotional manipulation, or soul damage; cannot yield another soul fragment to you; and displays a visible spiritual wound to Qi Sensing.

Soul Depletion is repaired by one of the following:

- a 1-hour spiritual treatment that succeeds on a Medicine or Cultivation Check against your Qi Cultivation Save DC;
- Spiritual Exorcism whose Source CL is at least yours;
- a Full Cultivation Session performed under a soul-repair Method, Foundation, Spirit, or Samsara Source Rule whose Source CL is at least yours; or
- another Source Rule that expressly repairs Soul Depletion.

This Insight does not trap the complete soul or prevent resurrection unless another higher-authority Source Rule expressly does so.

insight.soul-hearing-listener.name: Soul-Hearing Listener
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Soul-Echo Hearing, Spirit Awakening, CL10+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Charisma, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use **Soul-Echo Hearing**, choose one willing creature whose natural or spiritual voice you have heard within the last day. Establish a **Listening Link** with that creature.

The link lasts until you establish it with another creature, the creature withdraws consent while able to communicate that choice, or a Source Rule severs it.

While the linked creature is within 1 mile and on the same plane, you become aware when its state changes into or out of any of the following:

- **Possessed:** It is under unwilling Possession or coercive Hosting.
- **Silenced:** It is unable to produce its normal voice because of a condition, restraint, injury, Silence effect, or spiritual suppression.
- **Screaming:** It audibly or spiritually cries out because of immediate pain, terror, soul harm,.
- **Fallen:** It is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

You learn the state and the direction of the link, but not exact distance or location.

A ward, Domain, planar boundary, or concealment effect can block the link. If the blocking source has lower Source CL than the higher of your Sound and Spirit Awakening Source CL, you know the link is blocked and its direction immediately before the block. Otherwise, you know only that contact was lost.

The link does not transmit speech, thoughts, ordinary emotions, damage details, or continuous sensory information.

insight.soul-return-witness.name: Soul-Return Witness
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Life sphere, Spirit Awakening

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use **Read the Pulse** on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day, also diagnose the soul's apparent return state. Learn one:

- **Willing:** A Complete Soul appears willing and ordinarily capable of return.
- **Unwilling:** The soul appears to refuse ordinary return.
- **Absent:** No returnable Complete Soul is present or reachable by the examined pattern.
- **Trapped:** A creature, vessel, location, Domain, Spiritual Anchor, or custody effect is restraining the soul.
- **Consumed or Destroyed:** The pattern shows loss beyond ordinary absence; this diagnosis does not itself prove permanent destruction.
- **Blocked:** An authority, reincarnation route, afterlife custody, oath, Secret, artifact, or other effect prevents ordinary return.

If the restraining or blocking source has lower Source CL than the higher of your Life and Spirit Awakening Source CL, also learn whether it is sustained by a creature, vessel, location, Domain, Bond, or Spiritual Anchor.

If the source is within 2 Source CL of you, learn its broad category and whether it is present, distant, or outside the current plane.

If the source is 3 or more Source CL higher, Secret, Immortal, divine, or world-law authority, learn only that a higher authority is involved and whether ordinary return is presently possible.

This Insight does not identify an unknown captor by name, reveal a hidden release condition, return the soul, or establish that reconstruction is possible.

insight.spirit-broker-reputation.name: Spirit-Broker Reputation
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Use the following **Spirit Negotiation Position** ladder:

`Hostile → Unwilling → Wary → Open → Favorable`

When a spirit knows your reputation for keeping spirit covenants, begin its first negotiation with you during a scene one position more favorable than its ordinary starting position, to a maximum of Favorable.

A spirit knows your reputation if one of the following is true:

- it has dealt with you before;
- a spirit, shrine, court, ancestor, broker, sect, or witness it trusts has vouched for you;
- your relevant office, seal, lineage, or public covenant record is recognized in its community.

### Broken Reputation

If you have an unresolved breach of a Covenant Bond, Offering, Taboo, spirit-court judgment, or other recorded spirit agreement, this Insight provides no benefit to spirits that know of that breach.

Restore the benefit for that breach by completing its recorded Restitution. If no Restitution was recorded, complete all three:

1. acknowledge the breach to the harmed spirit or its recognized representative;
2. provide the missed Offering, compensation, service, or release that reasonably repairs the terms; and
3. receive acceptance from the harmed spirit, its lawful successor, or a recognized neutral spirit authority.

This Insight never changes a spirit's consent, core Nature, sworn hostility, or response to an impossible request.

This Insight never changes a spirit's consent, core Nature, sworn hostility, or response to an impossible request.

insight.spirit-instrument.name: Spirit Instrument
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Music sphere, CL 8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Charisma, Wisdom, or Dexterity score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one instrument, bell, drum, trained voice method, weapon expressly built as an instrument, or recorded body-rhythm focus that you possess or can perform.

It becomes spiritually bound to you.

You may summon it to your hand or ready it from within 1 mile as a Bonus Action, unless it is sealed by a stronger effect.

It cannot be damaged by ordinary means while you are conscious.

Once per scene, add +1 to one Music Attack roll or increase your Music Save DC by +1 for one talent before the roll is made.

insight.spotter-s-thread.name: Spotter’s Thread
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Sniper sphere, CL6+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

As a Bonus Action, choose one willing ally you can see or hear. Until the start of your next turn, if that ally can perceive a target and communicate its exact occupied space to you, treat the ally's perception as sufficient for Rangefinding Breath, Star-Scraper Line, or another Sniper talent that requires exact location. Normal range, line of effect, concealment, and cover still apply.

At CL11, the communication may pass through one linked spirit, Formation, paired token, signal flag, or Forged Technique that expressly transmits exact location. The transmitting link must be active, within its printed range, and not suppressed.

A long-term spring still requires project rules for permanent settlement, agriculture, sect infrastructure, or regional drought relief.

description:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

Your Iron Fist attacks may deal Slashing damage.

Once per turn when you hit with an unarmed strike or sword-like weapon, choose one:

- move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
- reduce the target's Speed by 5 feet until the start of its next turn;
- prevent the target from taking Reactions until the start of its next turn; or
- deal additional Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Choose one option for one hit. The additional damage is part of that hit.

insight.sword-line-meridian.name: Sword-Line Meridian

Once per turn, when you voluntarily move at least 10 feet immediately before an unarmed or sword-like attack and hit, deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. After the attack resolves, move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Teleportation does not satisfy the 10-foot movement requirement unless a Source Rule counts it as traveled movement. The post-attack movement requires a legal destination.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Talismans Source CL, using Body Refining CL when paid with Stamina through this Insight.

You may inscribe temporary talismans on your skin, scars, armor, nails, bones, weapon wraps, or clothing seams. A skin talisman takes 1 hour to inscribe, uses normal materials, and remains until activated, destroyed, removed, or you complete your next Full Cultivation Session.

Skin talismans do not count against your Prepared Talisman Limit, but you may maintain no more than your Proficiency Bonus at once. They cannot be transferred to another creature.

When you take damage, you may use your Reaction to activate one skin talisman whose printed activation is a Reaction or defensive response. You may spend Stamina instead of Cultivation Points for that activation. The talisman still obeys all target, trigger, material, and Source CL rules.

This does not increase the number of attacks you make, and it does not allow a hidden or inaccessible weapon to appear from nowhere.

**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, immediately after you spend Qi on a feature that resolves successfully, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

- Travel vertically along a wall.
- Cross an unsupported gap.
- Move across a liquid surface.

You must end on a legal supporting surface unless another feature supports you.

If Circulating Golden Core also triggers, you may use both movements or combine them into one continuous movement.

description:

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

A creature Grappled by you has Disadvantage on checks or saving throws it makes to escape that Grapple.

Once per turn, when a creature fails a roll to escape your Grapple, it takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This damage is attributed to you but is not an attack and cannot trigger itself.

insight.vessel-artisan.name: Vessel Artisan
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have Advantage on checks to prepare, repair, disguise, identify, or reinforce a spirit vessel, shrine, charm, mask, weapon, puppet, reliquary, or Spiritual Anchor.

### Craft Minor Vessel

**Action Type:** Downtime Procedure  
**Time:** 8 hours of work  
**Materials:** ordinary clay, wood, stone, cloth, metal, glass, bone, wax, inked paper, or another material listed in the spirit's Nature record; no rare cultivation material is required

Create one Tiny or Small minor vessel whose material matches at least one tag in the willing minor spirit's Nature record or one Minor Spirit Agreement.

Record:

- the vessel's object type and material;
- the spirit or Nature it is intended to receive;
- its entrance and release procedure;
- one visible or spiritual sign that it is occupied; and
- its ordinary object AC and Hit Points. If no object rule supplies them, use AC 12 and Hit Points equal to `5 + 2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.

The vessel:

- can shelter, transport, conceal, or localize its recorded spirit;
- does not grant a combat body, attack, independent turn, Nature Expression, resistance, or Companion statistics;
- cannot contain an unwilling Complete Soul without a legal Binding source; and
- expels its occupant into the nearest legal state if destroyed, unless another Source Rule governs destruction.

You may repair a minor vessel during 1 hour of work with ordinary materials, restoring all of its Hit Points if its spiritual structure has not been destroyed by a higher-authority effect.

description:
**Prerequisite:** Water sphere, CL 6+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You can stand and move across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground during your turn. If you end your turn on liquid without support, you sink unless another feature sustains you.

While moving across a Water Source, Basin, or Current, your Speed increases by 10 feet.

insight.wax-tempered-body.name: Wax-Tempered Body
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Body Refining or a recorded Wax inheritance, manual, teacher, transformation, or other legal access source

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL or the Source CL of the legal Wax access source.

Your flesh can soften under pressure and set before breaking.

**Yielding Wax — Once per scene:** When you would be Grappled, Restrained, pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone, gain Advantage on the saving throw or ability check made to resist or escape that effect. Declare this before rolling.

If you succeed, you may leave a harmless wax Impression on the creature or object that attempted to restrain or move you. The Impression is visible, has no mechanical effect by itself, and lasts until cleaned, melted, or the scene ends.

insight.weapon-and-technique-weave.name: Weapon-and-Technique Weave
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, proficiency with at least one weapon, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, gain one Weave benefit:

- After you hit with a weapon attack, gain +1 to the next Cultivation Attack you make before the end of your next turn.
- After a creature fails a saving throw against your Qi-powered technique, gain +1 to the next weapon attack you make before the end of your next turn.
- After you activate a Qi-powered technique through a weapon, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target struck or affected.

Only one Weave benefit may be active at a time. Gaining another replaces the previous benefit.

insight.wheel-refuses-the-end.name: Wheel Refuses the End
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Samsara-Wheel Cultivator or reincarnation Secret authority, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you die and your soul remains capable of entering Samsara, create a Samsara Anchor at your place of death.

For the next 1 minute:

- Your soul cannot be involuntarily consumed or redirected by an effect whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- An ally may touch the Anchor and spend an Action to preserve it.
- A resurrection, soul-return, or Samsara feature may originate from the Anchor.

When the Anchor is created, you may return through it with 1 Hit Point at the start of your next turn.

After doing so, mark this Insight **Wheel Exhausted**. It cannot create another returning Anchor until one of the following occurs:

- You complete a successful Realm breakthrough.
- You complete a 7-day reincarnation rite using the rare materials required by your Samsara source.
- You permanently reduce your maximum Qi by your Proficiency Bonus.

A permanent maximum-Qi reduction paid this way can be repaired only by a feature explicitly capable of restoring permanent cultivation sacrifice.

This does not overcome conceptual erasure, a severed Samsara connection, destruction of the soul, or an effect of superior authority without a successful Source CL contest.

---

insight.white-tiger-restraint.name: White Tiger Restraint
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Metal sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Strength, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You gain Advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to resist White Tiger frenzy, execution pressure, forbidden sealing temptation, killing-intent backlash, or another Metal effect that compels needless killing or cruelty.

If you willingly use a Forbidden Metal talent on a helpless unwilling creature, this Insight becomes dormant after that activation. Restore it by completing a Full Cultivation Session devoted to restraint and then sparing, protecting, repairing, or compensating a creature or community harmed by the violation.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

insight.wine-gourd-immortal.name: Wine-Gourd Immortal
riders: Shared Draught: after 10 uninterrupted minutes sharing a ritual drink with a willing creature, regain 1 Stamina, up to your maximum, once per scene.
description:
**Prerequisite:** Drunken Fist, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Body Refining Source CL unless a named Sphere or other Source Rule supplies the effect.

**Shared Draught Procedure.** After 10 uninterrupted minutes sharing wine, tea, medicine, or another ritual drink with at least one willing creature, regain 1 Stamina, not above your maximum. You can benefit from this procedure once per scene. The drink need not be alcoholic and cannot be repeatedly sipped to trigger the recovery.

Once per round, after a creature misses you with an attack, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. This movement requires a legal destination and resolves after the attack.

insight.winter-tempered-body.name: Winter Tempered Body
description:
**Prerequisite:** Ice Sphere and either Body Refining or Constitution 13+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Ice Source CL for Ice effects; Body Refining Source CL for Sure Foot on Winter.

Whenever an Ice feature grants you Temporary Hit Points, increase that grant by your Proficiency Bonus. Apply this increase once per activation, not once per target or round.

**Sure Foot on Winter — Once per scene:** When you would be knocked Prone while standing on ice, snow, or your Frost Lattice, choose not to become Prone. This does not prevent forced movement or damage unless those effects depend entirely on becoming Prone.

insight.world-ringing-bell-keeper.name: World-Ringing Bell Keeper
riders:
**Prerequisite:** Resonant Shatter, CL 10+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Charisma, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You may prepare one large bell, gong, drum, cliff-face, shrine chime, gate bell, or resonant stone during downtime.

While within 1 mile of that prepared object:

Thousand-Pace Call can target it without CP cost once per journey segment;

Sound talents used to defend the site gain +1 to their Save DC;

Read the Vibration can detect major impacts, gate openings, battle, or structural damage affecting the site.

This Insight does not create a permanent Formation by itself.

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.meri.name: Meridian Regulation

effects.evidence: The target immediately repeats the saving throw with Advantage. On success, apply the effect's normal successful-save result.

riders: Meridian Regulation is resolved by the table, one question for both of its printed branches. Choose one of the target's poisons, diseases or physical impairments. If that effect makes the target repeat a saving throw, the target repeats that throw with Advantage, and a successful repeat applies the effect's own successful result. If the effect does not repeat its save, the target makes a Constitution saving throw with Advantage against that effect's printed DC (the number the throw has to beat), and on a success one of that effect's penalties -- Poisoned, a Speed reduction, Disadvantage on attack rolls, Disadvantage on ability checks, Disadvantage on saving throws, or an inability to take Reactions -- stops applying until the end of the target's next turn. Effects of either kind are all offered in the same question, so an effect that repeats its save never hides another effect from the printed choice. The fighter chooses which one.

The effect must be a poison, a disease, or a directly caused physical impairment before either branch is offered, and that is decided from the effect's own ability and its printed text, never from the penalty it happens to leave: a dream, an illusion or a sound that leaves one of the penalties below is still not one of those three. The fight keeps a reviewed list of the printed abilities that can leave such an effect, one entry for each ability with the sentence from the rules that decides it: an entry either places that ability in one of the three, or records that the ability stays the GM's to rule on. An ability that is on neither list is the GM's to rule on as well.

The two printed limits are checked before anything is offered: the effect must have a printed saving throw DC, and it must not carry the Curse, Tribulation, Foundation Injury, Hidden Injury, Possession, Permanent or Soul Damage tag. An effect with no printed DC, or one whose printed text the fight cannot identify, is the GM's to rule on. Disadvantage on attack rolls is also the GM's: the fight does not keep that penalty as a lasting mark of its own, so the GM applies it or waives it by hand.

Meridian Regulation does not automatically remove the underlying effect, end its duration, cure the disease or poison, remove Exhaustion, restore Hit Points, stop ongoing damage, or remove a higher-authority effect.

tianxia.talent.poison.serious_ingrained_.name: Serious Ingrained Toxin Stages

effects.on: the first Cultivation Check it makes each day
effects.evidence: The target has Disadvantage on the first Cultivation Check it makes each day
gain Temporary HP

riders: At the end of each long rest, the target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Success: The poison stage decreases by 1. If it would decrease below Stage 1, the poison ends. Failure: The poison stage increases by 1, to a maximum of Stage 4.
A creature cannot suffer more than one Serious Ingrained Toxin at a time.
Stage 1 - Bitter Channels. The target has Disadvantage on the first Cultivation Check it makes each day, and cannot reduce CP costs below their printed values.

Stage 2 - Numb Meridian Flow. The target's maximum CP is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus, and it has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. This maximum CP reduction ends when the poison ends.

Stage 3 - Foundation Corrosion. The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by your Cultivation Level, and the target regains only half as much CP from short-rest or scene-based recovery. This maximum Hit Point reduction ends when the poison ends.

Stage 4 - Life-Gate Closing. The target cannot regain CP above half its maximum CP, cannot gain Temporary HP, and has Disadvantage on death saving throws. If the target fails three daily saves while at Stage 4, it dies unless the GM decides the poison instead triggers a major cultivation injury, coma, sealed meridians, or story crisis.

tianxia.talent.sabers.secret_saber_manua.name: Secret Saber Manuals
riders: These are four separate Secret manuals. The GM confirms which manual you learned and resolves only that manual with its own cost, duration and use limit. This heading does not activate all four at once.

Secret Saber Manuals are rare battlefield lineages, executioner records, cavalry scriptures, frontier army inheritances, bandit-king scars, or named-blade teachings. They are powerful, but Sabers is not intended to have Lightning-style regional sovereignty by default.

Manual of the Red Gate Charge - Secret, Battleline: Action, Cost 3 CP. Move up to your Speed in a straight or gently curving line. During this movement, you may pass through spaces occupied by hostile creatures, but you cannot end there. Choose up to three creatures whose spaces you passed through or moved adjacent to. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and knocked Prone if Large or smaller. Successful Save: Half damage and not Prone. Use Limit: Once per short or long rest. At Core Formation Realm, the damage increases to 6d8 and you may affect up to five creatures.

Execution Platform Sutra - Secret, Execution: Bonus Action, Duration 1 minute, Cost 5 CP, Use Limit Once per long rest. For the duration, the first time each turn you hit a Guard Pressured, Restrained, Prone, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a Sabers talent, choose one: add 3d8 slashing damage; suppress one non-Secret reaction, parry, guard, or defensive stance until the end of the target's next turn; force a Constitution saving throw; on failure, the target cannot regain HP or CP until the start of your next turn. This sutra does not kill helpless targets automatically. It makes execution mechanically possible under combat rules.

Black Banner Cavalry Dao - Secret, Pursuit, Battleline: Bonus Action, Duration 1 minute, Cost 5 CP, Use Limit Once per long rest. For the duration, when you move at least 20 feet on your turn, your next Sabers hit before the end of that turn deals +2d8 slashing damage and pushes the target 10 feet on a failed Strength save. Once during the duration, when a creature you damaged attempts to move farther away from you, you may use Red Trail Pursuit without spending your Reaction. If you are mounted, your mount also ignores nonmagical difficult terrain created by crowds, mud, grass, shallow water, snow, or loose battlefield debris for the duration. This manual does not grant Horse-Soul, mount intelligence, or warband command.

Tiger-Butcher Short Saber Manual - Secret, Cruel: When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a short saber, duan dao, or butterfly saber, you may spend 2 CP. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It takes 3d8 slashing damage and suffers one Saber Wound. Successful Save: It takes half damage and no Saber Wound. If the target is larger than you, Guard Pressured, or grappled by you or an ally, it has Disadvantage on the save. Use Limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest.
