tianxia.tradition.spirit.ancestral_chann.name: Ancestral Legion

effects.evidence: Manifest three lineage shades as one coordinated Spirit Cultivation Asset

riders: Carry the Message: deliver up to 25 words to a recognized creature, grave, shrine, household or institution, up to 1 mile through a legal route. This is a communication procedure.

Office Expression and Fourth Voice are resolved by hand: Office Expression applies the active borrowed Office from a shade without consuming its normal use. Fourth Voice requires an active Soul Fragment and grants one free Advise, Interpose, or movement.
description: You manifest three lineage shades as one coordinated Spirit Cultivation Asset rather than three independent creatures.
The Legion uses one shared profile:
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL.
- Resistances: Psychic and Necrotic.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.ancestral_chann.name: Council of the Remembered

activation.trigger: When you make an ability check using a skill associated with one of your Ancestor Offices

effects.evidence: Ancestor Offices: At CL3, choose two Ancestor Offices (a third at CL10)
effects.note: a standing free choice of Offices (one button per Office); Favor is a pool of up to Proficiency Bonus, 1 at the start of each scene

riders: Ancestral Advice: when you make an ability check using a skill associated with one of your Ancestor Offices, you may spend 1 Favor (or 1 Resonance if you have no Favor) to gain Advantage, declared after rolling but before the result is announced; if you already have Advantage, add your Proficiency Bonus to the check instead. The GM applies it (the table does not know which skill a combat check uses).

Gaining Favor (a meaningful Office check, protecting what the lineage recognizes, fulfilling a lineage request, accepting a complication for lineage duty): the GM adds it, up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Ask the Lineage: Ritual 10 minutes, Cost 1 Resonance
Lineage Recognition: perceive willing ancestor spirits associated with your lineage within your Spiritual Sense
description: Ask your ancestors one question concerning lineage history, a person or place known to the lineage, an established duty, a burial matter, a repeated danger, or an Office’s field of knowledge.

The answer arrives as memory, dream, scent, gesture, borrowed handwriting, a voice, a remembered route, or a symbolic warning. The answer is truthful according to what the ancestors know, but may be incomplete, biased, outdated, divided among several ancestors, or framed by lineage values.
Ask the Lineage does not reveal facts no ancestor could know, bypass Secret concealment, or guarantee a strategically optimal answer.

You can perceive willing ancestor spirits associated with your lineage within your Spiritual Sense. You know whether a manifested ancestor is accepted, disputed, forgotten, hostile, coerced, or falsely claiming membership, subject to a Cultivation Check against equal or higher concealment.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.ancestral_chann.name: Legacy Made Present
riders: Office Mastery: choose one associated skill from each of your three Offices; gain proficiency in it (Expertise if already proficient; a permanent +1 if you already have Expertise, never more than +1): a character-sheet choice.
description: Choose one of your Ancestor Offices. Until the effect ends:
- You may use Wisdom for its associated skill checks.
- You understand relevant ordinary professional signs, etiquette, jargon, and procedures.
- Archivist: Learn whether one visible spiritual effect or Asset has lower, equal, or higher Source CL than you.
You can maintain only one borrowed Office at a time.

options.label: Borrow the Archivist Office

effects.evidence: Borrowed Office (Archivist): once on each of your turns when you use a Spirit Awakening feature, learn whether one visible spiritual effect or Asset has lower, equal, or higher Source CL than you (the GM answers).

riders: Borrowed Office (Archivist): once on each of your turns when you use a Spirit Awakening feature, learn whether one visible spiritual effect or Asset has lower, equal, or higher Source CL than you (the GM answers).
While borrowed you may use Wisdom for Archivist checks (History and Investigation) and understand its professional signs, etiquette, jargon and procedures (the GM applies it).

options.label: Borrow the Healer Office

riders: While borrowed you may use Wisdom for Healer checks (Medicine and Insight) and understand its professional signs, etiquette, jargon and procedures (the GM applies it).

options.label: Borrow the Magistrate Office

effects.evidence: Borrowed Office (Magistrate): once on each of your turns when you use a Spirit Awakening feature, one creature Resonance Marked by you cannot knowingly speak a direct lie until the start of your next turn; it can remain silent or evade (the GM enforces it).

riders: Borrowed Office (Magistrate): once on each of your turns when you use a Spirit Awakening feature, one creature Resonance Marked by you cannot knowingly speak a direct lie until the start of your next turn; it can remain silent or evade (the GM enforces it).

riders: While borrowed you may use Wisdom for Warrior checks (Athletics and Intimidation) and understand its professional signs, etiquette, jargon and procedures (the GM applies it).

options.label: Borrow the Wayfarer Office

riders: While borrowed you may use Wisdom for Wayfarer checks (Perception and Survival) and understand its professional signs, etiquette, jargon and procedures (the GM applies it).

options.label: Borrow the Ritualist Office

effects.evidence: Borrowed Office (Ritualist): once on each of your turns when you use a Spirit Awakening feature, one ordinary curse, possession, or spiritual contamination revealed by your feature cannot become concealed until the start of your next turn (the GM enforces it).

riders: Borrowed Office (Ritualist): once on each of your turns when you use a Spirit Awakening feature, one ordinary curse, possession, or spiritual contamination revealed by your feature cannot become concealed until the start of your next turn (the GM enforces it).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.ancestral_chann.name: Possession by the Past

activation.trigger: You fail a saving throw, fail an ability check associated with one of your Offices, or are hit by an attack while you can act.

effects.evidence: Remembered Resistance: Reroll the failed saving throw and use the new result. Old Guard: Add your Wisdom modifier to your AC against the triggering attack, potentially turning it into a miss. After resolving the effect, the ancestor's posture lingers until the start of your next turn.

riders: Inherited Method: reroll a failed ability check associated with one of your Offices and use the new result (the GM applies it: the table does not know which skill a combat check uses).

Disputed Possession: if your Soul Anchor is Strained, you violated a lineage taboo during the scene, or two ancestor factions openly disagree, Possession by the Past costs 1 additional Resonance; the first time in a scene, you learn the subject of the dispute (the GM applies it).
description: Choose an Ancestor Office and resolve one effect:
- Inherited Method: Reroll the failed associated ability check and use the new result.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.black_current_w.name: Enter the Black Current

activation.trigger: After you deal damage to a meaningful hostile creature with Mind Spike, a Spirit Awakening technique, an unarmed strike, or a weapon attack with a weapon you are proficient with

effects.evidence: Flow After the Strike (move 10 feet without provoking, 15 through a Resonance Marked target's space; a Soulwake) and Wake Mark

riders: Current Without Footing: during your turn you may move across liquid surfaces, narrow rails, rope, branches, loose rubble, snow, mud, fragile rooftops and vertical surfaces as though they were stable ground; you fall or sink at the end of the turn unless you reach a supporting surface (the GM applies it: the map has no such surfaces).
Flow After the Strike needs a weapon you are proficient with (the table checks your training): an unarmed strike, Mind Spike or another Spirit Awakening technique always qualify.
description: Record the movement as a Soulwake.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.black_current_w.name: No Bank Holds the River

activation.trigger: A Resonance Marked creature within 60 feet moves at least 15 feet, teleports, or is forcibly moved

effects.evidence: Move up to half your Speed by spiritual step toward a legal space within 10 feet of the target's destination ... After arriving, choose one

riders: You gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed and can breathe while your spirit remains connected to your body, including underwater or in spiritual dream-rivers (the GM applies it: the map has no water).
A higher-Source-CL teleportation, boundary, concealment, or route effect can require a Cultivation Check to follow; the ordinary pursuit is automated.

Soul Splitting -- Tributary: your soul fragment can occupy a space in your Soulwake without blocking it; once per turn when you use Flow After the Strike it may move 10 feet along the wake (the table has no Soul Fragment).
description: You gain the following benefits:
After arriving, choose one:
A higher-Source-CL teleportation, boundary, concealment, or route effect can require a Cultivation Check to follow.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.black_current_w.name: Procession of the Black River

riders: Allied Current: creatures of your choice in the Domain can move across liquid and narrow surfaces during their turns (the GM applies it: the map has no such surfaces; moving through allies' spaces is already allowed).
A Secret boundary, execution law, anti-escape Anchor, or higher-Source-CL movement prohibition can contest River Leaves No Corpse Behind (the GM rules it).
description: The aura moves with you and becomes your Black River Domain.
Creatures of your choice in the Domain:
- ignore nonmagical difficult terrain;
Once on each of your turns, choose one:
- exchange the positions of two willing creatures in the Domain;
A Secret boundary, execution law, anti-escape Anchor, or higher-Source-CL movement prohibition can contest this rescue.

activation.trigger: A creature you can perceive targets you with an attack, attempts to Grapple you, or enters a space in your Soulwake

effects.evidence: Move up to 10 feet ... does not provoke; a lost reach/range misses, otherwise +2 AC against the attack; Carry the Reed

riders: Trigger 'attempts to Grapple you': move up to 10 feet without provoking, then the Grapple fails if it no longer has reach, otherwise you have Advantage on the check or save against it (the GM applies it: the Grapple's save has no defender step before its roll).

Trigger 'enters a space in your Soulwake': the creature makes a Wisdom save; failed -- move it 5 feet to another legal space adjacent to the wake and it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; success -- its Speed drops by 10 feet for the rest of the turn (the GM applies it: movement reaches the table only after the whole path).
description: You make the attacker commit to a position you have already abandoned.
Then resolve the trigger:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.boundary_walker.name: Deny Passage

activation.trigger: A creature you can perceive enters, leaves, teleports across, becomes incorporeal through, or spiritually passes through a Threshold Mark or a meaningful threshold within 30 feet

effects.evidence: Mapped threshold crossing and player choices use the printed cost and saving throw.

riders: Deny Passage stops a failed crossing at its previous space and applies Spiritual Pressure. Separating a possessing spirit from its host and special route, artifact, Formation, Domain or higher-authority contests still require the GM.
description: Failed Save: Choose one:
- its movement or teleportation fails, and the spent movement is lost;
- it is returned to the space it occupied immediately before crossing;
It also suffers one Spiritual Pressure effect.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.boundary_walker.name: Gate of No Return

activation.requirement: The target is Resonance Marked by you or currently crossing a meaningful threshold

effects.evidence: Choose one creature. It makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: Gate of No Return (failed Charisma save): the target is exiled into a nearby border-realm -- the GM removes it from the battlefield and places a Gate of No Return Anchor (AC your Cultivation Save DC, 10 x Proficiency Bonus Hit Points, your Int/Wis/Cha save bonuses, Resistance to damage from anyone but the exiled creature) within 30 feet of where it vanished. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and returns after two successes (three if its Source CL is lower than yours) or when the Anchor is destroyed (Advantage on its next save if you are Incapacitated); while exiled it can only attack the Anchor. On its return, place it in the nearest unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of the Anchor; it suffers two different Spiritual Pressure effects until the start of its next turn. (The table has no temporary removal from the battlefield: an off-map primary combatant counts as defeated.)

on_success.evidence: until the end of its next turn it cannot teleport
It also suffers one Spiritual Pressure effect.

riders: Requirement: the target is Resonance Marked by you (automated) or currently crossing a meaningful threshold (not automated: no thresholds on the map).
Successful Save: until the end of its next turn it also cannot become incorporeal, enter a creature or object, or cross planar or spiritual boundaries (the GM applies it).
Permanent Exile Boundary: Gate of No Return does not permanently exile a major enemy, destroy a route, erase a homeland connection, or close a world-scale Gate.
description: The Anchor has:
- Source CL: yours

tianxia.tradition.spirit.boundary_walker.name: Mark the Door

effects.evidence: Mapped threshold crossing and player choices use the printed cost and saving throw.

riders: Mark the Door supports named creatures and explicit creature kinds on mapped thresholds. Lineages, offices, curse categories and higher-authority Source CL contests still require the GM.
description: Place a Threshold Mark. Choose one mode:

Name up to your Wisdom modifier in creatures, lineages, offices, spiritual signatures, or broad categories. Those subjects can cross without triggering hostile Boundary Walker effects from you. This is permission, not compulsion.
Destroying the physical threshold normally destroys its Mark. Destroying only the Mark does not destroy the physical object.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.boundary_walker.name: Threshold Step

activation.trigger: when you move through or begin adjacent to a meaningful threshold

effects.evidence: Mapped threshold crossing and player choices use the printed cost and saving throw.

riders: Threshold Step works with mounted doors, gates and thresholds on the map. Other meaningful thresholds must first be mapped with their crossing boundary.
Threshold Sense: the state of unmapped spiritual routes and protected destination details still require an answer from the GM.
description: - This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Total cover, a sealed wall without an opening, or a threshold whose destination is unknown blocks the step.
While within 60 feet of a meaningful threshold, you know:
- whether it is warded, invited, forbidden, broken, one-way, or attached to another destination;
- whether its controlling Source CL is lower than, equal to, or higher than yours.
Protected destination details can require a Cultivation Check.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.boundary_walker.name: Walk the Border

effects.name: walk_the_border
effects.evidence: Become half-present on the border between locations ... Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

riders: Walk the Border lets you pass through creature spaces as difficult terrain, but you must finish in a free space. Openings narrower than a map square still require the GM.

You can stand on a wall, threshold, bridge edge, shadow boundary or similar border as though it were stable ground; you can perceive and interact with incorporeal spirits and border-realm manifestations as though fully present (the GM applies it).

You have Resistance to Force and Psychic damage caused by teleportation, planar displacement, possession separation or spiritual collision (the GM applies it: the table does not tag damage by those causes).

You cannot pass through a solid wall without a meaningful opening, nor end your turn in an invalid space; if forced to, you are shunted to the nearest legal space and take 4d10 Force damage (the GM applies it).
Threshold Step reaches 30 feet while Walk the Border is active. Border Strike still requires the GM to move its target toward or away from a meaningful threshold.
description: Become half-present on the border between locations.
While active:
- You can stand on a wall, threshold, bridge edge, shadow boundary, or similar border as though it were stable ground.
- You can perceive and interact with incorporeal spirits and border-realm manifestations as though they were fully present.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.name: Candle Against the Dark

activation.trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet of you or your Soul Candle fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw

effects.runs: combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py (the reroll, Temporary HP), combat/ext/candlemaker.py (Burn Bright / Take the Soot)
effects.evidence: The target rerolls the saving throw and must use the new result ... After this reaction resolves, choose one: Burn Bright, Take the Soot

riders: Black-Wax Seal: when the reroll turns a failure into a success you may spend 1 more Resonance: until the end of its next turn ordinary possession, forced soul movement and removal of its soul automatically fail (the GM applies it: the table has no possession).
description: Your Soul Candle can catch a spiritual failure before it becomes final.
After this reaction resolves, choose one:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.name: Funeral Light
description: You can make the Soul Candle reveal what remains and what is trying to remain unlawfully.
- A willing spirit answers honestly according to what it knew in life.
- The rite does not create knowledge the dead never possessed, defeat Secret concealment automatically, or call back a soul that has passed beyond the rite’s authority.

options.label: Vigil of the Departed
riders: Vigil of the Departed: a corpse or free spirit may answer up to three brief questions during the next minute; an unwilling spirit makes a Charisma save or must answer one honestly (a conversation: the GM runs it).

options.label: Funeral Suppression
riders: Funeral Suppression: make a Cultivation Check against a haunt's, possession's, curse's or spiritual contamination's save DC or Source CL; success ends an ordinary lower-Source-CL effect, suppresses a Restricted or equal one for 10 minutes, or one printed expression of a higher one until the end of your next turn; failure tells you its authority category, a recovery route and its anchor (the GM rules it: those effects are not tracked by source authority at the table).

cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn
Consume one Soul-Wick Mark
sustained by Concentration: Disadvantage on the next save to maintain it

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage, and you do not consume the mark

cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn
Consume one Soul-Wick Mark

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.name: Last Flame

activation.trigger: A creature within 30 feet of you or your Soul Candle is reduced to 0 Hit Points, fails a death saving throw, would die from an ordinary instant-death effect, or would have its soul removed from its body
activation.requirement: Your Soul Candle is present and has at least 1 Hit Point

effects.evidence: If reduced to 0 Hit Points, it drops to 1 Hit Point ... cannot benefit from being Hidden or Invisible ... Borrowed Final Breath

riders: Last Flame ignores a failed death saving throw, including both failures from a natural 1 (automated). Ordinary instant death and soul-removal delay, and temporary protection against possession, soul removal and instant death, still require manual resolution.

Borrowed Final Breath: the next time you drop to 0 Hit Points, immediately gain one failed death saving throw (automated). An equal- or higher-Source-CL healing rite, suitable Spiritual Exorcism or a proper funeral-cleansing vigil removes the debt; these recovery procedures remain text.
Secret Laws, divine judgment, artifact execution, tribulation authority and similar require a Cultivation Check or a specific counterprocedure (the GM rules it).
description: Your Soul Candle can preserve a soul at the instant its ordinary future would end.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.name: Thousand-Year Lantern

activation.requirement: A functioning Soul Candle

effects.evidence: The Soul Candle becomes a Thousand-Year Lantern ... Its Asset Hit Points double for the duration.
a 30-foot-radius Spirit Awakening field centered on the candle

inside.name: Thousand-Year Lantern
inside.reading: Advantage on death saving throws and on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws

riders: Allies in the field cannot be possessed or have their souls displaced by ordinary lower-Source-CL effects (the GM applies it).
You may use Spiritual Exorcism once during the activation without spending Resonance if the target is in the field (the GM refunds it).
A creature restored by Last Flame within the field gains Borrowed Final Breath when the protecting field ends (automated).
description: You manifest a lantern containing the remembered flame-patterns of every soul you have lawfully tended.
While the Lantern persists:
- An ordinary lower-Source-CL expression ends.

Last Wick Extinguishes is prepared execution authority, not universal soul erasure. Complete soul destruction, lineage extinction, permanent Method loss, and similar results require a dedicated higher-authority Source Rule or campaign-scale rite.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.name: Wick of the Self

effects.evidence: It makes a Wisdom saving throw

on_fail.evidence: Place one Soul-Wick Mark on the target.

Candle Marking Rite: you learn the target's first applicable sustaining category (bodily vitality, active defense, courage, Concentration, possession, oath, external blessing, companion bond, external anchor) -- the GM tells you.

on_success.evidence: Candle Marking Rite: the target is not marked, but you learn whether its Source CL is lower than, equal to, or higher than yours and whether a stronger effect conceals its soul-flame -- the GM tells you.

riders: A willing creature may fail the save automatically (the GM applies it).

Wicksight (while your Soul Candle is within 60 feet): you know when a creature within 60 feet is possessed, dream-haunted, Resonance Marked, Frightened, Charmed, at 0 Hit Points or concentrating, and whether its soul-flame is stable, faltering, divided, borrowed, concealed or externally sustained (information: the GM answers).

Your Soul Candle (a 1-minute vigil before the fight; 1 Resonance without materials) is a Tiny Asset you hold: AC 12 + Proficiency Bonus, 5 x Proficiency Bonus Hit Points (the Soul Candle pool), resists Psychic and Fire. As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Resonance to move it up to 30 feet to hover in a space you can see (the GM places it; the table measures from you).
description: - You do not automatically learn the source’s identity, exact feature text, secret weakness, remaining resources, or protected information.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.name: All Eyes Open

effects.evidence: a Spirit Awakening field extending 30 feet from you

riders: You cannot be surprised by a spiritually perceptible creature in the field; hostile creatures of your choice have Disadvantage on Deception checks in the field and on saves to maintain ordinary disguises or illusions against your observation; ordinary illusion, disguise and voice mimicry cannot grant Advantage against you (the GM applies these; ordinary invisibility is automated).

A creature bearing your Witness Note cannot teleport, cross a planar boundary or project out of the field without leaving a departure chord that shows its direction and broad method (the GM tells you).

Chorus Assets: three Unopened Eyes (Tiny stationary Assets: AC your Cultivation Save DC, 3 x Proficiency Bonus Hit Points each, immune to Poison and Psychic; each destroyed deals you Proficiency Bonus Psychic damage; all three destroyed end the field); once on each of your turns one Eye can be the origin of Spiritual Sense, Soul Gaze, Hymn of Stillness or Forced Confession (not automated: the table has no stationary spirit Assets).

Closed Testimony (Bonus Action, 2 Resonance): the line between two Eyes becomes a witness barrier until the start of your next turn; a lower-Source-CL creature bearing your Witness Note must succeed on a Charisma save to cross it, or its movement stops and it suffers one Spiritual Pressure effect (not automated: no Eyes, and movement reaches the table only after the whole path).
description: While the field lasts:
Each Eye has:
- Type and Size: Tiny stationary Spirit Cultivation Asset
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.name: Edict of Perfect Witness

activation.requirement: The target bears both your Witness Note and Resonance Mark, or is inside All Eyes Open and has failed against one of your features this scene

effects.evidence: It makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: For up to 1 minute, subject to repeated saves, the target is under Perfect Witness.

on_success.evidence: Until the end of its next turn, it ... cannot benefit from ordinary invisibility against you
two different ordinary Spiritual Pressure effects as one exceptional pressure package
Edict of Perfect Witness (successful save): until the end of its next turn it cannot willingly lie (the GM applies it).

riders: Perfect Witness's restrictions on deliberate lies, concealed possession, oaths, coercion, disguises, hidden Assets and direct commands still need adjudication. Plane shifts, soul projection and sealed-threshold departure also need adjudication; teleporting requires the declaration Action and its chosen destination at the table.
Equal and Higher Authority: a Secret Law, divine silence, artifact mask, identity-defining transformation, or equal- or higher-Source-CL concealment can contest individual bullets (the GM rules it).
Witness Aftermath and Soul Splitting -- Second Witness are story and Soul Fragment effects (the GM applies them).
description: While under Perfect Witness, it cannot willingly:
- speak a deliberate lie;
- benefit from ordinary invisibility, disguise, or illusion against creatures you designate;
- conceal whether it is possessed, oath-bound, coerced, disguised, carrying a hidden spiritual Asset, or acting under a direct command, though exact details may remain protected.

A Secret Law, divine silence, artifact mask, identity-defining transformation, or equal- or higher-Source-CL concealment can contest individual expressions of the Edict. A successful contest suppresses only the disputed bullet, not the entire feature.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.name: Forced Confession

activation.requirement: The target can hear you and bears your Witness Note or Resonance Mark

effects.evidence: The target makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: If the target fails, you may place a new Witness Note on the spoken statement without counting against the once-per-turn limits of another feature.

Forced Confession (failed save): it must speak one emotionally true sentence about the question you chose (fear, protection, service, guilt, intended action, refused desire); it cannot knowingly answer with a falsehood. Protected names, passwords, exact plans, Secret procedures, sealed memories and unknown facts stay protected (it describes the pressure around the secret instead). Confession Echo places its Witness Note automatically when you choose it. For the scene, knowing contradictions to the spoken statement within 300 feet remain a social ruling.

on_success.evidence: Forced Confession (successful save): you learn which broad motive dominates it -- fear, duty, hunger, love, pride, grief, hatred, survival, obedience, or concealment (the GM tells you).

description: You can force an observed contradiction to surface as an emotionally true statement.
- What do you fear will happen next?
- What are you trying to protect?
- Whom or what do you presently serve?
- What guilt or shame is influencing this decision?
- What desire are you refusing to name?
Forced Confession does not automatically reveal:
- protected names;
- passwords or exact tactical plans;
- a Secret Law’s hidden procedure;
- a sealed memory;
- divine or artifact-confined knowledge;
- an identity whose exposure would itself require higher authority.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.name: Hymn of Stillness

target.text: One creature that can hear you or bears your Witness Note

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw

on_fail.evidence: It takes 3d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic damage
it cannot take Reactions
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet
it cannot willingly benefit from ordinary invisibility ... against you

effects.evidence: if Resonance Marked by you, choose one additional ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect

on_fail.evidence: Sustained Refrain

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage
Successful Save: Choose either to reduce its Speed by 10 feet or prevent Reactions until the start of your next turn.

riders: An ordinary disguise cannot help it against you while still (the GM applies it); a lower-Source-CL creature that fails by 5 or more cannot speak a deliberate lie while the Hymn persists (the GM applies it).
description: - On a success, it ends.
- You can sustain only one Hymn of Stillness at a time.

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw

on_fail.evidence: It takes 3d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic damage
it cannot take Reactions
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet
it cannot willingly benefit from ordinary invisibility ... against you

effects.evidence: if Resonance Marked by you, choose one additional ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect

on_fail.evidence: Sustained Refrain

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage
Successful Save: choose either to reduce Speed by 10 feet or prevent Reactions

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw

on_fail.evidence: It takes 3d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic damage
it cannot take Reactions
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet
it cannot willingly benefit from ordinary invisibility ... against you

effects.evidence: if Resonance Marked by you, choose one additional ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect

on_fail.evidence: Sustained Refrain

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage
Successful Save: choose either to reduce Speed by 10 feet or prevent Reactions

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.name: Witness Note

activation.trigger: When you use Spiritual Sense, Soul Gaze, or another legal diagnostic procedure on a creature or effect

effects.evidence: Chorus Recognition: once per turn when a hostile creature bearing your Witness Note becomes Resonance Marked by you, impose Revealed Disturbance

riders: Spiritual Sense or another legal diagnostic procedure can also place a Witness Note (the GM places it; Soul Gaze's variant is automated).

Notations (Face: disguise and ordinary invisibility cannot hide its identity from you within 60 feet; Voice: you know when it contradicts a statement it made while noted; Wound: you know when it gains or loses Hit Points, possession, contamination or a Resonance Mark within 60 feet; Threshold: a note on a place tells you who crosses it within 300 feet) are information: the GM tells you.
description: Choose one Notation:

effects.evidence: you may spend 1 Resonance to place a Witness Note on one observed subject

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.name: Break the Four Directions

activation.requirement: Your Pole is a meaningful hostile creature or hostile Cultivation Asset you can perceive within 60 feet

effects.evidence: Spend one, two, or three different Bearing tokens ... make one cultivation attack against the Pole

description: You collapse completed movement into one decisive martial line.
- do not provoke opportunity attacks from the Pole;
- are one movement created by this activation, not separate movement activations.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.name: Heaven Has No Fixed North

effects.evidence: The aura is your Compass Domain and moves with you.

riders: No Direction of Escape (once during the activation, your Reaction): when a Resonance Marked hostile creature in the Domain teleports, uses conceptual movement, enters a route or crosses the Domain's boundary, a Cultivation Check against its movement's Source Rule can halve it, divert it, keep it in the Domain or let you follow it (the GM runs it: movement reaches the table only after it is done).
Domain Collision: a Domain that fixes direction, seals movement or controls gravity contests by Source CL (the GM rules it).
description: You manifest a battlefield in which orientation follows cultivated intent rather than passive geography.
The aura is your Compass Domain and moves with you.
Make a Cultivation Check against the movement's Source Rule.
- Success: Choose one result:
- It arrives in the nearest legal space still inside the Domain.
- Failure: The movement resolves normally, but you learn its destination direction and whether it crossed Space, Boundary, Time, Formation, Void, or another route authority.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.name: No Fixed Compass

activation.trigger: Once on each of your turns when a Grappled, Restrained, pinned, tethered, or similar effect prevents movement required by your declared Bearing
activation.modifies: Break the Four Directions, Turn the Compass

effects.evidence: Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Nonmagical difficult terrain does not cost you extra movement while completing a Bearing. Break the Restraining Direction.

riders: While completing a declared Bearing you may move across liquid, narrow, unstable and vertical surfaces and open gaps as though they were stable ground, falling at the end of the turn unless supported (the GM applies it: the map has no such surfaces).
Soul Splitting -- Counter-Needle: your Soul Fragment as an origin for Turn the Compass and Break the Four Directions (the table has no Soul Fragment).
description: - Higher authority: On success, suppress only the expression preventing the current movement unless the effect's own rules permit complete escape.
While your Soul Fragment is within 60 feet of your Pole:
- range, line of effect, and movement are measured from the chosen origin;
- you remain the only attacker and mover unless the feature expressly moves the fragment;

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.name: Three-Bearing Footwork

activation.trigger: Once on each of your turns when you complete your declared Bearing

effects.evidence: Pole, Bearings and Bearing tokens; Compass Strike (Approach / Orbit / Depart); No Blind Side to the Soul

riders: A Pole may also be an object, a Cultivation Asset or an Anchor (the GM tracks it; creatures and fixed spaces are automated). While a Pole creature bears your Resonance Mark within 120 feet you know its direction and distance band (information: the GM tells you).

Moving back and forth between the same spaces does not complete a Bearing unless it advances a meaningful hostile objective. The table recognizes damaging your creature Pole with a Martial Strike as progress; the GM adjudicates other objectives. A Martial Strike needs a weapon you are proficient with.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.name: Turn the Compass

activation.trigger: Your Pole within 60 feet targets you or a willing creature you can perceive within 15 feet of you with an attack, Grapple, or single-target hostile technique

effects.evidence: Choose the expression associated with the token spent: Approach -- Intercept the Line; Orbit -- Leave the Attack Facing Empty Air; Depart -- Put Distance Inside the Blow

riders: Turn the Compass against your Pole's Grapple attempt or single-target hostile technique (Advantage on the protected creature's save, or a redirected save for Approach) is the GM's: only attack rolls have a checkpoint before they resolve at the table.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea.name: Dream Eater Ascension

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw ... Failed Save: 10d10 Psychic damage. Choose one Consumption ... Successful Save: half damage, one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect, one Dream Fragment

riders: The consumed content (a recent memory, Long Rest benefits, a proficiency, a technique) and its recovery routes are the GM's; Defining Hope's Disadvantage on saves against Frightened is automated. The Devoured Dream's language, skill or insight and its illusions are the GM's; its Temporary Hit Points are automated.
Hunger's Reflection (after a Full Cultivation Session with the dream held: a Wisdom save or a Dream Intrusion) and Soul Splitting -- Mouth Behind Sleep (no Soul Fragment at the table) are the GM's.
description: - You can reproduce the consumed memory or dream as an illusion or symbolic vision.
Holding a Devoured Dream does not give you the victim’s Path, Sphere, technique, statistics, true identity, or Soul Anchor.
- A Dreams, Spirit, Medicine, Memory, Samsara, Karma, or appropriate Secret-Law procedure that explicitly restores lost memory or identity content.
- Destroying or forcing you to release the Devoured Dream, followed by a Long Rest or Full Cultivation Session.
- Completing the Witnessed Reconstruction procedure in the Procedure Addendum using witnesses, journals, Soul Anchor relationships, dream records, or lived repetition.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea.name: Dream Walker

effects.evidence: An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: Create a Resonance Mark on the dreamer

Dream Walker (failed save): you stand at the dream's outer threshold until the end of your next turn -- you may speak to the dreamer, present one image or memory, learn the dream's dominant emotional tone and whether another intruder, parasite, memory seal or dream curse is present (the GM runs the dream). You cannot deal damage, compel, steal or rewrite through it.

on_success.evidence: Dream Walker (successful save): the dream is closed, warded, lucidly defended, absent, or beyond your authority (the GM tells you which).

riders: Ritual use (up to 10 minutes, a sleeping creature within 1 mile whose broad location you know) and a willing dreamer admitting you: outside the fight (the GM runs it).

Defended Dreams: wards, Spirit or Dreams techniques, trained lucid dreamers, Soul Anchors, spirit companions, equal- or higher-Source-CL souls or creatures that do not dream can block entry or require a Cultivation Check (the GM rules it).

Wakeful Taste: when a creature Resonance Marked by you within 60 feet becomes Frightened or fails a save against Mind Spike, you learn one symbolic fact about its fear or sleep (information: the GM tells you).
description: You enter the dream’s outer threshold. Your body remains where it is, and this is not Astral Projection. You may:
- Speak to the dreamer in symbolic or ordinary language.
- Present one image, sensation, warning, or memory you willingly disclose.
- Learn the dream’s dominant emotional tone.
- Determine whether another dream intruder, nightmare parasite, memory seal, or obvious dream curse is present.
You perceive that the dream is closed, warded, lucidly defended, absent, or beyond your current authority. You do not learn its content.
- A symbolic image associated with its present fear.
- Whether it slept normally during its last long rest.
- Whether a nightmare, dream parasite, or dream-derived memory currently influences it.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea.name: Nightmare Touch

effects.evidence: If the target was sleeping, helpless, Frightened, or already scarred and is meaningful and hostile, gain 1 Dream Morsel
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: It takes 4d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic damage
gains a Nightmare Scar
If it is asleep, it wakes after the damage unless you spend 1 Dream Morsel to keep it asleep

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage and does not gain a Scar.

riders: On a failed save, the target cannot regain Hit Points from sleep or rest until the start of your next turn. Rest recovery occurs outside combat.

Predatory Trace: a creature damaged by Nightmare Touch knows its sleep or fear was attacked; Soul Gaze and dream diagnosis can identify your signature unless you win a Cultivation Check (the GM rules it).
description: You can bite into the spiritual residue of sleep, helplessness, or a marked fear.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea.name: Sleeping Curse

effects.evidence: It makes a Wisdom saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: The creature falls into Cursed Sleep. It is Unconscious, falls Prone if able

on_success.evidence: Drowsy: its Speed is halved
it cannot take Reactions
and it suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect

riders: Cursed Sleep cannot be ended by ordinary noise or an ally's simple action. An adjacent ally can use Wake a cursed sleeper: invoke a bond to grant an immediate repeat save. Spiritual Exorcism, Dreams/Spirit techniques, and a Source CL contest remain separate intervention procedures.

While it sleeps, once on each of your turns you may instead Question it (its dream answers one question symbolically) or Deepen the Scar (its Nightmare Scar cannot be removed by an ordinary long-rest save until after the next scene) -- the GM applies these; Feed and Maintain Stillness are buttons.
Lower-Realm Dominance: a substantially lower-Source-CL ordinary creature that fails cannot wake through ordinary immunity to magical sleep (the GM applies it).
description: You can drag an exhausted or spiritually opened soul into predatory sleep even during battle.
- Question: Ask one question about a fear, dream, or recent emotionally important event. The sleeper’s dream answers symbolically. Protected information can require a Cultivation Check.
- Use Spiritual Exorcism, a Dreams or Spirit technique, or a suitable stimulant or ritual.
- Contest your Source CL with a Cultivation Check to break the curse’s dream connection.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea.name: Stolen Dreams

activation.trigger: A creature bearing your Nightmare Scar fails its save against Mind Spike, Nightmare Touch, Domain Pressure, or another Dream Eater feature

effects.evidence: Trigger: a creature bearing your Nightmare Scar fails its save against Mind Spike, Nightmare Touch, Domain Pressure, or another Dream Eater feature. Cost: 2 Resonance or 1 Dream Morsel. Once per turn. Spend a Stolen Dream: Disadvantage on one attack roll or saving throw it makes against you

riders: The fragment you steal (a recent dream image, a surface fear, a person, place or object tied to safety or danger, an emotional vulnerability, a language fragment, face, route or sensory memory) and protected memories needing a Cultivation Check: the GM tells you.

Spend a Stolen Dream for Advantage on one related Insight, Investigation, Perception, Persuasion, Deception or Survival check, a harmless sensory image for 1 minute, or the direction of what the fragment shows within 1 mile (the GM applies these; confronting the dreamer is automated).
description: You can take usable fragments of fear, longing, and recent dream-memory.
Choose one Dream Fragment to steal:
- A recent dream image.
- A surface fear relevant to the current scene.
- A person, place, or object presently associated with safety or danger.
- One ordinary emotional vulnerability.

Protected memories, sealed secrets, Soul Anchor material, training secrets, plot-critical knowledge, and memories hidden by equal or higher authority require a Cultivation Check. On failure, you learn the category of protection rather than the memory.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea.name: Dream Stitch

activation.trigger: A creature you can perceive within 60 feet makes an attack roll.

effects.evidence: Impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll. If the attack misses, choose one: Resonance Mark or a Dream Thread on the attacker.

riders: Threaded Reverie: Soul Gaze on a creature bearing your Dream Thread learns one more item -- its strongest emotion, whether it is asleep or dreaming, or its fear's dream-symbol (information: the GM tells you).
description: If the attack misses, choose one:
- Create a Dream Thread on the attacker.
- Whether it is asleep, dreaming, affected by a dream intrusion, or maintaining an illusion.
- The symbolic image through which its current fear or desire would appear in a dream.

modifier.precondition: on a creature bearing your Dream Thread

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea.name: Eternal Dream Refuge

activation.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while conscious and your soul is not sealed, possessed, or prevented from dreaming

effects.evidence: Dream Refuge: Stable, Resistance except Psychic and Force, Dream Sleep saves, Refuge Recall, wake after 3 rounds

riders: Refuge Recall's other methods -- invoking a recorded Soul Anchor relationship, a legal healing feature (ordinary healing works), or a Medicine/Insight/Performance/Persuasion check against your Cultivation Save DC while touching you -- are the GM's (speaking your name and a shared event is a button).

The trigger needs your soul not sealed, possessed or prevented from dreaming; an equal- or higher-Source-CL anti-dream effect can break the Refuge (you stay Stable but lose its other protections) -- the GM rules it.
Soul Splitting -- Dream Double (no Soul Fragment at the table).
description: While the Refuge exists:
- You are stable.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea.name: Unreality Bites Back

activation.trigger: A creature within 60 feet succeeds on a check or saving throw made specifically to disbelieve, pierce, escape, suppress, or end one of your dream, illusion, emotional unreality, or Dreamweaver effects.

effects.evidence: The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed: 3d10 Psychic, Resonance Marked, one Spiritual Pressure effect, a Dream Thread. Success: half, a Dream Thread. Dream-Thread Passage.

riders: The trigger also covers a successful check or save to disbelieve, pierce or end your illusions and other dream effects (the GM offers it then; escaping your World of One is automated).
Dream-Thread Passage also lets you perceive the creature through ordinary darkness (the GM applies it; its Hidden and Invisible benefits against you are automated).
description: Your dream-work resists being dismissed as “only an illusion.”
Unreality Bites Back never reverses the triggering success by itself. It punishes spiritual certainty and creates later access.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea.name: Waking Dream Revision

activation.trigger: You, an ally you can perceive, or a creature bearing your Dream Thread within 60 feet completes a d20 Test.

effects.runs: combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py (Rehearse Success), combat/ext/dreamweaver.py (Rehearse Failure, Lucid Resistance)
effects.evidence: Rehearse Success / Rehearse Failure reroll; Lucid Resistance: Advantage on saving throws against sleep, dream intrusion, nightmare effects

riders: Change the Symbol: instead of a reroll, move your Dream Thread from the creature to another within 30 feet of it (a Wisdom save to receive it) -- the GM applies it.

Lucid Resistance: when you succeed on such a save you may spend 1 Resonance to learn the effect's direction, dream-symbol or signature (information: the GM tells you); memory alterations through dreams are the GM's.
description: You can revise a moment by forcing the soul to rehearse a different dream-version of it. This is not Fate alteration; the revision must pass through one of your Dream Threads.
Choose one of the following:

effects.on: the d20 Test
effects.evidence: If the Test was made by you or an ally, reroll it. The new roll must be used

effects.on: the d20 Test
effects.evidence: If the Test was made by a hostile creature bearing your Dream Thread, force it to reroll. The new roll must be used
The new creature makes a Wisdom saving throw, receiving the Thread on a failure

tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea.name: World of One

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw ... Failed Save: drawn into a World of One ... Successful Save: half of 6d10 Psychic damage, one Spiritual Pressure effect, a Dream Thread

riders: The third escape procedure -- destroying the dream Anchor (AC your Cultivation Save DC, 5 x Proficiency Bonus Hit Points) with its own actions inside the dream -- and 'cannot perceive or affect the ordinary battlefield' beyond Incapacitated are the GM's.

Authority and Realm: lower-Source-CL creatures cannot use ordinary sleep immunity or legendary resistance; mindless or dreamless creatures are immune; equal- or higher-Source-CL targets may contest the dream law (the GM rules it).
Domain Integration (origin from your Soul Fragment; no sleep immunity inside your Domain with both marks) is the GM's.
description: You isolate one soul inside a personal dream-world whose symbols obey your cultivated authority.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.name: Chronicle of the Living Soul

effects.evidence: Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures you can perceive. Each becomes a Recorded Soul for the duration.

riders: Living Chronicle: resolve these other Entries and rewrites by hand: an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save and its reroll with Advantage; possession or transformation; a suppressed Soul Anchor or bond; a vow, confession, sacrifice or betrayal; restoring Concentration; and making a confession undeniable spiritual evidence. The game records failed death saving throws and can erase one accrued failure, as well as recording drops to 0 Hit Points and Charmed or Frightened conditions.
Against equal or higher, Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact, tribulation, Foundation, Method, bloodline, true-name or campaign authority, a rewrite needs a Cultivation Check (the GM rules it).

Chronicle Asset: externalized as a Medium Asset (AC your Cultivation Save DC, 8 x Proficiency Bonus Hit Points) you may originate Echo Scribe features from it and Rewrite costs 1 less; not built at the table (kept internal: +1 Resonance per Rewrite, automated).
description: You open a living record in which the next moments become editable before they harden into history.
- loses Concentration;
- has a Soul Anchor, Cultivation Asset, spiritual bond, or companion bond suppressed;
- willingly makes a defining vow, confession, sacrifice, or betrayal.
You can maintain a number of Living Entries equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Recording beyond the maximum erases the oldest Living Entry.
- convert a recorded betrayal, confession, or vow into undeniable spiritual evidence without changing whether it occurred.

Against an ordinary lower-Source-CL effect, the rewrite applies as printed. Against equal or higher, Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact, tribulation, Foundation, Method, bloodline, true-name, reincarnation, or campaign-scale authority, make a Cultivation Check. On failure, the Entry is not consumed, but the rewrite does not occur and you learn one required recovery or counterprocedure.
You may externalize the Chronicle as a Medium Cultivation Asset in an adjacent space:
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.name: Ink Remembers
riders: Ink Remembers (Action, touch, 1 Resonance): touch an object meaningfully involved in an event and receive one sensory echo of its strongest recent use or emotion (sight, sound, touch/force, emotion, or supernatural disturbance), usually from the last seven days; you may record it as an Echo Entry. Cleansing, forgery or concealment can distort it (a Cultivation Check reveals one true fragment). Information: the GM tells you.
description: You can recover the strongest recent echo left on a meaningful object or mark.
Touch a written document, carved inscription, blood mark, footprint, broken weapon, garment, corpse, shrine object, damaged treasure, or another object meaningfully involved in an event.
- sight or visual arrangement;
- sound or spoken emotional tone;
- touch, force, injury, or direction of movement;
- fear, grief, loyalty, anger, desire, or intent;
- spiritual pressure, possession, curse, dream influence, death, or another supernatural disturbance.
The echo usually concerns the most significant event within the previous seven days. Older echoes may remain on treasured, blood-soaked, haunted, consecrated, artifact, or story-significant objects.
You may record the echo as an Echo Entry.

Ink Remembers does not provide complete history, exact statistics, secret mechanics, secure identity, or facts the object did not meaningfully witness. Cleansing, forgery, counter-inscription, stronger concealment, or destruction can distort the echo. A successful Cultivation Check against that Source Rule reveals one true fragment and the fact that the record was altered.
This does not reveal the source unless you identify it through another procedure.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.name: Marginal Correction

activation.trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet fails an ability check or saving throw involving memory, knowledge, illusion, charm, fear, possession, dreams, identity, emotional deception, spiritual concealment, or an event represented by one of your relevant Echo Entries

effects.evidence: The target rerolls the check or saving throw with Advantage and must use the new result.

riders: Reroute the Line: on a successful reroll you learn the triggering effect's broad authority category (information: the GM tells you).

Restore the Missing Word (consume a relevant Echo Entry: the roll counts as a success for the recorded fact) and Annotate the Wound (a possession, identity, memory or lasting spiritual wound expression suppressed until the end of the target's next turn) are the GM's: Echo Entries and those wounds are not tracked at the table.
description: Choose one Correction:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.name: Name on the Page

effects.evidence: The target makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: It becomes Resonance Marked for the scene

on_success.evidence: It is Resonance Marked until the end of your next turn

riders: Name Entry (failed save): ordinary invisibility, disguise, mimicry and illusion cannot hide that the subject is present within 120 feet; you know when it knowingly acts against the recorded name, title, office or epithet, and the first time each round it does so within 60 feet it takes 2 x Proficiency Bonus Psychic damage or one Spiritual Pressure effect, your choice (the GM judges the contradiction). A successful save records only its appearance and pressure category.
Correcting the Name: a creature can spend an Action to challenge an inaccurate Entry (a Charisma save against your Cultivation Save DC) -- the GM runs it.
description: - its chosen name;
- a title it meaningfully bears;
- a kinship or office it recognizes;
- a descriptive epithet that is currently and demonstrably true, such as “the wounded gatekeeper,” “the spirit within the magistrate,” or “the killer holding the red spear.”

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea.name: Written Rebuke

activation.trigger: A Resonance Marked creature within 60 feet knowingly speaks a direct lie, uses a verbal or spiritual command, activates an audible or named technique, or targets you or an ally with a mental, emotional, memory, dream, or possession effect

effects.evidence: The triggering creature makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed: 4d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic; Strike the Phrase. Success: half.

riders: Other triggers -- a Resonance Marked creature within 60 feet knowingly lying, giving a verbal or spiritual command, or targeting you or an ally with a save-based mental, emotional, memory, dream or possession effect -- and the Break the Command / Record the Lie rebukes are the GM's (attack techniques are automated with Strike the Phrase); a successful save's Echo Entry is the GM's.
It does not counter silent techniques, purely physical attacks, accidental falsehoods or speech protected by superior authority without a Cultivation Check (the GM rules it).
description: You write against a hostile word before its echo settles into reality.

Written Rebuke does not automatically counter silent techniques, purely physical attacks, accidental falsehoods, mistaken beliefs, or speech protected by superior true-name, divine, Secret, or artifact authority. Against such effects, a Cultivation Check may be required to apply Strike the Phrase or Break the Command.

effects.evidence: The triggering creature makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage.

on_fail.evidence: It takes half damage.
The triggering attack roll is made with Disadvantage
the triggering effect’s first target makes its saving throw with Advantage

effects.evidence: The triggering creature makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage.

on_fail.evidence: It takes half damage.
Until the end of the scene, the creature has Disadvantage on the first Charisma saving throw it makes against you when that Entry is relevant.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.name: Afterimage Edge

effects.evidence: Record the Killing Step; Strike From the Echo; Step Through the Opening

riders: Strike From the Echo measures reach, range and line of sight from the Echo Position; cover against the attack is still worked out from your own space (the GM may give the Echo's cover instead).
description: - You still occupy your actual space.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.name: Echo Counter

activation.trigger: A creature you can perceive targets you with an attack or enters your reach

effects.evidence: Record your current space as an Echo Position, then move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

riders: "Or enters your reach": Echo Counter against a creature entering your reach is the GM's (the table moves a creature along its whole path at once, so there is no moment to answer mid-move); against an attack it is a button.

Cross the Blade-Hum against a creature that only moves through an Echo Position is answered when its move is committed: a failed save's Speed 0 ends the rest of its movement, but it is not pulled back to the Echo (the GM may stop it there).
description: You leave the threatened body behind and let the attacker strike the decision you already abandoned.
If the attack misses, choose one:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.name: Hundred Echoes Kill One Moment

effects.evidence: You enter the Hundred-Echo State.

riders: Moment of the Final Edge: ending one lower-Source-CL movement or concealment effect and moving the target 20 feet along your echo sequence are the GM's (the other four results are buttons); against a target 5 or more Source CL lower that bears your Pursuit Mark, ordinary escape, invisibility and movement defenses cannot prevent the approach (the GM rules them).
description: You manifest every combat-ready version of your position across a single decisive interval.
You enter the Hundred-Echo State.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.name: Pursuit Without Distance

activation.trigger: The creature bearing your Pursuit Mark moves at least 15 feet, teleports, enters invisibility, changes form, crosses a portal, or leaves your current line of sight

effects.evidence: move up to your Speed by spiritual step toward a legal space within 10 feet of its destination; or move to an Echo Position within 60 feet and use Mind Spike against the target. After arriving, record your space as an Echo Position.

riders: Follow the Vanishing Point when the marked creature teleports, turns invisible, changes form, crosses a portal or leaves your line of sight, and its Cultivation Check option for a teleport or route, are the GM's (the table answers a move of 15 feet or more).
Pursuit Mark: you know the marked creature's direction and approximate distance within 1 mile (information); Spiritual Exorcism or a higher-Source-CL boundary also ends it (the GM rules it).

Cut the Retreat (once per round, consume an Echo Position when the pursued creature leaves it or moves away: Wisdom save, failed: its movement ends after 5 feet and 3d8 Psychic; success: 10 feet less movement) is the GM's: the table cannot stop a move part-way.
Soul Splitting -- Second Stance (your soul fragment's own Echo Position) is the GM's: the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: - You can maintain one Pursuit Mark at a time.
Choose one:
After arriving, record your space as an Echo Position.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.name: Three-Step Soul Execution

effects.evidence: Choose up to three legal origins among your space and your Echo Positions. Each origin must be within 30 feet of the next origin in the sequence.

on_fail.evidence: cannot take Reactions
Speed is halved

on_fail.on: its next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw
on_fail.evidence: Disadvantage on its next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw

on_success.evidence: cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn

final_save.evidence: If all three attacks hit the same Resonance Marked target, it makes a Charisma saving throw after the final hit

description: You resolve three prepared killing positions as one continuous Spirit Awakening technique.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s.name: Court of Equal Heaven

effects.evidence: The aura is your Court of Equal Heaven Domain and moves with you.
Debts of the Aggressor; Any Hand May Answer; Nothing Without Answer; Perfect Recompense.

riders: Debts count a hostile creature's Actions and Bonus Actions (a Debt from its Reaction, or from a mental effect without a save other than Charmed and Frightened, is the GM's); Debts are visible to Spiritual Sense (information).

Karma, Oath, Contract, Sovereignty, Fate, divine judgment, artifact law, or higher-Source-CL reciprocity can contest a Debt or answer that contradicts its authority; losing the contest suppresses only that Debt or answer (the GM runs the contest).
The Court records hostile consequence, not justice: it cannot force restitution, transfer permanent wounds, revive the dead, or decide who deserved an action.
description: The aura is your Court of Equal Heaven Domain and moves with you.
- qualifying movement or restraint for Motion;
- a qualifying spiritual or mental consequence for Intent.

Karma, Oath, Contract, Sovereignty, Fate, divine judgment, artifact law, or higher-Source-CL reciprocity can contest a Debt or answer that directly contradicts its authority. Losing the contest suppresses only that Debt or answer.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s.name: Exact Counterweight

activation.trigger: You or a willing creature bearing your Resonance Mark within 30 feet is affected by a hostile activation matching a Measure you hold

effects.evidence: Choose the corresponding procedure: Impact, Motion or Intent Counterweight.

riders: Impact Counterweight is taken off the damage before Resistance (the table's damage-reduction moment), not after it; it does not reduce Hit Point costs, self-inflicted sacrifice, maximum-Hit-Point reduction, Exhaustion or cultivation harm, and unreducible damage needs an authority contest (the GM rules those).

Motion Counterweight's other choices -- Advantage on the check or save against becoming Grappled or Restrained, and a Cultivation Check to suppress a Grappled or Restrained imposed without a save -- are the GM's; cutting a typed push or pull by up to 20 feet and preventing a typed Prone are buttons (the engine's own Shove is the GM's).

Intent Counterweight against an ordinary lower-Source-CL effect imposed without a save (a Cultivation Check to suppress one mental, emotional, spiritual, possession, command or identity expression until the start of the protected creature's next turn) is the GM's; the +1d6 to a failed Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save is a button.
description: Choose one:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s.name: Receive and Return

effects.evidence: You gain the Measure rules above. Measured Return: once on each of your turns, when a Martial Strike damages a meaningful hostile creature, you may spend one Measure and apply its expression.

riders: Receiving a Measure counts a hostile creature's Actions and Bonus Actions; a Measure from its Reaction (an Opportunity Attack), from preventing at least 10 feet of movement it was legally attempting, or from a possession, identity or other mental effect without a save (other than Charmed and Frightened) is the GM's.
Damage or effects voluntarily accepted principally to generate a Measure do not qualify (the GM rules it).

Know the Weight: when Soul Gaze examines a creature, effect, Asset or Anchor that gave you a Measure this scene, you also learn its primary expression (Impact, Motion or Intent), whether its Source CL was lower, equal or higher than yours, and what continuing link it depended on (information: the GM tells you).
description: - which of Impact, Motion, or Intent was its primary expression;
- whether the Source CL was lower than, equal to, or higher than yours;
- whether the effect depended on a weapon, body, spirit, Asset, Anchor, Domain, Formation, possession, or another continuing link.
You do not automatically learn exact statistics, hidden techniques, or protected names.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s.name: The Scales Do Not Tremble

effects.evidence: Convert the Measure (Bonus Action, 1 Resonance, once per turn); Counterweight Becomes Counterstrike (once per round).

description: Transfer one discrete matching consequence to yourself before it resolves:
- one ordinary mental, emotional, spiritual, possession, command, or identity effect.
While the fragment holds a Measure:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s.name: Threefold Recompense

range.text: Martial Strike range (Mind Spike 60 feet, a weapon its reach)

effects.evidence: Spend one, two, or three different Measures, then make one Martial Strike against the target.

riders: Motion Recompense's other choice -- moving yourself to a legal space adjacent to the target before damage is applied -- is the GM's; moving the target up to 15 feet on a failed Strength or Wisdom save is automated.
description: You return one or more completed Measures through a single martial judgment.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur.name: Banishment Strike

activation.trigger: An Intruder, Restless Dead, fiend, demon, hostile spirit, or possessed creature fails its saving throw against your Mind Spike.

effects.evidence: Native Ghost, Undead Soul or Restless Dead: optional 2 Resonance after Mind Spike; Charisma save; Frightened for 1 minute with end-of-turn repeat saves.

riders: Banishment Strike against a native ghost, undead soul or Restless Dead resolves its save, Frightened condition and repeat saves. Possessing Intruders, extraplanar banishment, cursed Hosts and approach restrictions around a Host, corpse, grave or sustaining Anchor still require their source procedure.
description: Apply the result appropriate to the target:

Banishment Strike does not permanently destroy a soul, erase a Spirit Companion bond, override divine custody, dismiss a willingly hosted ancestor, or send an equal- or higher-Source-CL entity across planar boundaries without its printed Anchor or escape procedure.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur.name: Ghost Sight and Name the Intruder

effects.evidence: Name the Intruder: Bonus Action, 1 Resonance; diagnosis and optional designation; Intruder, Curse Source or Restless Dead becomes Resonance Marked, concealed on a successful Charisma save until your next turn.

riders: Name the Intruder gives Soul Gaze’s combat diagnosis and lets you name the intruder. Haunted objects, possession-link details and Ward of Invitation checks are not yet resolved automatically.
description: - The broad outline of a possession link between a Host and Intruder.
- Ordinary curses, spiritual contamination, corpse animation, and funerary disturbance.

Ghost Sight does not function as general Blindsight at that extended range. It does not reveal mundane hidden creatures, physical writing, concealed objects, or a spirit behind total cover. Equal- or higher-Source-CL concealment remains contested.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur.name: Grand Exorcism

effects.name: Grand Exorcism
effects.evidence: Choose any number of allies, Hosts, Intruders, Restless Dead, fiends, demons, undead spirits, possessions, curse Anchors, and hostile spirit Assets in the area. Each hostile chosen creature makes a Charisma saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: The target takes 10d10 Radiant or Psychic damage

on_success.evidence: The target takes half damage
becomes Resonance Marked by you
and suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect

riders: Which hostile creatures it answers: the table asks you (every hostile creature in the area for the AI); their kinds and each kind's failed-save result -- an Intruder forced out of every Host and sealed or expelled, an extraplanar spirit expelled or its Anchor revealed and it Incapacitated, a Restless Dead destroyed, sent onward or dropped to 0 Hit Points, an undead body destroyed at 50 Hit Points or fewer, a curse ended or suppressed, a spirit Asset or Anchor taking double damage -- Creatures carry no type at the table (spirit, ghost, undead, fiend, demon, possessor, Host), so this is the GM's.

Allied Purification: ending one ordinary Charmed or Frightened is a button; repeating a save against possession, curse, dream intrusion, memory alteration, Spiritual Affliction or Heart Demon influence with Advantage, returning a displaced soul, and suppressing a higher affliction (a Cultivation Check) are the GM's.

High-Authority Limits and Domain Integration (inside your Domain Manifestation every ordinary possession link, invisible hostile spirit and lower curse Anchor counts as perceived; the Emanation may start from your Soul Fragment) -- the GM's.
description: You invoke the full authority of departure, rightful hosting, burial, and spiritual boundary.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur.name: Purification Bell

effects.name: Purification Bell
effects.evidence: Choose any number of creatures ... in the area. A hostile Intruder, Restless Dead, fiend, demon, undead spirit, or possessing entity makes a Wisdom saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: It takes 6d8 Radiant or Psychic damage, chosen for each activation
becomes Resonance Marked by you
and is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage
and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn

riders: Purification benefits the table cannot see -- repeating a save against possession, dream intrusion, memory alteration or contamination with Advantage, suppressing a curse or contamination, removing a Spiritual Pressure effect or a spirit-tracking mark -- are the GM's; ending a Frightened or Charmed and removing a hostile creature's mark are buttons (the GM confirms the cause: "caused by a spirit, curse, possession, or Heart Demon", and the mark's lower Source CL).
Resonant Exposure makes the spirit visible, not corporeal (the table ends only its Invisible benefit).

Bell Against the Anchor: instead of damaging a creature, a Cultivation Attack or Check against a spiritual or curse Anchor in the area for 6d8 Force or Radiant, or -2 to the sustaining effect's Source CL until the end of your next turn -- the GM's (Anchors are not creatures at the table).
description: You manifest the spiritual law of a bell, chime, clap, drum, sutra, sword-ring, hand seal, or other tradition-appropriate purification sound.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur.name: Seal of Binding

effects.evidence: The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed: a Binding Seal Anchor; while it remains the target is Restrained and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

riders: Binding Seal: resolve departure from a Host, prior temporary incorporeality, entering a Host and crossing planar boundaries by hand. The game applies Restrained, prevents teleportation and new Invisible or Incorporeal conditions, and keeps voluntary movement within 30 feet of the Anchor. Inherent passive qualities remain unsuppressed.

Successful initial save: you also learn its escape condition, sustaining Anchor category, invitation route, or the name, taboo, burial need or obligation most relevant to peaceful resolution (information: the GM tells you).
Breaking or Resolving the Seal: completing an exposed lawful resolution (Revoke Invitation, Break the Anchor, Return Remains, Pay Restitution ...) also ends it -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting Expression -- Seal Warden (your Soul Fragment beside the Anchor: Resistance for it and Disadvantage on the next repeat save) -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: You create an exorcist seal that restrains a designated spiritual threat and exposes its removal procedure.
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL.
While the Anchor remains:
- Its sustaining Anchor category.
- Its invitation or possession route.
- The true name, title, taboo, burial need, payment, or unfinished obligation most relevant to peaceful resolution.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.name: Borrowed Ending

activation.trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, fail a death saving throw, become Charmed or Frightened, become possessed, suffer a curse, lose a memory, have identity altered, suffer a permanent wound, or fail a Cultivation Check with an immediate consequence

effects.evidence: Cost: 6 Resonance and 1 Fate Tension. Create a Borrowed Ending and delay the triggering consequence until the end of the target's next turn.

riders: Other triggers -- failing a death save, becoming possessed, a curse, a lost memory, an altered identity, a permanent wound, a failed Cultivation Check -- are the GM's; dropping to 0 Hit Points and becoming Charmed or Frightened by a hostile creature are buttons.

Whether the cause "was legally removed or the situation genuinely changed": the table counts regained Hit Points (0 Hit Points) and the charming or frightening creature being gone (a condition); other changes -- an escape, exorcism, surrender, bargain -- are the GM's. Against an equal or higher source, complete dissolution needs a Cultivation Check (on a failure the consequence is one step less severe or delayed to the end of the scene) -- the GM's.
A willing equal- or higher-authority healer, exorcist or fate cultivator may target the Ending Token to dissolve it instead of triggering it (the GM rules it).
Judgment: the printed "1 Fate Tension" cost is taken on (Fate Tension is a burden that starts at 0); it cannot be taken at the maximum (Fate-Tangled).
description: You can detach a consequence from the moment it was supposed to occur.
During the delay:
At the end of the target’s next turn:
It is a Cultivation Asset with:
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
- Immunities: Poison, Psychic, and ordinary bodily conditions

tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.name: Nudge Consequence

activation.trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, saving throw, death saving throw, or Cultivation Check

effects.evidence: Before the final outcome is declared, add or subtract 1d8 from the triggering roll. After the result resolves, gain 1 Fate Tension if the modifier changed success to failure or failure to success.

riders: Death saving throws and Cultivation Checks, and rolls whose target number the table does not know, are the GM's to nudge.

Consequence Echo: when the nudge changes an outcome involving a major enemy, a death save, a Secret Law, divine agent, artifact, tribulation, fate-protected creature, breakthrough, permanent injury or identity-scale effect, choose 1 more Fate Tension or a Named Echo (a future complication; resolving or accepting it removes 1 Fate Tension) -- the GM judges the stakes.

Refuse Certainty (once per scene, 2 more Resonance): a creature within 60 feet that would automatically succeed or fail because of an ordinary lower-Source-CL feature must roll instead -- the GM's (automatic results do not roll at the table).
description: You can apply force to a probability already in motion.
- accept one Named Echo from the fixed Named Echo table and state it immediately.
A Named Echo is a coherent future complication connected to the intervention, such as:
- a broken weapon fails at a later dramatic moment;
- the healing that succeeded creates a visible omen;
- a diverted curse seeks a new route;
- an authority notices the altered probability;
- the beneficiary owes a spiritual favor.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.name: Omen Glimpse

activation.trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, saving throw, death saving throw, or Cultivation Check

effects.evidence: Before the final outcome is declared, replace the d20 with your Omen die. The Omen die is then expended.

riders: Prepare an Omen: the table gives you an Omen die at the start of each fight (the minute of observation is taken to be before it; 1 Resonance). Preparing one as a Bonus Action when genuinely surprised (2 Resonance and 1 Fate Tension) is the GM's call, and while Fate-Tangled you cannot gain or prepare an Omen die (the GM applies it between scenes).
Omen Limits: an Omen cannot replace a roll that has no d20, change a fully resolved event, or override a higher-authority fixed result without a Cultivation Check (the GM rules it).
description: - You can hold only one Omen die.
- Preparing a new one replaces the old one.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.name: Read the Thread

target.text: One creature, object, location, active plan, or imminent event you can meaningfully observe

effects.evidence: Read the Thread: choose one Thread Question (what it will most likely do next, what it protects, its immediate danger, the choice that most alters its outcome, how its fate is distorted, the sign before its next major consequence); the GM answers symbolically but usefully.

riders: Thread Clarity: equal or higher authority can require a Cultivation Check; on a failure you learn which category is obscured and one sign of the concealment (the GM runs it).
Mark the Branch: after receiving the answer, use the prediction button to record an attack or voluntary movement. Predictions of other actions still need to be resolved by hand.
description: - What is this subject most likely to do next?
- What is it trying hardest to protect?
- What immediate danger is connected to it?
- What choice would most alter its next likely outcome?
- Is fate around it ordinary, Restricted, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact-level, tribulation-bound, or otherwise distorted?
- What visible sign will precede the next major consequence tied to it?
- Equal or higher authority can require a Cultivation Check.
