- On a failed check, you learn which category is obscured and one visible sign of the concealment rather than receiving false information.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.name: Sever One Thread

activation.trigger: A creature within 90 feet succeeds or fails on an attack roll, ability check, saving throw, death saving throw, or Cultivation Check, or an immediately resolved event creates a single discrete outcome
activation.requirement: You are not Fate-Tangled, and the event has not yet produced further dependent rolls or completed a later action

effects.evidence: Reroute the Roll; Restore the Omen. After Sever One Thread resolves: Set your Fate Tension to its maximum.

riders: Cut the Immediate Event (a discrete non-roll event -- an ordinary teleport completing, a possession taking hold, a gate opening, an execution trigger, an Anchor collapsing: a Cultivation Check against its Source Rule; success, it does not occur; failure, it is delayed to the end of the turn and one way to stop it is revealed) is the GM's.

Severed-Thread Consequence: choose and record one consequence from the fixed list (an authority notices, the spared death returns as a tribulation, ...); Sever One Thread cannot be used again until it is resolved -- the GM keeps the record (the table allows one use a fight).

Fate-Tangled (Fate Tension at its maximum): the first time each scene you then change a roll or delay a consequence with a Fate Reader feature, a Counter-Omen token is created and resolved by the Counter-Omen Procedure -- the GM's.

Secret-Law Authority: an equal or higher Secret Law, divine decree, artifact destiny, tribulation law, fixed reincarnation, voluntary sacrifice or campaign-defining outcome can resist (Source CL, then a Cultivation Check); you still learn how the outcome was protected -- the GM's.
description: You can cut one resolved possibility away from the world and force another nearby possibility to occupy its place.
Name the thread you are severing in a brief statement: “the blade lands,” “the seal holds,” “the soul escapes,” “the gate opens,” or another precise outcome.
- Success: The named event does not occur. Costs already paid remain paid unless the source says otherwise.
After Sever One Thread resolves:
- Set your Fate Tension to its maximum.
- You become Fate-Tangled.
Examples include:
- an authority notices the impossible divergence;
- the spared death returns as a future tribulation;
- the abandoned possibility becomes a hostile omen-spirit;
- a different branch claims the cost that was refused;

An equal- or higher-Source-CL Secret Law, divine decree, artifact destiny, tribulation law, fixed reincarnation event, voluntary self-sacrifice, or campaign-defining outcome can resist Sever One Thread. Resolve the contest by Source CL and then Cultivation Check. Even on failure, you learn whether the outcome was fixed, protected, willingly accepted, or anchored elsewhere.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.grief_eater.fea.name: Eat the Bitter Memory
riders: The table eats or suppresses Frightened and Charmed; a Nightmare Scar, ordinary despair, grief paralysis, emotional corruption or a memory-emotion wound is the GM's.

Authority tiers: the table takes the ordinary 1d8; two dice for Restricted, three for Rare or Forbidden, four for Secret or comparable effects are the GM's to add, and equal or higher Source-CL effects can require a Cultivation Check (on a failure you become Resonance Marked by the hostile source until the end of your next turn).
description: Choose one:

effects.evidence: End one ordinary effect. Gain 1 Sorrow Burden if you are below your maximum. You take 1d8 Psychic damage per authority tier.

Suppress a stronger effect until the end of your next turn. You take 2d8 Psychic damage that cannot be reduced. The target gains Advantage on the next save it makes against that effect during the suppression.

Diagnose: the effect stays; the GM tells you its Source CL relationship to yours, whether it is self-generated or imposed, one trigger that strengthens it, one condition that weakens it, and one lawful recovery route.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.grief_eater.fea.name: Shared Burden

activation.trigger: An ally within 30 feet takes Psychic, Necrotic, or Force damage, fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, or would receive an ordinary emotional, possession, nightmare, grief, or identity effect

riders: Divide the Pain (combat/ext/damage_sharing.py): you take half the triggering damage, rounded up, and the ally takes the rest; your share cannot be reduced, redirected or turned into healing.

Carry the Echo (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py): the ally rerolls a failed Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save and must use the new result; you choose your lesser emotional echo until the end of your next turn (Frightened, no Reactions, Speed -10, or Disadvantage on your next attack).

Hold the Door (combat/ext/grief_eater.py): an ally becoming Charmed or Frightened by a hostile creature waits until the end of its next turn, then lands unless that creature is gone; delaying a possession, nightmare, despair, memory-emotion or identity-pressure consequence, and "meaningful exorcism, healing, escape, surrender ..." changing the result, are the GM's.

Transferring a permanent soul wound, complete memory loss, high-authority possession, curse, Secret effect, divine judgment, artifact authority or tribulation scar requires a Cultivation Check and normally creates a persistent Burden Scar (a Hidden Injury of the spirit, treated by exorcism, a funeral rite, emotional resolution, equal-authority healing or a treatment procedure) -- the GM's.
description: Choose one mode:

Transferring a permanent soul wound, complete memory loss, high-authority possession, curse, Secret effect, divine judgment, artifact authority, or tribulation scar requires a Cultivation Check and normally creates a persistent Burden Scar rather than simply removing the effect.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.grief_eater.fea.name: Taste of Sorrow

activation.trigger: A meaningful creature within 60 feet becomes Bloodied, Frightened, Charmed, possessed, reduced to 0 Hit Points, dies, or experiences a major emotional break

effects.evidence: Gain 1 Sorrow Burden and choose the triggering creature. If it is willing or fails a Wisdom saving throw, it becomes Resonance Marked by you until the end of your next turn.

riders: Sorrow Burdens also come from a creature becoming possessed, suffering major memory or identity harm, or openly showing story-significant grief, and never from staged harm, harmless summons, captive loops or allies frightening one another -- the GM's (the table counts Bloodied, Frightened, Charmed, 0 Hit Points and death, one a turn).
You learn the dominant emotional category around it (fear, grief, rage, guilt, love, emptiness, despair, relief) -- information: the GM tells you.

Carry the First Tear: once per round when an ally within 30 feet would suffer an ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect, spend 1 Sorrow Burden to take that effect instead (or another that represents the burden), without your Reaction -- the GM's.
description: You learn the dominant emotional category around it: fear, grief, rage, guilt, love, emptiness, despair, relief, using the fixed Emotion Categories in the Normalized Execution Notes.
This does not reveal the cause, hidden facts, exact memories, guilt’s truth, or whether the emotion is morally justified.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.grief_eater.fea.name: Vessel of Ten Thousand Sorrows

effects.evidence: Create a 30-foot-radius Mourning Field centered on you. It moves with you.
Allies of your choice in the field ...; for each Sorrow Burden spent when the field manifests, choose one Mourning Office.

riders: Advantage in the field is on saves the table tags Charmed, Frightened or possession; nightmare, despair, grief, emotional corruption and forced memory-emotion saves are the GM's.

The field's Temporary Hit Points also follow Spiritual Exorcism, Divide the Pain or another feature that removes, absorbs or delays a hostile effect -- the GM's (Eat the Bitter Memory, Hold the Door and Carry the Echo are automated). A creature cannot generate Sorrow Burdens from consequences you already absorbed during this activation (the GM rules it).

Office of the Wake (allies dropped to 0 Hit Points stay conscious until the end of their current turn), Office of the Empty Chair (hostile creatures cannot benefit from invisibility or emotional concealment against those they harmed) and Office of Returning Names (a lost memory, name or bond is delayed until the field ends) -- the GM's; Office of the Funeral Bell is automated.

Mourner's Embrace: if the target chooses movement toward what the grief is tied to, choose and resolve that destination by hand. Ceasing hostility is enforced by the game; an ordinary creature 5 or more Source CL lower remains unable to use hostile actions until it leaves the field or succeeds on a later end-of-turn Charisma save. Speaking a statement resolves that immediate choice.
Vessel Consequence: when the field ends (the end of the scene), a Wisdom save against your own Cultivation Save DC; on a failure a Burden Scar and one level of Exhaustion -- the GM's.
description: You open your soul as a communal vessel without allowing the stored grief to erase your identity.
While active:
- speak one statement it believes about the harm;
Success: Retain your identity and release the gathered grief through a visible but harmless funeral sign.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.grief_eater.fea.name: Weight of Mourning

activation.requirement: The target damaged an ally, killed or destroyed a meaningful creature or Asset, inflicted major emotional or spiritual harm, or bears a visible grief-related spiritual stain during the scene

effects.evidence: The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: It gains Mourning Weight until it completes two successful saves at the end of its turns.

riders: Requirement: the table offers it against a creature that damaged one of your allies or dropped a creature to 0 Hit Points this fight; destroying a meaningful Asset, major emotional or spiritual harm, or a visible grief stain are the GM's to allow.
While weighted it also cannot become Hidden from a creature it directly harmed (the table stops it hiding from you).

Innocence and False Grief: false memories, framed evidence, coerced action or concealed causality revealed by a Cultivation Check or investigation end Mourning Weight (no Resonance or Sorrow Burden back) -- the GM's.
description: While weighted:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.halo_eater.feat.name: Bite the Halo

activation.requirement: The target is savored by you, Resonance Marked by you, or visibly carries qualifying radiance

effects.evidence: Choose one creature. It makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: 4d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic or Radiant damage; one qualifying effect on it ends or is suppressed. If you end or suppress a qualifying effect, gain 1 Stolen Radiance.

riders: Restricted and higher protected radiance still need their printed authority contest and strain procedure.
Successful Save: one qualifying effect you perceive flickers -- you learn its remaining duration and one condition that could end, discharge, bypass or restore it (information).

Devoured Effect Recovery: the source of a blessing is not deleted; it can be received again, recharged or reconsecrated by its own rules (the GM's). Qualifying radiance at the table: a beneficial effect its own side put on the creature (a buff condition, AC, resistance, immunity, Speed), or healing / Temporary Hit Points from a technique; the GM rules out mundane recovery, armor and cover.
description: Bite the Halo does not permanently delete the source that created a blessing unless the source itself is destroyed by another procedure.
- A discharged item can be recharged according to its own rules.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.halo_eater.feat.name: Crown of Borrowed Light

effects.evidence: It sheds bright spiritual light in a 20-foot radius and dim spiritual light for another 20 feet. This is a Spirit Awakening field.
For each Stolen Radiance spent when the Crown manifests, choose one Crown Facet.

riders: The field is the Crown's whole light (20 feet bright and 20 feet dim); you may hide its visible light without ending it. You perceive qualifying radiance in it even when its light is concealed (information).
A hostile creature in the field cannot gain more than one benefit from the same named healing or Temporary Hit Point feature in a turn unless its Source Rule allows it -- the GM's.

The Temporary Hit Points and Spiritual Pressure answer your Spirit Awakening features; "protected by a shrine, oath, divine office, holy artifact, or qualifying radiance" is read as carrying a beneficial effect of its own side. Qualifying radiance at the table: a beneficial effect its own side put on the creature (a buff condition, AC, resistance, immunity, Speed), or healing / Temporary Hit Points from a technique; the GM rules out mundane recovery, armor and cover.
Crown Collapse: a higher-authority effect that tears the Crown away forces a Wisdom save against its DC (failure: 4d8 Psychic and all Stolen Radiance lost; success: half and 1 kept) -- the GM's.
description: While the Crown lasts:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.halo_eater.feat.name: Empty Heaven Maw

activation.requirement: The target is Resonance Marked or savored by you and carries qualifying radiance

effects.evidence: A creature makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: 10d10 + Wisdom modifier Psychic or Radiant damage; one qualifying radiance expression for each Stolen Radiance spent, maximum three; you regain Hit Points equal to half the damage actually dealt.

riders: Targets other than creatures -- a shrine, sacred Formation, blessing Anchor, divine projection or protective spiritual Asset, resolved against its Source CL -- are the GM's.

A higher-Source-CL, Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact, tribulation or office-defining expression: the table suppresses it until the end of your next turn; a successful Cultivation Check to extend it to the end of the target's next turn, the target's three successful repeat saves restoring an equal expression, and a successful save's "reveal its Anchor, source direction, or restoration condition" are the GM's.

Vacant Halo (the scene, after the Maw ends an effect): the first time each round the target would receive qualifying radiance, its user pays 1 more unit of an activation resource or makes a Cultivation Check against your DC, else the new radiance is suppressed until the start of the target's next turn -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting Expression -- Hungry Reflection (your Soul Fragment as the origin of Taste the Radiance or Bite the Halo) -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
It cannot consume a deity, moral worth, an entire oath relationship, a complete Foundation or Method, or an artifact's existence.
description: You can open a spiritual absence shaped specifically to consume invested sanctity.
Failed Save or Successful Authority Contest:
- An ordinary or Restricted expression with lower Source CL ends.
- The Vacant Halo is visible to Spiritual Sense.
- A meaningful purification, reconsecration, source-specific restoration, or an equal- or higher-Source-CL cleansing effect removes the Vacant Halo.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.halo_eater.feat.name: Stolen Benediction

activation.trigger: A meaningful hostile creature within 60 feet receives supernatural healing, gains Temporary Hit Points, or succeeds on a save against Charmed, Frightened, possession, curse, spiritual contamination, identity damage, or memory damage because of qualifying radiance

effects.evidence: Choose one Benediction Shape: Restoring, Warding, Cleansing or Reflecting. Cost: 3 Resonance and 1 Stolen Radiance.

riders: The trigger "succeeds on a save against Charmed, Frightened, possession, curse ... because of qualifying radiance" is the GM's (the table answers healing, Temporary Hit Points and a new blessing). Cleansing Shape's suppression of a curse, possession, Nightmare Scar, contamination or Spiritual Pressure effect on yourself is the GM's; ending your Charmed or Frightened is a button.
Predatory Mercy (once per scene: after a hostile creature succeeded against possession, curse or contamination, Cleansing Shape on a willing ally within 30 feet instead) -- the GM's.
description: You can convert predation into a controlled counterfeit blessing.
Choose one Benediction Shape:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.halo_eater.feat.name: Taste the Radiance

activation.trigger: A creature within 60 feet gains or activates qualifying radiance, receives supernatural healing, or becomes Resonance Marked by you while carrying qualifying radiance

effects.evidence: If the triggering creature is a meaningful hostile creature, gain 1 Stolen Radiance and Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Until the end of your next turn, the creature is savored by you.

riders: You learn its broad purpose and category (healing, warding, cleansing, empowering, oath-bearing, shrine-backed, divine, artifact ...), whether its Source CL is lower, equal or higher than yours, and its authority tier; a concealed source can require a Cultivation Check -- information: the GM tells you.

Stolen Radiance also comes from a hostile creature succeeding on a save because of a blessing or activating a visibly sanctified effect the table does not see, and never from your own effects, staged blessings, harmless summons or ceremonial healing -- the GM's. Qualifying radiance at the table: a beneficial effect its own side put on the creature (a buff condition, AC, resistance, immunity, Speed), or healing / Temporary Hit Points from a technique; the GM rules out mundane recovery, armor and cover.
description: Taste the spiritual structure of the triggering effect.
You learn:
- its broad purpose;
- whether it is healing, warding, cleansing, empowering, oath-bearing, shrine-backed, divine, artifact-based, or another recognizable category;
- whether its Source CL is lower than, equal to, or higher than yours;
- whether it is ordinary, Restricted, Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact-level, tribulation-scale, or otherwise exceptional.

A concealed or deliberately masked source can require a Cultivation Check against the protecting effect. On failure, you still learn that meaningful radiance is present and that its details are concealed.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.heartbinder.fea.name: Borrowed Courage
riders: Borrowed Courage requires a willing creature bearing your Vow Mark within 60 feet.
Devotion Release allows healing, movement or a mental-save bonus; learning a lawful recovery route is a recovery-information procedure.

Hold the Heart suppresses the selected charm, possession, grief, despair, corruption, obsession or identity-confusion expression until the end of your next turn. Bear It With Me transfers the selected Frightened, charm, grief, despair or emotional wound for one minute, preserving its original source and recovery saves. If you are immune, it remains suppressed on the original creature until the end of your next turn.
Authority-tier contests beyond the recorded source’s Cultivation Level are resolved by hand.
description: Your bonds allow one soul to lend another the strength to remain itself.
Choose one procedure:
- you learn one lawful recovery route for the effect you suppressed or transferred.

effects.evidence: End the Frightened condition on the target
can immediately stand from Prone without spending movement
It gains Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 x Proficiency Bonus + Wisdom modifier`

Spend up to 3 Devotion. For each point spent, choose one additional benefit: the target regains Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier; the target may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; the target gains +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws until the start of your next turn; you learn one lawful recovery route for the effect you suppressed or transferred.

Suppress one ordinary charm, possession, grief, despair, emotional corruption, obsession, or identity-confusion expression until the end of your next turn. Against a Restricted or equal-Source-CL effect, make a Cultivation Check.

Transfer one ordinary Frightened, Charmed, grief, despair, or emotional-wound expression from the target to yourself for 1 minute. If you are immune, the effect is not erased; it remains suppressed on the original creature until the end of your next turn

tianxia.tradition.spirit.heartbinder.fea.name: Chain of Devotion

target.text: Up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures bearing your Vow Mark, including yourself

effects.evidence: While at least two linked creatures remain within 60 feet of one another, they form a Devotion Chain. Each linked creature gains +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws

riders: +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves while at least two linked creatures are within 60 feet of one another (combat/ext/heartbinder.py).

Once per round when a linked creature within 60 feet takes damage, another willing linked creature may use its Reaction to take any portion of that damage, up to half, after Resistance and before Temporary Hit Points; it keeps its type and source and cannot be reduced or redirected again (combat/ext/damage_sharing.py, the Chain: half).

Once per round when a linked creature fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, another linked creature within 60 feet may spend 1 Devotion and use its Reaction to grant a reroll; the target must use the new result (combat/ext/heartbinder.py: the linked creature holding the Devotion, which is the Heartbinder).
Knowledge of the direction and broad distress state of every other linked creature within 1 mile, and one brief emotional impression to the chain once per turn without an action: GM-adjudicated.

Chain Anchor: AC your Cultivation Save DC; Hit Points 8 x Proficiency Bonus; Saving Throws uses your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throw bonuses; Resistances Psychic damage; Source CL your effective Spirit Awakening CL. While it exists the Chain does not require Concentration (not automated: an Anchor object).
description: You manifest the living relationship between chosen souls as a battlefield network.
Each linked creature gains:
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL

tianxia.tradition.spirit.heartbinder.fea.name: Heart’s Rebuke

activation.trigger: A creature within 60 feet damages, charms, frightens, possesses, spiritually manipulates, forcibly moves, or inflicts a Spirit Scar, Soul Wound, defining-memory injury, identity injury, grief effect, despair effect, or another effect expressly labeled a major emotional wound on a Vow-Marked creature

on_fail.evidence: It takes `4d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic damage and suffers one Rebuke until the start of its next turn
Choose one Rebuke until the start of its next turn: Do Not Approach; Feel What You Caused; The Bond Remembers; Shared Alarm.

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage
The protected creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus

effects.evidence: If you spend 1 Devotion when using Heart's Rebuke, the protected creature also gains Advantage on the next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw it makes against the triggering creature before the end of its next turn.

riders: If you spend 1 Devotion when using Heart's Rebuke (combat/ext/heartbinder.py: spent when you have it, asked when a player is set to Ask me), the protected creature also gains Advantage on the next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw it makes against the triggering creature before the end of its next turn; the Rebuke's own Devotion (a Reaction and Resonance spent to protect a marked creature) is gained after it.

Heart's Rebuke punishes the witnessed hostile act; it does not establish legal guilt, karmic debt, an oath breach or permanent hostility. Its other triggers (charms, frightens, possesses, spiritually manipulates, forcibly moves, or wounds the soul, memory or identity) are the GM's to offer; the table answers damage.
description: A hostile act against one of your chosen bonds returns as spiritual pain.
Heart’s Rebuke punishes the witnessed hostile act. It does not establish legal guilt, karmic debt, an oath breach, or permanent hostility.

effects.on: the next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw it makes against the triggering creature
effects.evidence: spend 1 Devotion when using Heart's Rebuke, the protected creature also gains Advantage on the next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw

tianxia.tradition.spirit.heartbinder.fea.name: Unbroken Vow

activation.trigger: A Vow-Marked creature within 60 feet would die, have its soul severed or removed, be permanently transformed, lose a defining memory, suffer a major identity wound, or have its complete cultivation suppressed

effects.evidence: the target remains alive and conscious at 1 Hit Point if physically possible
The triggering consequence is delayed until the end of the target's next turn. During the delay damage cannot take it below 1 Hit Point

riders: The triggering consequence is delayed until the end of the target's next turn (combat/ext/heartbinder.py: a drop to 0 Hit Points is held at 1 Hit Point, and damage during the delay cannot take it lower; healing above 1 Hit Point ends the delay; if it is still at 1 Hit Point at the end of the target's turn the consequence occurs: it falls to 0 Hit Points). Only death is automated; soul removal, transformation, memory and identity wounds and cultivation suppression stay GM-adjudicated.

During the delay it cannot be possessed or have its soul displaced by ordinary lower-Source-CL effects, and the Vow Bearer knows the broad category and source direction of the delayed consequence (GM-adjudicated).
The Vow Bearer may willingly take one level of Exhaustion and spend up to 3 Devotion to extend the delay by one additional round (not automated).

The Bond Refuses: Make a Cultivation Check against the effect's save DC or Source CL. Success against ordinary lower-Source-CL authority: Convert death into unconsciousness at 0 Hit Points, soul removal into a Strained Soul Anchor, permanent transformation into a suppressible transformation scar, major memory loss into an inaccessible memory wound, or complete cultivation suppression into suppression of one printed system for the scene; against Restricted or equal authority choose one of those and the target gains a persistent Vow Scar. (The engine has no death state, so the delayed drop to 0 Hit Points is defeat either way: not rolled.)

Unbroken Bond Field: every willing linked creature may contribute one of the following without an action: spend 1 Hit Die; take Psychic damage equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus, ignoring Resistance; spend 1 Cultivation Point from a Path it possesses; accept one level of Exhaustion. For each distinct contributor, gain +1 to The Bond Refuses Cultivation Check, to a maximum of +3 (belongs to The Bond Refuses: not automated).
description: A chosen bond can hold a soul in the world after ordinary fate says it should be gone.
During the delay:
- the Vow Bearer knows the broad category and source direction of the delayed consequence;
Failure: The delay ends and the original consequence occurs. The Vow Mark remains unless the relationship or soul is destroyed.
- accept one level of Exhaustion.

Unbroken Vow preserves through chosen connection. It does not compel affection, prevent a willing departure, create resurrection without a remaining soul, or supersede dedicated Secret Laws of death, karma, fate, time, or conceptual severance.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.heartbinder.fea.name: Vow Mark

effects.evidence: You can maintain a number of Vow Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ... During combat or a similarly pressured scene, it requires an Action and 2 Resonance. (A Vow Mark bears Devotion, Stand Together, Heart's Rebuke, Borrowed Courage, Chain of Devotion and Unbroken Vow.)

riders: The rite needs a willing creature; outside immediate danger it is a 1-minute rite that costs no Resonance (combat/ext/heartbinder.py works it at the fight's first turn, marking the nearest typed teammates up to your Proficiency Bonus). The 30-foot reach of the in-combat rite is a table judgment (the text names none).

Stand Together (combat/ext/heartbinder.py): when you or a Vow-Marked ally within 30 feet places a Resonance Mark on a hostile creature, you may spend 1 Devotion to give one Vow-Marked ally within 30 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus, once per round per creature.

Devotion (combat/ext/heartbinder.py): 1 per turn, from a Reaction or Resonance spent to protect a marked creature from a hostile source (a damage share, Heart's Rebuke, Unbroken Vow, a Chain reroll) or a marked creature taking damage in another marked creature's place; no more than once per turn, up to your Proficiency Bonus, none at the start of a fight. The promise, condition and save-against-fear bullets are GM-adjudicated.
Heart-Sense (Bonus Action, spend 1 Resonance, remote sense on a Vow-Marked creature) is out-of-fight information-gathering; GM-adjudicated.

While a marked creature is within 1 mile you know whether it is Bloodied, Charmed, Frightened, possessed, at 0 Hit Points, or suffering a major emotional or identity wound (its category only): GM-adjudicated.
description: - you know its direction and whether it is conscious;
- you know whether its current strongest surface emotion is fear, grief, anger, loyalty, despair, hope, love, hatred, or confusion;
Heart-Sense does not reveal thoughts, exact location, hidden facts, or memories.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.inner_soul_gate.name: Crown Soul Gate

effects.evidence: Crown Opening (Bonus Action, 9 Resonance, the scene, no Concentration): Root, Sacral, Solar and Heart Openings are all active; Spiritual Truesight 30 feet; Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves; once per round a failed one succeeds for 2 Resonance.

riders: Spiritual Truesight 30 feet: the table ends an Invisible creature's Advantage and Disadvantage against you within 30 feet; seeing transformations, illusions, possession links and hidden souls, and equal or higher concealment (a Cultivation Check), are the GM's.

Ordinary possession and soul displacement with lower Source CL automatically fail against you, and your Reaction's Source CL contest against a creature within 30 feet that tries to possess, erase, rewrite, consume or relocate a soul -- the GM's (souls are not tracked at the table).
The once-per-round success cannot override an unalterable natural result or replace a breakthrough, tribulation, training or forging resolution.
Silent Axis: you are not spiritually silenced merely by losing speech -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting Expression -- Gate Mirror (a second Gate Opening held by your Soul Fragment) -- the table has no Soul Fragment.

Crown Collapse: forcibly broken by an equal or higher Source-CL effect, you take 4d10 Psychic damage and cannot open another Gate until the end of your next turn -- the GM's (the model typing dealt that damage every time you opened the Crown).
description: The crown gate opens above the ordinary self and aligns every lower gate into one coherent spiritual axis.
While Crown Opening is active:
- Root, Sacral, Solar, and Heart Openings are all considered active simultaneously. This expressly overrides the one-opening limit.
- Ordinary possession and soul displacement with lower Source CL automatically fail against you.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.inner_soul_gate.name: Heart Soul Gate

effects.evidence: Heart Attunement (Reaction, 2 Resonance: a willing creature within 30 feet adds your Wisdom modifier to a failed save against Charmed, Frightened or possession); Heart Restoration (Action, touch, 5 Resonance); Heart Opening (Bonus Action, 4 Resonance, the scene).

riders: Heart Attunement answers saves against Charmed, Frightened and possession; madness, emotional corruption and dream intrusion are the GM's.

Heart Restoration: additional afflictions, a Cultivation Check when no repeat save exists, and the successful suppression, severity, stabilization and recovery choices are not yet automated. Accepted or protected bonds cannot be erased.
Heart Opening: "allies of your choice within 10 feet" -- the table gives it to every ally within 10 feet.
description: Range: Touch
Touch one willing creature and choose one effect:
- Ordinary madness.
- Ordinary emotional corruption.
- Ordinary possession.
- A suppressed identity fracture.
- A lower-Source-CL dream intrusion.
- Reduce its severity by one stage.
- Reveal the effect’s Anchor, true name, contradiction, restitution, confession, or reconstruction requirement.
Duration: The scene

tianxia.tradition.spirit.inner_soul_gate.name: Root Soul Gate

activation.trigger: You are knocked Prone, moved against your will, Grappled or Restrained by a spirit-affecting effect, or an effect attempts to separate your soul from your body

effects.evidence: Rooted Identity (Advantage against possession); Root Reclamation (Reaction, 1 Resonance); Root Opening (Bonus Action, 1 Resonance, the scene).

riders: Rooted Identity's proficiency in Athletics or Acrobatics (or Medicine or Insight) is part of the character sheet.

Advantage against soul displacement, soul-body exchange or ejection, and forced movement caused by a spirit, psychic effect or incorporeal creature -- the GM's (the table gives it against possession).

Root Reclamation against a Grappled or Restrained "by a spirit-affecting effect" or a separation effect: the table offers the Advantage on a save against Prone, Grappled, Restrained, forced movement or possession; the Wisdom save when the effect grants no roll (its save DC, else the Authority DC) is the GM's. It cannot stop movement from terrain collapse, a mundane vehicle or an effect too large to resist.
Root Opening: the minimum Speed of 10 feet against ordinary Spiritual Pressure is not yet enforced.
description: Your soul learns the shape of its own body and refuses ordinary displacement from it.
- Forced possession.
- Soul displacement.
- An effect that would exchange, eject, or misidentify your soul and body.
Choose one:
Duration: The scene

tianxia.tradition.spirit.inner_soul_gate.name: Sacral Soul Gate

activation.trigger: You fail a Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw

effects.evidence: Sacral Reorientation (Reaction, 2 Resonance, once per round: add your Wisdom modifier to a failed Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma save); Sacral Opening (Bonus Action, 2 Resonance, the scene).

riders: Fluid Affect: Advantage on checks to tell whether an emotion is your own, imposed, inherited or an echo, and Soul Gaze tells you more about a creature's surface emotion -- information: the GM tells you.
Sacral Reorientation's free Soul Gaze on yourself (source category, severity, recovery route) is information; its order with Soulward Response is the GM's.

Sacral Opening: moving through the space of a creature bearing your Resonance Mark as difficult terrain is the GM's (the table's movement does not pass through creatures); "effects that would force you to act from an imposed emotion" are read as Charmed and Frightened.
description: You admit emotional turbulence without allowing it to seize the whole self.
If Sacral Reorientation turns failure into success:
Duration: The scene

tianxia.tradition.spirit.inner_soul_gate.name: Solar Soul Gate

effects.evidence: Solar Core (Resistance to Psychic damage; Advantage against Charmed and Frightened); Solar Opening (Bonus Action, 4 Resonance, the scene).

riders: Solar Core: if Soul Armor also grants Resistance to Psychic damage, reduce Psychic damage by your Proficiency Bonus after Resistance instead -- the GM's; Advantage against coercive emotional manipulation and effects that would make you renounce your identity or Soul Anchor -- the GM's.

Solar Opening's 10-foot spiritual light revealing lower-Source-CL possession residue, emotional contamination and dream parasites is information; against an equal or higher effect that weaponizes your own chosen emotion it gives Advantage instead of immunity (the GM rules it).
description: The gate of selfhood burns away borrowed fear and turns conviction into spiritual heat.
Duration: The scene
While open:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.knot_weaver.fea.name: Binding Knot

effects.evidence: Choose two creatures ... that are part of the same Observed Tie. Each unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw. If both fail or consent, create a Binding Knot.

riders: Observed Ties at the table are between two creatures in the fight; a Tie to an object, Asset, Anchor, location or effect is the GM's. Possession Knot (a possessor and host, or a controller and its Asset: Disadvantage on the first control save each round, and damage can force a maintenance save) is the GM's.

Guardian Knot: an unwilling side must first fail a Charisma save before it takes the damage -- the table asks that side's player, who may refuse. Destroying or ending the actual relationship can end the Knot (the GM rules it).
A Binding Knot does not create consent, loyalty, ownership, love, guilt or legal obligation.
description: A Binding Knot does not independently create consent, loyalty, ownership, love, guilt, or legal obligation.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.knot_weaver.fea.name: Knot of Inevitability

activation.requirement: The target is Resonance Marked and involved in an Observed Tie

effects.evidence: Create a Great Knot Anchor in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Name one relationship-bound consequence. The target makes a Charisma saving throw when the Knot is created and at the end of each of its turns.

riders: Release (drop, dismiss or stop controlling what forms the Tie), Answer (answer one direct question about the Tie truthfully) and Return (what forms the Tie moves toward its lawful side) are the GM's; Remain, Face and Protect are enforced.
The Anchor's Resistance to Psychic, Force and damage from creatures not in the Tie is the GM's (the table's objects take full damage).

Equal or higher relationship, oath, contract, karma, fate, Secret, divine or artifact authority can contest the Knot through a Cultivation Check; it cannot command unrelated behavior, invent guilt, establish ownership, rewrite history or force self-destruction -- the GM's.
description: You bind a consequence to an actual relationship rather than to abstract fate.
The Anchor has:
- Source CL: yours
Name one relationship-bound consequence:

Destroying the Anchor ends the Great Knot. Equal- or higher-Source-CL relationship, oath, contract, karma, fate, Secret, divine, or artifact authority can contest the Knot through a Cultivation Check.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.knot_weaver.fea.name: Red Thread Sense

effects.evidence: Learn one visible relationship involving it and record that relationship as an Observed Tie.

riders: You learn the broad role of each side; whether the tie is willing, coerced, inherited, possessive, protective, contractual, grief-born, hostile or concealed; its Source CL relative to yours; and whether it is active, dormant, damaged, false, severed-but-scarred or externally anchored -- information: the GM tells you (and confirms the other side you name). Observed Ties at the table are between two creatures in the fight; a Tie to an object, Asset, Anchor, location or effect is the GM's.

Tug the Visible Thread's other choices -- learn whether it is protecting, obeying, pursuing, possessing, restoring or abandoning the other side, or keep it from becoming Hidden from the other side until the start of your next turn -- are the GM's; the 5-foot move toward or away is a button. Forced movement cannot place a creature in an obviously lethal hazard.

Knot Tension also comes from a hostile creature activating a bound Asset, exploiting an oath or using a possession link, and never from staged ally behavior, harmless summons or captive loops -- the GM's (the table counts a hostile creature's Action or Bonus Action that reaches the other side of its Tie).
description: You learn:
- whether the tie is willing, coerced, inherited, possessive, protective, contractual, grief-born, hostile, or concealed;
- whether the tie’s Source CL is lower than, equal to, or higher than yours;
- whether the tie is active, dormant, damaged, false, severed-but-scarred, or externally anchored.
You do not automatically learn names, exact contract terms, hidden motives, complete memories, or protected secrets.
- learn whether it is currently acting to protect, obey, pursue, possess, restore, or abandon the other side;

tianxia.tradition.spirit.knot_weaver.fea.name: Sever the False Thread

effects.evidence: Make a Cultivation Check against the effect's save DC. Success: a lower-Source-CL tie ends; an equal one is suppressed for the scene; a higher one has one expression suppressed until the end of your next turn. Failure: the target gains Advantage on its next saving throw against that tie.

riders: The table severs a Charmed or Frightened a hostile creature imposed; a possession, compulsion, false memory bond, coercive oath expression, hostile sympathetic link, controller-Asset link or other manipulation is the GM's.

An equal-Source-CL tie's restoration (its printed procedure or a Cultivation Check after a Meaningful Intervention), and the failure's lesson (one Anchor, maintenance condition, lawful release or reconstruction route) are the GM's.

Honest Bonds Remain: it does not end a willing relationship, Spirit Companion bond, complete oath, lawful contract, love, lineage, memory of the dead, Foundation or Method. Severance Scar: a fully ended coercive tie can leave a scar visible to Soul Gaze (the GM's).
description: Success:
- An ordinary lower-Source-CL false or coercive tie ends.

- A Restricted or equal-Source-CL tie is suppressed for the scene. Its source may attempt restoration through its printed procedure or a Cultivation Check after one Meaningful Intervention defined in the Normalized Execution Notes.

Sever the False Thread does not automatically end a willing relationship, valid Spirit Companion bond, complete oath, lawful contract, genuine love, lineage, parentage, memory of the dead, Foundation, or Method. It can remove coercion, counterfeit attachment, possession, or an unlawful expression without erasing the underlying people or history.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.knot_weaver.fea.name: Tie the Moment

activation.trigger: A Resonance Marked creature within 60 feet involved in an Observed Tie makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, or willingly moves 10 feet or more

effects.evidence: Cost: 3 Resonance or 1 Knot Tension. Declare the tug before the outcome is finalized.

riders: Denying Advantage granted by the other side of the Tie, and imposing one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect after it targets the other side with a hostile effect, are the GM's; subtracting 1d6 from its attack roll or saving throw, ending its move 10 feet short (it steps back along its path) and pulling it 5 feet back toward the other side are buttons. Ability checks are the GM's to tug.
Counter-Tug: an equal or higher Source-CL target may spend its Reaction on a Charisma save to halve the adjustment or ignore the movement -- the GM's.
Tie the Moment cannot reverse a resolved event, create an attack target that was illegal at declaration, or force a creature to spend a limited resource.
description: Declare the tug before the outcome is finalized. Choose one:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.last_inch_palm..name: Inside Every Guard

effects.evidence: Contact Without Adjacency; Follow the Contact; Open the Gripping Hand (Bonus Action, 2 Resonance).

riders: Contact Without Adjacency also covers ordinary Spiritual Pressure from a Last-Inch feature and one single-target technique that requires spiritual touch -- the GM's; it never makes you adjacent, allows weapon Opportunity Attacks, Help, Grapple or Shove, delivers poison, bypasses total cover or lets another creature target through you.

Follow the Contact after a teleport or conceptual movement, across a sealed boundary, beyond the distance it moved (a Cultivation Check), while you are Grappled or Restrained, or against equal or higher route authority -- the GM's.
Open the Gripping Hand against a bodily possession, swallowing, pin or hold other than Grappled/Restrained, and a higher-authority hold (separation for one Last-Inch feature) -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Second Palm (a second Handspan Subject kept by your Soul Fragment) -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: - Spirit-Touch Unarmed Strikes;
- Nothing Crosses Unanswered;
- Palm Across Emptiness;
- ordinary Spiritual Pressure imposed by a Last-Inch feature;
- does not provoke opportunity attacks from the subject;
- Higher authority: On success, create enough separation to use one Last-Inch feature, but do not automatically end the complete effect unless its own rules permit it.
- One activation chooses one Handspan Subject and one origin.
- Contact Without Adjacency can originate from the fragment for its subject.
- Palm Across Emptiness can originate from the fragment, but you remain the source and pay the cost.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.last_inch_palm..name: Nothing Crosses Unanswered

activation.trigger: Your Handspan Subject within 15 feet targets you or a willing creature adjacent to you with a melee attack, Grapple, Shove, touch-range hostile technique, possession entry, or other effect that requires bodily or spiritual contact

effects.evidence: The subject makes a Wisdom saving throw before the trigger resolves. Failed: increase the required reach by 10 feet. Success: +2 AC. Palm at the Threshold.

riders: The table answers a melee attack; a Grapple, Shove, touch-range hostile technique, possession entry or other contact effect is the GM's (on a failed save the protected creature has Advantage on its check or save against it).
Palm at the Threshold's Spirit-Touch strike counter is the GM's (the table offers Mind Spike one die fewer, a 5-foot shove on a failed Strength or Wisdom save, or a Spiritual Pressure effect).

It does not affect an area effect, internal poison already delivered, a true-name effect, an attack from inside the target or a technique that ignores distance and contact; equal or higher contact, Space, Boundary, possession, divine, artifact or Secret authority can require a Cultivation Check -- the GM's.
description: You can alter the final interval of hostile contact.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.last_inch_palm..name: Palm Across Emptiness

activation.requirement: Line of effect

target.text: Your Handspan Subject or one creature bearing your Resonance Mark

on_fail.evidence: It takes `5d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic or Force damage

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage

riders: Touch the Spirit, Not the Flesh: Suppress one ordinary possession entry, disguise-body relation, external controlling link, or incorporeal passage expression until the end of your next turn
Palm Across Emptiness is not a projectile and does not cross intervening spaces, but it still requires legal line of effect
Draw Into the Palm: bodily, gravity, Space, Boundary, anchoring and higher-authority defenses still need their printed protection procedures.
It cannot target an ordinary object, a spiritually empty corpse or a mindless nonspiritual construct unless it is an external Anchor or a Cultivation Asset.
description: You strike the spiritual fact of contact before the body crosses the intervening space.

Palm Across Emptiness is not a projectile and does not cross intervening spaces, but it still requires legal line of effect. It can pass through an ordinary narrow opening that spiritual contact could cross, but not total cover, a sealed wall, a Domain boundary that denies contact, or an expressly higher-authority separation.

on_fail.evidence: It takes `5d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic or Force damage
Move it to a legal space adjacent to you; a creature at least two size categories larger can make a Strength saving throw to reduce the movement to 10 feet toward you.
becomes your Handspan Subject until the end of the scene

The Far-Side Anchor also ends when exorcised or conceptually reconnected; its Wisdom and Charisma saves and immunity to Poisoned and Disease are the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Near Twin (your Soul Fragment always Near; exchanging places with it) -- the table has no Soul Fragment.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.law_of_near_and.name: Collapse the Interval

description: You make two related points adjacent for one crossing.

A hostile effect that ignores distance, originates inside the target, follows a true-name link or uses a higher relation can force a Cultivation Check instead -- the GM's.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.law_of_near_and.name: Name What Is Near

Far Relation also answers a creature moving toward you (its movement toward you costs double, or on a success 5 feet less Speed) -- the GM's: the table moves a creature along its whole path at once. Against a melee attack it is a button.

A willing subject can end a relation as an Action; an unwilling one makes a Charisma save as an Action to end it -- the GM's. Equal or higher Boundary, Space, Seal, Formation, Thread, Void or conceptual effects can contest a relation.
Permanent Price -- No Ordinary Measure of Home (chosen when the Law is learned) -- a story price, not a combat rule.
