tianxia.tradition.spirit.mudang.feature..name: Grand Mudang Procession

effects.evidence: Create a Grand Spirit Procession, a Huge Spirit Cultivation Asset occupying a 15-foot-square space within 30 feet.

riders: The Procession is an object on one square (its 15-foot space counts for "within 15 feet of the Procession"): its saves, resistances, condition immunities and hovering are the GM's; it moves when you use "Move the Procession" (the text: at the end of each of your turns).

Carry the Living, Reveal the Hidden Court and Beat Back the Intruder (spirits, possessed creatures and incorporeal undead) -- the GM's; Communal Mending against possession or contamination -- the GM's.
Grand Hospitality (lower-CL spirits cannot enter or possess inside it) and the invited spirits' departure -- the GM's.
description: You call a greater manifestation into a moving court of drum, breath, ancestor, and local spirit authority.
- Resistances: Psychic, Necrotic, Radiant
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
Choose one:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mudang.feature..name: Greater Spirit Possession

effects.evidence: Choose one spirit, ghost, incorporeal undead, projected soul, or possessing entity you can perceive: Willing Guest (a Hosted Trait Template) or Unwilling Intruder (a Charisma save: Contained, or Resonance Marked and one Spiritual Pressure effect) -- the GM resolves it.

riders: Greater Spirit Possession works only on a spirit, ghost, incorporeal undead, projected soul or possessing entity -- blocked: the table does not tell spirits apart; the Hosted Trait Templates are in the Procedure Addendum. The button pays its cost; the GM resolves the guest, its Containment saves and Possession Strain.
Soul Splitting -- Second Drum -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: You can host a willing greater spirit, accept a dangerous spirit under negotiated restraint, or temporarily contain an unwilling intruder inside your cultivated body.
- Success: The guest departs cleanly.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mudang.feature..name: Gut of Revealed Guests

effects.evidence: After completing the ten-minute ritual, the focus is a Spirit Anchor with AC your Cultivation Save DC and 5 x Proficiency Bonus Hit Points.

riders: Before the fight, record completion of the ten-minute ritual with its required focus. Spend 4 Resonance to place the focus at your starting space. You can petition spirits, diagnose willing allies once, dismiss the circle, or end hospitality. Destroying the focus ends the circle. You have Advantage on diagnosis and negotiation checks against spirits in the circle; weaker concealment is revealed to your allies when they have a clear view.
Contests against equal or stronger concealment, revealing guests to creatures other than allies, and revealing a speaking guest’s condition are not yet resolved automatically.
description: You can establish a public ritual court in which spirits must either appear, declare concealment, or contest your authority.
Required focus: Drum, bells, cloth streamers, offering table, marked floor, ancestor board, or another recognizable gut instrument
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
- Immunities: Poison, Psychic, and ordinary bodily conditions
Within the Circle:
- Ordinary spirits, ghosts, hosted entities, possessing creatures, projected souls, and incorporeal undead become visible to creatures you designate.
Range: Any spirit in the Gut Circle
Pacification is not domination. Attacking the spirit, breaking declared hospitality, or making an impossible demand ends the restraint immediately.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mudang.feature..name: Possession Trance
riders: Watchful Guest increases Spiritual Sense by 10 feet and gives Advantage on Perception checks involving spirits or possession. Protection against surprise is not yet resolved automatically.
Healing Guest after Spiritual Exorcism or Medicine -- the GM's (the table answers Settling Step and healing actions).
Guest Conduct: the guest's recorded Taboo and Restitution, and a guest leaving when its Taboo is broken -- the GM's.

effects.evidence: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain, and once on each of your turns after moving at least 20 feet, you may move one willing adjacent creature 5 feet with you.
Spiritual Sense +10 feet; Advantage on Perception checks involving spirits or possession; cannot be surprised by a spiritually perceptible creature.

Gain 2 x Proficiency Bonus Temporary Hit Points when the guest enters. Once per round when you or an ally within 10 feet takes Psychic, Necrotic, or Radiant damage, reduce that damage by your Wisdom modifier.
Once on each of your turns when you use Settling Step or another legal healing procedure on a creature, it regains Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus or gains that many Temporary Hit Points.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mudang.feature..name: Spirit Dance
riders: Trance Rhythm from a chant, drumbeat or bell pattern without Spirit Dance, or from a willing spirit accepting an invitation, offering or limitation -- the GM's (the table counts moving 10 feet in the Spirit Dance, a hostile creature failing a save against your Spirit Awakening feature, and a Resonance-spending action that helps another creature).
The next Dance Step is a free button used once on each of your turns (the text chooses it at the start of the turn).
Guiding Step offers only squares no other hostile creature could make an Opportunity Attack on the way to; which creatures are spirits or incorporeal undead is the GM's.
Settling Step against a minor possession symptom -- the GM's.
Divining Step (1 Trance Rhythm: a symbolic impression -- Favorable, Dangerous, Divided, Concealed or Spiritually Contaminated) -- information: the GM tells you.
Spirit-Service Training (Performance or Religion proficiency) is not a combat ability.
description: A protected mystery, Secret Law, divine concealment, or equal- or higher-Source-CL deception can require a Cultivation Check. On failure, you learn that the omen is obscured or contested rather than receiving false certainty.

effects.evidence: Until the start of your next turn, you and one ally within 10 feet gain a bonus equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded up, to the first Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw each makes.
Choose one creature within 30 feet that can perceive your rhythm. It may move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from spirits, incorporeal undead, or creatures Resonance Marked by you.
Choose one willing creature within 10 feet. It may suppress one ordinary Frightened effect or one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect until the start of your next turn.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mushroom_dreamw.name: Fruiting Body of the Dream

effects.evidence: A 30-foot-radius Spirit Awakening field surrounds you and moves with you.

riders: Mycelial Nodes are planted by a 1-minute rite before a fight -- blocked: the table places none, so everything "from you or a Mycelial Node" is measured from you. The Fruiting Heart on a Node and the Fruiting Body Asset are therefore blocked too.
Blindsight against sleeping, hallucinating, possessed or spiritually contaminated creatures -- the GM's (the table answers poisoned, frightened, charmed and Resonance Marked creatures).
The restoration's dream-haunted or grief-based effects, and its exclusions for harmless, summoned or looping sources -- the GM's.
Shared Root-Dream while awake (a rest) is not a combat ability. Dream-Corpse Fruiting (once, 6 Resonance: Merciful, Memory or Grave Fruiting of a three-marked creature at 0 HP) -- the GM's.
description: Your soul blooms as the visible fruiting body of a vast hidden dream-network.
While the field persists:
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mushroom_dreamw.name: Hallucinogenic Bloom

effects.evidence: When a hostile creature enters the Bloom for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.
The area is lightly obscured to hostile creatures and difficult terrain for them.

riders: Mycelial Nodes are planted by a 1-minute rite before a fight -- blocked: the table places none, so everything "from you or a Mycelial Node" is measured from you. The Blooming Node Anchor (a Bloom without Concentration) is therefore blocked too.
Lightly obscured for hostile creatures (Disadvantage on their Perception checks that rely on sight) -- the GM's.
Lost Trail's "cannot willingly move closer to a creature you designate", Borrowed Forest's afterimage target, and Spore Communion's information -- the GM's.
description: You cause the hidden dream-network to fruit across the battlefield.
The area fills with luminous spores, impossible mushrooms, false roots, remembered voices, and damp dream-light. It is lightly obscured to hostile creatures and difficult terrain for them.
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mushroom_dreamw.name: Mycelial Dream
riders: Mycelial Nodes are planted by a 1-minute rite before a fight -- blocked: the table places none, so everything "from you or a Mycelial Node" is measured from you.

Spore Touch's learning (whether it is sleeping, poisoned, frightened, charmed, dream-haunted, grief-strained, possessed or contaminated; on a success, its Poison/Psychic immunity or resistance and higher protection) -- information: the GM tells you.
Shared Root-Dream (during a rest, meditation or sleep rite) and touching a sleeping unwilling creature are not combat abilities.
description: You can join minds through a hidden root-dream.
For the duration of the rest or rite:
- participants communicate through images, sensations, remembered places, and spoken dream-language;
- a participant may refuse any memory or image and may leave the dream at any time by waking or ending meditation.

on_fail.evidence: Place one Dream-Spore Mark on it

effects.evidence: It makes a Constitution saving throw.

options.label: Spore Touch on a willing creature

effects.evidence: A willing creature may fail automatically: Place one Dream-Spore Mark on it.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mushroom_dreamw.name: Spore Murmur
riders: Mycelial Nodes are planted by a 1-minute rite before a fight -- blocked: the table places none, so everything "from you or a Mycelial Node" is measured from you.
The Psychic damage option affects poison-immune creatures with a mind or spirit; the GM confirms that physiology. Mindless creatures cannot receive False Forest or Drowsing Root.

on_fail.evidence: It takes 4d8 + Wisdom modifier Poison damage
suffers one of the following Murmurs until the start of your next turn. Hyphal Spread.
Place one Dream-Spore Mark on it

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage and gains no mark or Murmur.

effects.evidence: Choose one creature. It makes a Constitution saving throw.

on_fail.evidence: It takes 4d8 + Wisdom modifier Psychic damage
suffers one of the following Murmurs until the start of your next turn. Hyphal Spread.
Place one Dream-Spore Mark on it

on_success.evidence: It takes half damage and gains no mark or Murmur.

effects.evidence: Choose one creature. It makes a Constitution saving throw.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.mushroom_dreamw.name: Under-Root Memory
riders: Under-Root Memory is a 10-minute ritual (three questions answered as sensory impressions) -- not a combat action.
Rootline Passage (Bonus Action, 2 Resonance: travel between two connected Mycelial Nodes after the ritual) -- blocked: the table has no Mycelial Nodes.
description: You can consult the network of decay, roots, corpse-soil, and dream residue beneath a place.
Ask up to three questions concerning creatures, deaths, strong emotions, dreams, poisons, burials, spiritual disturbances, or significant passages through the area during the previous seven days.
The answers arrive as sensory and symbolic impressions:
- taste, smell, pressure, temperature, direction, rhythm, color, emotion, dream image, or decay pattern;
- the broad number and nature of significant creatures;
- whether death, violence, fear, grief, poison, possession, dream influence, or spiritual contamination occurred;
- a remembered direction or route through connected organic terrain.
Under-Root Memory does not provide exact dialogue, hidden statistics, secure names, complete chronology, or knowledge that left no meaningful organic, spiritual, or dream residue.

Sterile metal, purified stone, burned earth, divine wards, Secret concealment, spatial severance, or a stronger anti-divination Source Rule can block or distort the network. On a failed Cultivation Check against such concealment, you learn that the memory was deliberately interrupted and one broad category of interruption.
- You may carry worn and held equipment.
- An effect blocking teleportation, route travel, dream passage, or the intervening spiritual ecology can prevent the passage.
- Destroying either Node ends that route.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.plain_truth_fis.name: Deed Follows Word

activation.requirement: You have at least 1 Credence

riders: Pursuit's "its voluntary movement away from you costs 2 feet for every 1 foot moved" -- the GM's.

Break against an Asset, Anchor, barrier or object (+2d8 Force), and suppressing an equal-authority expression -- the GM's (the table ends a lower creature's Concentration on a successful Cultivation Check).
Redirecting the attack when the declaration became impossible -- the GM's.
description: You compress Credence into one declared martial deed.

effects.evidence: Challenge: the named hostile creature; on a hit it becomes Resonance Marked for the scene and has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you.
Pursuit: the named hostile creature; on a hit, move to a legal space adjacent to the target after damage.
Guard: one hostile creature that threatened the named protected subject; on a hit the subject gains Temporary Hit Points, may move 10 feet and gains Advantage on its next Int/Wis/Cha save.
Break: the named creature maintaining the effect; on a hit, a Cultivation Check against its Concentration.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.plain_truth_fis.name: Hall of Spoken Deeds

effects.evidence: A 40-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can perceive within 60 feet: your Hall of Spoken Deeds Domain.
The Hall manifests a visible Witness Stone in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of its center.

riders: Willing Declarations: an ally's Break, and the benefit "add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll made as part of the deed" -- the GM's (the table offers Challenge, Pursuit, Guard and Hold, and the move, Temporary Hit Point and save benefits).
Hostile Intention's successful save also tells you the broad category of its first intention -- information: the GM tells you.

Final Pronouncement is a free button once during the Hall (the text names no action). Do Not Flee (Speed halved moving away; no teleporting out) and Speak the Deed, Release against a possession, Asset command, stolen object or coercive effect, and the authority limits -- the GM's.
The Witness Stone's saves and Psychic resistance, and an adjacent creature's Action to suppress Hostile Intention for itself -- the GM's. Domain Collision -- the GM's.
description: You manifest a Domain in which every combatant's first purpose becomes visible enough for heaven to judge its consistency.
The sphere is your Hall of Spoken Deeds Domain.
You gain 1 Credence the first time each round that:
- you complete an Open Declaration in the Hall; or
- Release What Is Not Yours: It must release one ordinary Grapple, possession expression, controlled Asset command, stolen object, or maintained coercive effect of your choice.
- Speak the Deed: It must state the broad purpose of one active technique, Domain, Asset, Anchor, or transformation it is maintaining.
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.plain_truth_fis.name: Heaven Rejects the Feint

effects.evidence: Call the False Form: state one claim and make a Cultivation Check against the concealment or control -- the GM tells you whether it is true and which false-target benefit is suppressed.

riders: Call the False Form's claim, check and suppression -- the GM's (the button pays its cost).
Unbroken Word's 5-foot move toward completion after a success -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Witness to the Word -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: - moving you against your will;
- concealing or replacing the declared subject;
- suppressing the movement or Martial Strike required by the declaration.
- “This is not the true body.”
- “This appearance conceals another identity.”
Make a Cultivation Check against the relevant concealment or control Source Rule.
- Failure: Learn only that the claim could not be established. You do not learn whether it was false or protected.
Call the False Form does not reveal exact location through total concealment, dispel an illusion, sever possession, or expose a Secret identity without the required authority.
- You may originate Unspoken Intention or Call the False Form from yourself or the fragment.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.plain_truth_fis.name: Unspoken Intention Made Visible

activation.trigger: A meaningful hostile creature bearing your Resonance Mark begins its turn within 60 feet

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: it chooses one Intent. Contradiction. Successful Save: one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.

riders: Contradiction's "incompatible voluntary movement costs 2 feet for every 1 foot moved" -- the GM's (the table moves a creature along its whole path at once).

The Intent's named subject may also be an object or a space -- the GM's (the table offers creatures). A successful save's information (attack, movement, technique, defense or escape) -- the GM tells you.
description: - proceed and suffer Contradiction.
When it suffers Contradiction:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.plain_truth_fis.name: Word and Hand

effects.evidence: You gain Open Declaration and Credence. Truth-Forged Strike.

riders: Open Declaration: a Guard also completes when your Reaction or feature reduces, redirects or contests a hostile effect against it, when you Ready while it is threatened, or when you move it -- the GM's; a Break against an Asset, Anchor, barrier, weapon or other Source Rule -- the GM's (the table names a creature holding Concentration, a Grapple or a Restraint).

A declaration against a harmless object, willing ally, staged attack or defeated effect grants no Credence, and voluntarily contradicting it before completing it breaks it and costs 1 Credence -- the GM's.
Honest Posture (Advantage on Insight and Cultivation Checks to identify a feint, false target, illusion or controller) -- the GM's.
description: Honest Posture does not see through every illusion or reveal protected facts automatically. Equal or higher concealment still contests.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.seraphic_molter.name: Burn Away the Lesser Self
riders: Burning away a dream influence, emotional corruption, possession symptom, minor curse or spiritual contamination -- the GM's.
A creature targeting the Cast-Off as an Anchor for the removed effect, the effect returning on reintegration, and the strengthened effect counting as one Source CL higher -- the GM's.
description: You can shed an affliction into a temporary spiritual cast-off.
Choose one effect on yourself:
- one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect;
- one ordinary dream influence;
- one ordinary emotional corruption;
- one ordinary or lower-Source-CL possession symptom;
- one minor curse or spiritual contamination.
The removed or suppressed burden becomes a Cast-Off Self in an adjacent space:
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
- Immunities: Poison, Psychic, and ordinary bodily conditions
While the Cast-Off exists:

effects.evidence: Optional cost: Gain 1 Molt Debt to strengthen the result. Choose one effect on yourself: Charmed. The removed or suppressed burden becomes a Cast-Off Self in an adjacent space.
Optional cost: Gain 1 Molt Debt to strengthen the result. Choose one effect on yourself: Frightened. The removed or suppressed burden becomes a Cast-Off Self in an adjacent space.
Optional cost: Gain 1 Molt Debt to strengthen the result. Choose one effect on yourself: Poisoned. The removed or suppressed burden becomes a Cast-Off Self in an adjacent space.
Optional cost: Gain 1 Molt Debt to strengthen the result. Choose one effect on yourself: Spiritual Pressure. The removed or suppressed burden becomes a Cast-Off Self in an adjacent space.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.seraphic_molter.name: Eyes in the Wings

effects.evidence: Your Spiritual Sense range increases by 30 feet. Pinion Witness. Sensory Overgrowth.

riders: Using Spiritual Sense from the squares your Wingless Ascent passed, knowing when a creature looks at or targets you, and Pinion Trace's Soul Gaze answers -- information: the GM tells you.
Pinion Witness when a creature projects its soul, changes shape or crosses a spiritual boundary -- the GM's (the table answers teleporting and becoming invisible).
description: Open impossible eyes across your spiritual wings, shadows, halo scars, and reflected surfaces.
While this feature lasts:
While the Trace lasts, Soul Gaze can determine:
- the broad direction of its movement;
- whether it remains on the same plane;
- whether its current form is the same spiritual identity;
- whether a stronger Source Rule severed or concealed the trace.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.seraphic_molter.name: First Molt

effects.evidence: Choose one Minor Seraphic Sign when you gain this feature.

riders: Your Sign is chosen before the fight (the sheet does not record it); changing it happens during a Full Cultivation Session.

Glass-Eye Sign's Insight Advantage, Halo-Bruise Sign's Psychic resistance against dreams, fear, possession or Spiritual Pressure, Second-Voice Sign's proficiency, Many-Shadow Sign's information, and Molt Recognition -- the GM's.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.seraphic_molter.name: Molt the Mortal Name

effects.evidence: Cost: 10 Resonance and 1 Molt Debt. Manifest a complete Seraphic Ascension Form. Choose two Ascension Anatomies when the form begins and a third when you reach half your Hit Point maximum or lower.

riders: Specific anti-flight or anti-spirit exceptions to Throne Wings' opportunity protection, Thousand Eyes' surprise protection, and Mercyless Purity against possession, curse, disease, contamination or emotional corruption still need adjudication.

Death and the Shed Name against being displaced from your body or having your soul imprisoned; the Husk's reintegration Molt Debt, the Permanent Seraphic Sign and identity-reconstruction procedure -- the GM's.
End of the Form (one cost when it ends) and the Authority limits -- the GM's.
description: You shed the layer of identity by which ordinary death, weakness, and mortal limitation recognize you.
The Husk appears in an adjacent space with:
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
- Immunities: Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Necrotic, and ordinary bodily conditions
When the form ends, choose one cost:

Secret-Law erasure, divine custody, artifact imprisonment, tribulation destruction, voluntary surrender of identity, and equal- or higher-authority soul destruction can contest the Husk and Ascension Form through their printed procedures. Molting is not universal immortality.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.seraphic_molter.name: Wingless Ascent

effects.evidence: Unfold incomplete spiritual wings. At the start of each of your turns, choose one mode.

riders: Ascending Beat (a fly Speed for the turn) and Folding Glide (across liquids, gaps and walls) -- the GM's: the table has no flying or climbing. Their extra Resonance after three Ascending Beats -- the GM's.
Torn Wings -- the GM's.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.name: Lord of the Dead

effects.evidence: Create a Warden-Wraith, a Large Spirit Cultivation Asset in an unoccupied space within 30 feet.

riders: The Warden-Wraith is an object on one square (its 10-foot space counts for "within 10 feet"); its flight, saves, resistances and immunities are the GM's; it moves with "Move the Warden-Wraith" (the text: at the end of each of your turns).

Warden's Scythe against a spirit or undead (no Reactions), Chain the Departing, Open the Proper Gate, Procession of Witnesses and Burial Silence -- the GM's. The table does not tell spirits, ghosts, undead or possessed creatures apart; their parts are the GM's.
Jurisdiction of the Dead (lower undead cannot attack you; knowing deaths; twice PB Soul Fragments while it lasts) and Final Custody -- the GM's.
Forbidden Consequences (Grave Debt for consuming, enslaving or obstructing souls) -- the GM's.
description: You establish temporary jurisdiction over the dead in the scene and manifest a warden-wraith built from your cultivated office.
- Resistances: Psychic, Necrotic, Radiant
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL

- Open the Proper Gate: Release one willing spirit, end one ordinary lower-Source-CL coercive binding, or permit one soul under Death Custody to depart through the correct afterlife, reincarnation, ancestor court, or Soul Anchor route. Equal or higher custody requires a Cultivation Check.
While the Warden-Wraith exists:
- You may maintain a number of Soul Fragments equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus for the activation’s duration.
Final Custody is not permanent soul destruction. Equal- or higher-Source-CL targets use their printed escape procedures and may force a Cultivation Check contest.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.name: Raise Specter

effects.evidence: Raise a scene-duration specter; native summon compiles its placement, stats and owner expressions.

riders: Testify reproduces information held by the fragment; the GM provides that memory.
Soul Splitting — Twin Custody still requires the GM to use a Soul Fragment as the expression’s origin.
description: - Size: Medium
- Resistances: Psychic and Necrotic
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
- Testify: The specter reproduces one memory, route, image, or statement contained in the spent fragment. Protected information remains limited to what the fragment held.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.name: Soul Drain and Death Custody
riders: Preventing Cultivation Point recovery, becoming incorporeal, possessing or returning to a vessel, and the success's spiritual concealment remain the GM's.
Death Custody's outcomes (release, healing, transfer, interrogation, a Coerced fragment with Grave Debt) and authority contests -- the GM's.
Warden's Reversal (Reaction, 1 Soul Fragment: an ally's soul would be displaced, consumed, trapped or converted) -- the GM's: the table has no such effects.
description: - Release it to die or depart normally.
- Permit legal healing.
- Transfer custody to a willing healer, funerary authority, or prepared vessel.
Equal- or higher-authority death claims, divine custody, Secret Laws, Samsara, or artifacts can contest Death Custody with Source CL and their printed procedures.

effects.evidence: Choose one creature. It makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: 6d8 + Wisdom modifier damage; it cannot regain Hit Points. Capture at the Brink.
Choose one creature. It makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: 6d8 + Wisdom modifier damage; it cannot regain Hit Points. Capture at the Brink.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.name: Soul Harvest

activation.trigger: A meaningful creature dies within 30 feet, an undead or spirit is destroyed within 30 feet, or a willing spirit within 30 feet deliberately gives you a fragment

effects.evidence: Create one Soul Fragment from the triggering source, subject to your maximum. A Coerced fragment from a nonhostile creature gains 1 Grave Debt. Fragment Uses.

riders: The table does not tell spirits, ghosts, undead or possessed creatures apart; their parts are the GM's. The table treats a creature's defeat as its death, and a fallen ally is asked whether it gives its fragment freely.
An unwilling soul's successful save tells you whether it is departing, claimed, reincarnating, concealed or bound -- information: the GM tells you.

Fragment Uses: Advantage on one Soul Gaze, Speak with the Dead or Cultivation Check involving death, and preventing a spirit's concealment -- the GM's. Whether a Coerced fragment was consumed out of necessity (no Grave Debt) -- the GM's.
description: You can catch a fragment at the moment a meaningful soul sheds residue.
Create one Soul Fragment from the triggering source, subject to your maximum.
As a Bonus Action, spend one Soul Fragment for one benefit:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.name: Speak with the Dead
riders: Speak with the Dead is a 1-minute ritual (questions answered by corpse memory) and Funerary Reading grants a proficiency -- not combat abilities.
description: You can awaken corpse memory or lingering residue without importing a spell’s fixed assumptions.
The corpse or residue can resist if:
- Its funeral rites prohibit questioning.
- Its soul or memory is sealed.
- Another authority claims custody.
- It died under Secret, divine, artifact, or higher-Source-CL concealment.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soulstring_danc.name: Dance of Borrowed Limbs

activation.requirement: The target bears at least two Choreography Strings

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Consume one String. At the start of each of the target's turns, choose one command.

riders: The commands to make a weapon attack at Disadvantage against a target you choose, and speak or keep silent, still need manual resolution. The game applies Speed, a 10-foot move, Prone, the Reaction gesture and dropping one removable held object.
Control Boundary and the forced harmless choreography of a much lower creature after three failed saves -- the GM's.
description: - drop one held object that is not soul-bound or inseparably attached;

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soulstring_danc.name: Marionette Defense

activation.trigger: You are hit by an attack while a creature bearing one of your Choreography Strings is within 30 feet

effects.evidence: Choose one String-bearing creature within the triggering attack's legal target geometry. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Dance Partner.

riders: On a failed save the attack is turned from you with its original roll; the GM applies that roll to the chosen creature (the table cannot move an attack to another target after it hits) and Dance Partner's Resistance.
Redirecting a line, area or other geometry, and the limits on illegal targets, extra resources and precise effects -- the GM's.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soulstring_danc.name: Stolen Rhythm

activation.requirement: The target bears at least one Choreography String

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Consume one String and choose two effects until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: choose one effect. Catch the Beat.

riders: Resolve the Help and movement-mode restrictions by hand. The game applies Speed, Reactions, weapon-attack Disadvantage, and the additional 5 feet required to stand or change elevation.
Catch the Beat against teleporting or being moved by another source -- the GM's.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soulstring_danc.name: Theater of Strings

effects.evidence: Create a 30-foot-radius Theater of Strings field centered on you. It moves with you.
Hostile String-bearing creatures cannot take Opportunity Attacks against you. Final Choreography.

riders: Resolve any motion trigger that does not produce movement, an attack, standing or falling Prone by hand. These recorded transitions can move another String bearer once per round.
You and willing allies still need to apply ignoring the first 10 feet of difficult terrain each turn by hand. Standing within the field costs 5 feet automatically.
Final Choreography's Crossed Blades (a weapon attack with its Reaction at a target you choose) and higher creatures' Cultivation Check contests -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Second Dancer -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: You transform the battlefield into a stage whose rhythm is spiritually legible to you.
While active:
Failed Save: Consume all three Strings. Choose one sequence:
Your Soul Fragment gains the following Subpath Fragment option:
The fragment does not place Strings, consume Strings, or use Final Choreography.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soulstring_danc.name: Threaded Step

effects.evidence: Place one Choreography String and move it 5 feet in a direction of your choice. Dancer's Counterstep.

riders: Threaded Step answers a failed save against your Spirit Awakening feature (Mind Spike included); "when you hit a creature with Mind Spike" is that failed save at the table.
The 5-foot move of a creature larger than Large, into an obviously lethal hazard, and a Strength save instead of Wisdom -- the GM's.
Removing Strings through cleansing, identity stabilization or movement-freedom effects -- the GM's (a bearer's Action to shake one off is a button).
description: - This is forced movement and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..name: Break Their Will

activation.trigger: A meaningful hostile creature within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points, surrenders, becomes Incapacitated through one of your Spirit Awakening effects, or fails a saving throw against Commanding Voice

effects.evidence: Submission Shock (Reaction, 1 Mandate). Command the Marked: spend 1 Mandate instead of 1 Resonance.

riders: Submission Shock's surrender and "becomes Incapacitated through one of your Spirit Awakening effects" triggers, and whether the second creature can perceive the collapse -- the GM's (the table answers a defeat and a failed save against Commanding Voice).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..name: Commanding Voice
riders: Approach and Flee move the creature at the start of its turn along the table's path, without Opportunity Attacks (the GM may rule a route unsafe); Approach's point is you or an ally you name.

Confirm that the target can hear you or perceive your authority and that the command is possible. It cannot force self-harm, a limited Secret or artifact resource, or unknown information. Drop removes one held object on the commanded turn, and Kneel prevents standing until that turn ends.
Voice of Office (Wisdom for commanding Persuasion or Intimidation checks) is not a combat ability.
The "(1 Mandate)" button is Break Their Will's Command the Marked: only against a creature bearing your Resonance Mark.
description: - Drop: Drop one held object that is not fused to the body or protected by a stronger Source Rule.

effects.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Approach) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Flee) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Halt) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Kneel) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Silence) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Yield) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target follows the command (Drop) on its next turn; it becomes Resonance Marked by you and you gain 1 Mandate.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..name: Edict of Heaven

effects.evidence: Declare one clear edict and choose any number of creatures within range. Each target makes a Charisma saving throw. Mandate of Clarity.

riders: No Passage's designated threshold, and creatures that cannot hear or perceive you -- the GM's (the table forbids teleporting).

An equal- or higher-Source-CL target contesting with a Domain, throne, true name or oath (a Cultivation Check), and the limits on what an edict may forbid -- the GM's. Mandate of Clarity -- information: the GM tells you.
description: You impose one local law upon the conduct of lesser wills.
Choose one printed edict:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..name: Hegemon’s Domain

effects.evidence: When you activate Domain Manifestation, you may spend 4 additional Resonance to transform it into Hegemon's Domain. Court of Submission. Absolute Edict.

riders: Court of Submission asks that the creature perceive you or one of your spiritual Assets -- the GM's. Lesser-Realm Command and Equal Thrones -- the GM's.
Price of Tyranny (Soul Anchor Strain and Tyranny Restitution) -- the GM's.
description: Your Domain becomes a court in which your authority is locally real.
While active:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..name: Retainer of the Empty Throne

effects.evidence: Manifest the Retainer in an unoccupied space within 30 feet.

riders: Creating the Retainer (a 1-hour rite with a willing or surrendered soul, an office or a relic) happens before the fight; the table assumes you hold one.
The Retainer is an object on one square: its flight, resistances and immunities are the GM's; it moves with "Move the Retainer" (the text: at the end of your turn).
Herald (Commanding Voice or Edict of Heaven from the Retainer) -- blocked: the table measures every technique from its user. Counsel (a check with Advantage) -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Twin Heralds -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: You can preserve a loyal, surrendered, or lawfully accepted soul-impression as a spiritual retainer. This Restricted expression is not automatic soul imprisonment.
- The final acknowledged surrender of a meaningful foe whose soul is free to refuse.
- A lawful ancestral, institutional, or spiritual office whose previous holder accepts succession.
- A relic containing a consenting residual personality or office-imprint.
You may maintain one Retainer at a time. It is a Spirit Cultivation Asset attached to your Soul Anchor.
Duration: The scene
- Size: Medium or smaller.
- Source CL: Your effective Spirit Awakening CL.
- Resistances: Psychic and Necrotic.
- Herald: Extend the audible or spiritually perceptible origin of Commanding Voice or Edict of Heaven from the Retainer.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.thrum_of_the_gr.name: Burial Drum

effects.evidence: A 20-foot-radius aura centered on you. When a hostile creature in the aura would regain Hit Points, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. Beat of Interment (1 Gravebeat).

riders: Hostile creatures treating the aura as difficult terrain while moving closer to you -- the GM's (the table cannot tell a step toward you from one away).
Burial Drum deals Necrotic extra damage to labelled Undead, Possessed or Death-sustained creatures, or a marked, Frightened or Dying creature. Choosing Psychic instead remains the GM's.
Beat of Interment on a creature at 0 Hit Points (a failed death save instead) and the Burial Marker Anchor (the aura on a planted marker without Concentration) -- the GM's.
description: You establish a rhythm in which healing, courage, and false immortality struggle to take hold.
While the Burial Drum persists:
- The aura moves with you.
You may plant a drum, staff, weapon, bell, grave tablet, banner, bone stake, or spiritual marker in an adjacent space as a Burial Marker Anchor:
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL

tianxia.tradition.spirit.thrum_of_the_gr.name: Call the Unquiet

activation.requirement: A corpse, grave, battlefield, death-haunted object, or at least 2 Gravebeats

effects.evidence: Create one Unquiet Echo in an unoccupied space adjacent to the source. Grave Cry (1 Gravebeat).

riders: The requirement (a corpse, grave, battlefield, death-haunted object, or 2 Gravebeats) is met by the fight's battlefield at the table.

The Echo's saving throws, moving through creatures and objects, damage for ending inside one, and moving when you move still need manual resolution. Its Necrotic and Psychic Resistances apply automatically; Direct the Unquiet Echo moves it.

Soldier's March still needs manual resolution for Dead March originating from the Echo and its additional 10 feet. Grave Keeper automatically grants death-save Advantage to allies within 10 feet of the Echo. Its protection against soul removal and a willing soul shaping the Echo still need manual resolution.
description: You call forth the pressure and memory of death without claiming permanent custody of a soul.
Create one Unquiet Echo in an unoccupied space adjacent to the source. You can maintain only one Unquiet Echo at a time.
The Echo is a Medium Cultivation Asset:
- Source CL: your effective Spirit Awakening CL
The Echo carries one Death Memory chosen when created:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.thrum_of_the_gr.name: Dead March

effects.evidence: It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one March. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet. Processional Chain: spend up to 2 Gravebeats.

riders: The target must be Resonance Marked, undead, a movable haunt, or standing on earth, stone, grave-soil or a battlefield -- the table takes any creature on the ground.
The forced moves follow the table's path (the GM rules out lethal hazards, boundaries, teleportation and flight).
description: Failed Save: Choose one March:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.thrum_of_the_gr.name: Gravebeat

effects.evidence: While Gravebeat persists: once per turn add your Proficiency Bonus to Psychic or Necrotic damage to a Resonance Marked hostile creature; mark a creature near one that becomes Bloodied or drops. You gain 1 Gravebeat when a marked hostile creature becomes Bloodied.

riders: Gravebeats from disturbing or laying to rest a corpse or grave, and from a failed death saving throw, still need adjudication. The table counts a labelled undead, haunt or possessed enemy failing your save, a marked foe becoming Bloodied, a foe's defeat and healing refused by Burial Drum.

Sensing corpses, undead, dying creatures and death magic within 30 feet, and your spiritually audible rhythm, require information supplied by the GM. Dismiss Gravebeat by hand; it ends automatically when you become Unconscious.
Hear the Burial (Action, 1 Resonance: the time, manner and nature of a death) -- information: the GM tells you.
description: You begin the rhythm that every corpse remembers.
While Gravebeat persists:
- Your footsteps, weapon impacts, heartbeat, voice, drum, bell, staff, or another chosen rhythm become spiritually audible to creatures you can spiritually perceive.
- approximate time and manner of death;
- whether the death was ordinary, cursed, sacrificial, possessed, divine, artifact-caused, tribulation-caused, or otherwise unusual.
This is diagnosis, not corpse testimony. It does not create dialogue or summon the dead.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.thrum_of_the_gr.name: The Earth Beats Once

activation.requirement: A Bloodied or Resonance Marked hostile creature standing on or touching earth, stone, grave-soil, a structure, or a battlefield surface

riders: The consequences suppressing regeneration or death prevention, and the undead/possessed save Disadvantage -- the GM's.
Touching the same continuous surface (the table takes the battlefield floor) and Lower-Realm Interment -- the GM's.
description: You strike the grave-rhythm beneath a living body and make the whole battlefield answer.

effects.evidence: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Spend up to 3 Gravebeats. Battlefield Afterbeat.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Spend up to 3 Gravebeats. Battlefield Afterbeat.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.unwritten_footp.name: Concept of the Missing Footstep

effects.evidence: A 40-foot-radius aura centered on you: the Unwritten Procession. Unrecorded Movement. Cut Action From Witness. Empty Space Assassination.

riders: "Unnoticed" at the table: the creature does not notice you (it bears your Unnoticing condition, or you are Hidden); what it perceives, remembers or can communicate is the GM's. Unnoticing from Unrecorded Movement lasts until you deal it damage or end your turn (unless you are Hidden: cover and concealment are the GM's).
Cut Action From Witness's memory choices, touching, interacting with objects or crossing wards -- the GM's (the table offers the Unwritten Trace and lost Reactions after you damage a creature).
Empty Space Assassination with another single-target Spirit Awakening technique -- the GM's (the table offers Mind Spike and a weapon attack). The World Notices the Wound -- the GM's.
description: You unfold a domain in which movement and witness no longer possess a reliable relationship.
The area becomes an Unwritten Procession.
- it remembers the result but not your identity as the source;
- it remembers your involvement but not the route or method;
This capstone does not remove you from history, records, names, karmic consequences, or the memories of creatures outside the Domain.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.unwritten_footp.name: Knife Between Thoughts

activation.trigger: A traced creature targets you with an attack or single-target hostile technique

effects.evidence: Between-Thought Strike: spend 2 Resonance before the roll. Misattribute the Blow: move 10 feet; the target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

riders: The game prevents Reactions aimed at you after Between-Thought Strike. Its restrictions on communicating your exact location or giving another creature a targeting benefit still need manual resolution.
Misattribute the Blow's false source (your former position, an afterimage, a shadow) is flavor; the table resolves the save's result.
description: On a hit or failed save:
Misattribute the Blow consumes the trace.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.unwritten_footp.name: No Trace Returns

activation.trigger: A creature notices you, a ward identifies you, a tracking effect acquires your trail, or an attack targets you

effects.evidence: Erase the Last Passage: move up to half your Speed by spiritual step, then choose one result. Ghost Through the Hold.

riders: Erase the Last Passage when a creature notices you, a ward identifies you or tracking acquires your trail -- the GM's (the table answers an attack on you).
False Trail and Blank Interval -- the GM's; passing through ordinary cover (not sealed barriers) -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- False Author -- the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: Your movement can leave behind an explanation that excludes you.
Then choose one result:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.unwritten_footp.name: Steal the Witness

effects.evidence: It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: You become Unwritten to the target. Successful Save: Place an Unwritten Trace on it and remove its Reactions until the start of its next turn.

riders: Treating your spaces as empty, not communicating your location, and repeat saves on a Grapple, touch or spoken declaration -- the GM's (the table gives the repeat save when you attack it or target it with a technique).
Creatures without a mind, hive minds, wards and higher perfect witnesses contesting it -- the GM's.
description: While you are Unwritten to it:
- area effects and actions chosen without targeting you can still affect you normally;

tianxia.tradition.spirit.unwritten_footp.name: Step No Record Keeps

effects.evidence: It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Place an Unwritten Trace on it; you are unnoticed by that creature until the start of your next turn. After resolving Slip the Conclusion, you may move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target. Ambush Without Hatred.

riders: "Unnoticed" at the table: the creature does not notice you (it bears your Unnoticing condition, or you are Hidden); what it perceives, remembers or can communicate is the GM's.
Slip the Conclusion's "can perceive you", touching or addressing it (the table counts damaging or targeting it), and the success's direction -- the GM's.
Ambush Without Hatred's rule against staged concealment -- the GM's.
Trace-Eating Passage (no mundane trail) is not a combat ability.
description: This does not hide major destruction, opened locks, moved bodies, active techniques, obvious blood loss, displaced water, broken wards, or evidence you intentionally leave. Trained spiritual tracking can contest your concealment with a Cultivation Check.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.well_of_hours.f.name: Borrowed Second

effects.evidence: Choose one option. The ordinary options create 1 Time Debt. The weapon-attack and Mind Spike options create 2 Time Debt. Pay the Second Back: remove 2 Time Debt.

riders: Drawing, stowing, picking up, handing off or working an ordinary object, and Spiritual Sense -- the GM's (the table offers Slip Away, Rise and Step, Disengage, Search, Soul Gaze on a hostile creature, Weapon Strike and Mind Spike).
Borrowed Second's limits on Domains, Assets, Forged Techniques, item powers and extra-turn effects -- the table's options include none of them; its use during another effect's extra turn -- the GM's.
Pay the Second Back: involuntary movement still moves you (the table only stops your own).
description: Choose one option:
- draw, stow, pick up, hand off, open, close, or manipulate one ordinary object;
- use Spiritual Sense or Soul Gaze;
Borrowed Second cannot:
- activate a Domain;
- activate Soul Vessel, Soul Splitting, or another feature that creates a separately acting Asset;
- activate a full multi-packet Forged Technique;
Until the start of your next turn:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.well_of_hours.f.name: Hourglass Mark

effects.evidence: It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The creature gains your Hourglass Mark. Successful Save: one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect. Spend 1 Resonance and gain 1 Time Debt to apply the corresponding delay.

riders: Delayed Movement (15 feet less for a move it begins) -- blocked: the table has no checkpoint before a creature's own move (movement is committed whole in gate2_engine, a saved-fight lock file).
Delayed Reaction (its Reaction waits until the trigger resolves) -- blocked: the table resolves a Reaction where it is triggered.
Break the Glass by a Time, Fate, Spirit, Clock, Sound, anti-curse or severance effect -- the GM's (the table offers the Action with Arcana, Insight, Sleight of Hand or a Cultivation Check).
description: - Intelligence (Arcana);
- Wisdom (Insight);
- Dexterity (Sleight of Hand);
- a Cultivation Check using an appropriate Source Rule.
On a success, the Hourglass Mark ends. Time, Fate, Spirit, Clock, Sound, anti-curse, and suitable conceptual severance effects can qualify.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.well_of_hours.f.name: Refuse the Moment

activation.trigger: You or a creature you can perceive within 30 feet would take damage, gain a condition from a failed saving throw, be forcibly moved, become Grappled or Restrained, become Unconscious, or be reduced to 0 Hit Points by a non-damage effect

effects.evidence: Defer one discrete consequence of the triggering event. The deferred consequence arrives at the end of the protected creature's next turn. Time Debt: 2.

riders: Deferring forced movement, a command or possession impulse, or being set to 0 Hit Points by an effect that deals no damage -- the GM's (the table defers damage, a condition from a failed save, and becoming Grappled, Restrained or Unconscious).
Answering a deferred condition early with a cleansing, exorcism, counter-technique or escape -- the GM's.
Authority Limits: a Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact or other higher consequence needs a Cultivation Check (failed: not delayed, Resonance spent, 1 Time Debt) -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Hold This Breath -- blocked: the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: You place one consequence beside the present and demand that it wait.
Defer one discrete consequence of the triggering event. Valid examples include:
- one instance of forced movement;
You can maintain only one Deferred Consequence from Well of Hours at a time. Creating another releases the first immediately before the new consequence is deferred.

A Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact, heavenly-law, Foundation-breaking, Method-breaking, permanent, soul-consuming, or explicitly outside-time consequence requires a Cultivation Check against the originating Source Rule.
On a failed contest:
- the consequence is not delayed;
Refuse the Moment cannot:
- undo a completed severance, destroyed Asset, broken Foundation, or consumed soul;
- reverse an event whose Source Rule resolves outside time;

tianxia.tradition.spirit.well_of_hours.f.name: Ripple of Before

activation.trigger: You roll Initiative, become Surprised, fail a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check, or fail a Cultivation Check to notice an immediate spiritual danger

effects.evidence: Echo of the Chosen Step: record the space where that movement began as your Before-Space; Bonus Action, 1 Resonance, 1 Time Debt: return to your Before-Space. Before the Bell: 1 Time Debt.

riders: Time Debt: a tally you can carry, to a maximum of your Proficiency Bonus -- the GM keeps the count. It cannot be passed to harmless creatures, disposable Assets or captives. At the end of the scene your Time Debt becomes Temporal Arrears; clearing them takes 10 quiet minutes.
Before the Bell on an Initiative roll -- blocked: the table rolls Initiative when the fight is created, before any choice can be offered (gate2_engine, a saved-fight lock file).

Before the Bell when you are Surprised, fail a Perception or Insight check, or fail a check to notice a spiritual danger, and learning the danger's direction -- the GM's (the table has no Surprise, and its Search roll learns its result per hidden creature afterwards).
Echo of the Chosen Step contested by a Source Rule that seals time, Space or routes -- the GM's.
Soul Splitting -- Yesterday's Witness -- blocked: the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: Your soul recognizes the pressure of a moment immediately before the body understands it.
Choose the result appropriate to the trigger:
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to the Initiative roll, ability check, or Cultivation Check. You decide after rolling but before the final outcome is declared.
This movement:
- does not provoke opportunity attacks;
- is not ordinary teleportation;
- can be contested by a Source Rule that seals time, Space, routes, or conceptual movement;
- restores only your position.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.well_of_hours.f.name: The Well Has No Bottom

effects.evidence: The area becomes a Well of Hours, a spiritual-temporal field.

Record the Round Image of every creature of your choice in the area. Friendly Current. Hostile Undertow. Return to the Bell: set your Time Debt to its maximum; take 3d10 Psychic damage. Drink the Unlived Hour: gain 1 Time Debt. Collapse of the Well: your remaining Time Debt is converted into Temporal Arrears.

riders: Friendly Current's "draw or stow one item and use Spiritual Sense" -- the GM's.
Hostile Undertow's Delayed Movement and Delayed Reaction -- blocked (see Hourglass Mark); a failed save after a move or a Reaction still gives your Resonance Mark.

Return to the Bell does not restore destroyed Assets, severed limbs, broken Foundations, consumed souls, permanent Hidden Injuries or death -- the table restores only space, Hit Points and ordinary conditions.
Higher-Source-CL Time, Fate, Void, Samsara, Boundary, Seal, Formation, divine or artifact authority contesting the field -- the GM's.
Temporal Arrears: the table keeps your Resonance at or below its maximum minus your Arrears; clearing them (10 quiet minutes) -- the GM's.
description: You reveal the local truth that every present moment rests above an immeasurable depth of moments that might have been.
The area becomes a Well of Hours, a spiritual-temporal field and Source Rule.
- its space;
- its ordinary conditions.
- draw or stow one item and use Spiritual Sense;
Successful Save: Choose one:
- Remove ordinary conditions gained after the image was recorded.

- Do not restore a destroyed Cultivation Asset, severed limb, broken Foundation, consumed soul, permanent Hidden Injury, completed death, or higher-authority consequence unless a successful Cultivation Check and the originating Source Rule both permit temporal restoration.
After using Return to the Bell:
- set your Time Debt to its maximum;
When the field ends:
- every Deferred Consequence whose subject is inside it resolves immediately unless already answered;
- your remaining Time Debt is converted into Temporal Arrears normally.
You cannot activate The Well Has No Bottom again until:
This is a defined cultivation-recharge procedure, not a short-rest or long-rest limit.

A higher-Source-CL Time, Fate, Void, Samsara, Boundary, Seal, Formation, divine, artifact, or conceptual authority can contest individual operations of the field. Ordinary anti-magic does not automatically erase it unless that effect also suppresses cultivation Source Rules.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler.name: True Yokai Form

effects.evidence: You gain the benefits of Unmasking without paying its cost, your natural weapon die becomes 1d10, and gain the lineage package: Resistance chosen when you transform; Ninefold Feint; Mountain Wind Cut; River Lock; Grand Silk.

riders: Kitsune True Form grants Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover; Tengu True Form grants Fly Speed 50 feet. Swim and climb speeds, breathing water, web-walking and ceilings still require their terrain procedure.
Equipment merging into the form and True-Form Exposure (observers see you are not wholly human) -- the GM's.
Ninefold Feint: the 15-foot move is a free step (no Opportunity Attack); the foxfire sign letting Soul Gaze reach the attacker through ordinary invisibility -- the GM's.

River Lock against incorporeal movement still needs manual resolution. It automatically contests a grappled creature's teleport. Grand Silk offers Break free as an Action to repeat its Dexterity save, ending that restraint on success.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler.name: Unmasking

effects.evidence: Choose an appropriate bite, claw, horn, wing-blade, tail, web-strike, water-heavy blow, or foxfire lash when you activate Unmasking. It deals 1d8 + Wisdom modifier damage of your lineage affinity or an appropriate physical type. Once on each of your turns when you hit with the natural weapon or a creature fails its save against Mind Spike, deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus of your lineage affinity.

riders: The Tell cannot be suppressed while Unmasking lasts -- not a combat effect. The weapon's shape (bite, claw, horn ...) is description: the table asks its damage type.
Kitsune: the step after a missed attack against your foxfire double is a free 5-foot step (no Opportunity Attack).
Worn equipment merging into the form -- the GM's.
description: This is a weapon expression of your own body and soul. It is not a Sphere talent and does not count as a detached Cultivation Asset.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler.name: Yokai Lord

effects.evidence: Assume True Yokai Form and manifest a Yokai Court in a 30-foot aura centered on you. Lineage Apotheosis: Heaven-Scouring Descent; Court Beneath the River; Web of a Hundred Names.

riders: Court Authority (Overawed) and Lordly Challenge -- blocked: the table records no creature type (beast, yokai, spirit-beast, transformed or spiritually compromised).
Kitsune Palace of Foxfire -- blocked: the table measures a technique from its user (a double cannot be its origin).

Heaven-Scouring Descent has no printed Action cost: the table offers it free on your turn, once. Court Beneath the River: breathing, swimming and standing in it, and forced passage across its edge -- the GM's (a hostile teleport across it needs the Charisma save).
Web of a Hundred Names: the Thread Anchor stands in your space.
Soul Splitting Expression -- Masked Twin -- blocked: the table has no Soul Fragment.
description: You become a local sovereign expression of your inherited lineage rather than merely revealing an ancestral body.
Gain one greater expression:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler.name: Yokai Mask

effects.evidence: Lineage Gift: Tengu -- as a Reaction when pushed or knocked Prone, spend 1 Resonance to move 10 feet to a legal space and remain standing; Kappa -- as a Reaction when you or an adjacent ally would be moved, spend 1 Resonance to reduce that movement by 10 feet and shift the creature 5 feet; Jorogumo -- once on each of your turns when you Resonance Mark a creature, you may reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the mark ends.

riders: Your lineage (Kitsune, Tengu, Kappa or Jorogumo, chosen at CL3) is not on the Factory sheet: the table keeps it for the fight (the "Yokai Lineage" setting buttons, or asked the first time Unmasking needs it). Its Tell, Need, Taboo (2d10 Psychic for a knowing violation) and skill proficiency are the GM's and the sheet's.
Suppressing or revealing your Tell (Bonus Action) and using Wisdom for Deception about your nature -- not combat abilities.
Kitsune Foxfire Misdirection -- blocked: the table has no Insight contest against you and no attackable illusion, reflection or duplicate.
Tengu reduces the fall used for damage by 10 feet per Proficiency Bonus. Double jump distance, Kappa swimming and held breath, and Jorogumo climbing still require their movement procedure.
description: Your inheritance can be hidden, displayed, or used as a social and spiritual instrument.
Gain the gift of your chosen lineage:

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler.name: Yokai’s Bargain
riders: Yokai's Bargain is negotiated: it forms only if both parties knowingly accept its stated terms, and its benefits (skill Advantage, travel speed, Temporary Hit Points at the start of the first scene it is pursued, telepathy, crossing a ward) and a Yokai Claim after a knowing breach are the GM's.
description: Yokai bargains are voluntary exchanges enforced by hospitality, appetite, clever wording, and spiritual face. They are not Oath-Ledger debts, Soul-Collateral Contracts, or Karma judgments.
The claimant may spend the Claim in one of these ways:
